# 58I. The Deposit's Other Movers: Reopen and New Closing, and Split Corrections (VC-X-50, spec)

**Status:** implemented (VC-X-50, migration 0065; "As implemented (VC-X-50)" at the end of this section). **Open questions 1–7 decided by the owner on 2026-11-03** (chat; "Decided by the owner on 2026-11-03 (chat)" under "Open questions (decided)" at the end of this section): each as proposed (a reopen and the next closing each judged alone, "in no year" as a year `null`; a first closing recorded after the year's end flagged; no `sourceType` in the year item, the kind tells; `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` or `USE_CHANGED` an open item flag; the corrections under `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`; every correction or reversal after the year's end that changes P's sums of the year flagged; VC-X-50 after VC-X-49 as a whole, one migration, its own e2e test, ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged). Backlog VC-X-50, created by the owner's decision on §58H open question 3 („wie vorgeschlagen. Wiedereröffnung mit neuem Abschluss und Split-Korrekturen als neue Backlog-Zeile, jetzt anlegen, nicht in VC-X-49.“; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-03). **Migration: 0065** (`0065_tax_year_deposit_and_correction_movers`, the next free number on main after VC-X-49's 0064; 0063 is VC-X-48's; Kysely's Migrator refuses a migration whose name sorts before one already applied, so the number is fixed only by the merge order). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it. It amends §58E (Part 1's kinds; the year item may name no year; the acknowledgement table's CHECKs) and §58G (the part kinds), additively, and builds on VC-X-49 (§58H), whose text it does not change. Placement, signs, the per-owner arithmetic, the attribution of Loan interest (§58D), § 82b, VC-8-05's AfA, the 31-December rule and the rule for `final` are unchanged. **ACC7 and ACC8 stay unchanged; VC-X-50 has its own e2e test** (open question 7, decided as proposed, as for VC-X-48 and VC-X-49).

**Why a section of its own, after §58H:** VC-X-50 is a backlog item of its own; §58H names both movers under "Not a change here" and points to it.

The two movers, read against the code (paths below are relative to `services/de-backend/src/`):

| Input | What it moves | Fits | Proposal |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) A deposit **reopened** and **closed anew** (§47.4) | the deposit's **year**: its tax year is its closing date's (§58A), and between a reopen and the next closing it is in no year | §58E Part 1 (the year shape), with a side that names no year (open question 1) | kinds `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED` of `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED` |
| (b) A **split correction** (§35) moving a split to another PropertyReference | every split of the corrected Transaction between views: the original's splits stop counting, the replacement's start | §58G's part shape | kinds `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED` of `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` (open questions 5 and 6) |
| (b) for the **deposit** of the moved rent's Tenant | the deposit's view | already §58H's kinds: a reconciled rent split is released before it can be corrected, and matched again after | nothing new; a test pins it |

**The kind names follow the AuditRecord actions** they read (as `RECONCILIATION_CONFIRMED` and `LOAN_TERMS_ADDED` do) and are kept as they are; they live in the namespace of the flags' `kind` and of `change_kind`, separate from error reasons and other enums. `DEPOSIT_CLOSED` is also a `409` reason (`api/error-answers/security-deposit.ts:27`; `planVoid`, `domains/security-deposit/deposit.ts:153`; a split on a closed deposit, `domains/ledger/transaction-split.ts:185`), and `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED` is also a `NotCountingReason` of an acquisition cost (`domains/acquisition/cost.ts:21`). A client tells them apart by the field (`kind` in a flag entry or an acknowledgement, `reason` in an error), never by the value alone.

### As the code stands (main 15a695d, after VC-X-48; the file:line references re-read against main ff60600, after VC-X-49, #258)

**The deposit's closing and reopen.**

- **Close** (`infrastructure/postgres/security-deposit-closing.ts:21-72`) writes `CLOSED` on the entity `SecurityDeposit` (`security-deposit-rows.ts:23`) with `metadata` `{ closingDate, reason, closingNote, heldAtClosing }` (`security-deposit-closing.ts:65-69`, `closingJson` at `:141-146`). `planClose` (`domains/security-deposit/deposit.ts:180-202`) refuses a deposit that is not `ACTIVE` (`:191`, `409 DEPOSIT_NOT_ACTIVE`), so a closed deposit takes another closing **only through a reopen**; it refuses cash booked after `closingDate` (`:192-195`). Repeating the same closing is `UNCHANGED`, no record (`:182-190`).
- **Reopen** (`security-deposit-closing.ts:74-122`; `planReopen`, `deposit.ts:211-215`) sets `ACTIVE` and clears `closing_date`, `closing_reason`, `closing_note`, `held_at_closing` (`security-deposit-closing.ts:100-112`), and writes `REOPENED` with `metadata.cleared` = the closing it cleared (`:114-119`). The deposit's other records are `CREATED`, `AMENDED`, `VOIDED` (`security-deposit-store.ts:117`, `:241`, `:292`).
- **The retained amount** is computed from the **stored** `held_at_closing` (`retainedAmountOf`, `deposit.ts:218-221`; read in `tax-source-facts.ts:302-310`), never from the cash as now; no split may name a `CLOSED` deposit except a reversal (`domains/ledger/transaction-split.ts:182-185`). So a closed deposit's year and amount change only by a reopen and a new closing.
- **In the view:** `closedDepositsOf` (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-reads.ts:371-401`) reads the Realm's deposits with `status = 'CLOSED'` and `closing_date` in `year` (`:380-387`) that count by the deposit (`depositNotCounted(f, null)`, `:395`); `yearItems` lists one in P's view when its PropertyReference is P (`:349`); `buildTaxYearView` lists a `null` one not attributed (`domains/taxation/tax-year-view.ts:177-179`). A reopened deposit is in no year's view; reclosed, it is in its new closing date's year.
- **The old classification** stores the closing it classified; another date or amount makes it not count (`depositNotCounted`, `domains/taxation/deposit-closing.ts:70-84`, `CLOSING_CHANGED` at `:79-82`). The meaning then keeps the classification's `reviewState` and `treatment` (`:117-135`), the view places the item `UNCLASSIFIED` (`tax-year-items.ts:85`) with the meaning's flag `NOT_COUNTED` (`:202`), and adds `NEEDS_REVIEW`/`UNCLASSIFIED` only from the review state and treatment (`:137-138`). **`NOT_COUNTED` is informative in the review** (it is in none of `CONFIRMABLE`, `OPEN_ITEM_FLAGS`, `OPEN_YEAR_FLAGS`, `tax-year-review.ts:14-46`; `flagIsOpen`, `:68-84`). So the new year shows the deposit open (`NEEDS_REVIEW`, `UNCLASSIFIED`) only when it had no classification; with a confirmed classification of the old closing it is listed in `unclassified`, never summed, and **nothing holds the year open** (open question 4). §58C "As implemented" said "needing review with their `NOT_COUNTED` flag"; the review table did not name the flag. **Decided (open question 4):** `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` or `USE_CHANGED` is now an open item flag (§58C's review table and "As implemented" corrected; "As implemented (VC-X-50)" 6).
- **No code reads** the `CLOSED` or `REOPENED` records for tax.

**The split correction.**

- **A confirmed Transaction's splits are frozen**: `PUT …/splits` works only while `IMPORTED`, `UNREVIEWED`, `CLASSIFIED` (`SPLITTABLE_STATUSES`, `domains/ledger/transaction-split.ts:44`; `planSplits`, `:58-61`; `SPLITS_REPLACED`, `infrastructure/postgres/transaction-split-repository.ts:167`), and those Transactions never count for tax (`COUNTED = ['CONFIRMED', 'RECONCILED']`, `tax-source-facts.ts:36`; `countingSplits`, `:133-134`). A counting split moves to another PropertyReference only by a **correction**.
- **The correction** (`infrastructure/postgres/correction-repository.ts`) writes a reversal and, for `correct`, a replacement with new splits (new split ids), sets the original `CORRECTED` (`:138-162`) and writes **one** AuditRecord `CORRECTED` (or `REVERSED` without a replacement) on the original `Transaction` (`:175-184`), with `reversalTransactionId`, `replacementTransactionId` and `changes` (`:399-422`: `splits.from`/`splits.to` with each split's `propertyReferenceId`). The original and the reversal stop counting; the replacement counts.
- **A rent split with a `CONFIRMED` reconciliation cannot be corrected:** `planCorrection` answers `TRANSACTION_RENT_RECONCILED` (`domains/ledger/correct-transaction.ts:125-126`; the reconciliations read under the original's lock, `correction-repository.ts:105-120`). A reconciliation is made only on a counting, non-reversal Transaction (`domains/rent-reconciliation/reconciliation.ts:115`). So the sequence is always: release (`RentPaymentReconciliation` `RELEASED`), correct (`Transaction` `CORRECTED`), match the replacement (`CONFIRMED`).
- **The view reads a split by its own PropertyReference** (`tax-year-reads.ts:317`), not the Transaction's. A replacement whose original's split was classified and which has none of its own carries `CLASSIFICATION_ON_CORRECTED_SPLIT`, open (`tax-year-review.ts:25`) — in the view it **reaches**. The view it **leaves** loses the split's figure with no flag.

**What VC-X-28, VC-X-48 and VC-X-49 already give.**

- `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED`'s kinds and year item (`domains/taxation/attribution-rule.ts:5-21`): `yearBefore`, `yearAfter` are numbers; `movedItems` (`:44-54`) compares them; `recordedAfter` is the 31-December rule (`:42`). The item flag is put only on a `TRANSACTION_SPLIT` (`tax-year-items.ts:131-136`).
- `replay` (`attribution-history.ts:86-95`) replays an on/off history; `walk` (`:101-122`) the records of a group of entities. A deposit's history has a value (the closing), not only on/off.
- `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` (`attribution-parts.ts:22-27`; `partOn`, `:111-123`; `partMoved`, `:126-129`, a step between `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` and `NONE` not flagged, §58G open question 3, decided).
- The tables: 0060's `tax_year_acknowledgement` (`change_kind`, `change_entity_type`, `_kind_entity`, `migrations/0060_tax_year_acknowledgements.ts:35-54`) and `tax_year_acknowledgement_item` (`year_before`, `year_after` `NOT NULL`, `_moved` `year_before <> year_after`, `:68-75`); 0063's widened CHECKs (`0063_tax_year_part_acknowledgements.ts:35`), `tax_year_acknowledgement_part_item` (`source_type` `TRANSACTION_SPLIT`, `:52`) and the shape guard (`:90-105`). VC-X-49 (§58H) adds `LOAN_CLOSED`, the two deposit reconciliation kinds and `DEPOSIT_CLOSING` part items.

### Routes

**No new route.** §58E's acknowledgement routes serve the new kinds, with §58G's optional `kind`. `docs/development/api-inventory.md` is unchanged.

### Part 1: a deposit reopened and closed anew (`ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED`)

| `kind` | AuditRecords read | Candidate items | The input before / after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DEPOSIT_REOPENED` | `SecurityDeposit` `REOPENED` | the deposits of the Realm **attributed to P now** (their PropertyReference derived as §58A does, as now, is P) with at least one `CLOSED` record | the deposit's closing, replayed from its records in `(occurred_at, id)` order; its year on a side is the year of `closingDate` when closed with `retainedAmountOf` > 0, else **none** (`null`) |
| `DEPOSIT_CLOSED` | `SecurityDeposit` `CLOSED` | as above | as above |

- **One rule** (§58E Part 1): flagged in P's view of `year` when the two years differ (`null` counts as a value: `2027` and `null` differ), one of them is `year`, and the record lies after 31 December of `year` (`recordedAfter`). Each record is judged alone (open question 1).
- **The closing per side** comes from the records: `CLOSED` sets it from `metadata` (`closingDate`, `reason`, `heldAtClosing`; the retained amount by `retainedAmountOf`), `REOPENED` clears it, `CREATED` starts without one, `VOIDED` keeps none, `AMENDED` leaves it (only `ACTIVE` fields and `notes` change, §47.1).
- **The history:** consistent when the replay ends in the deposit's status and closing now (`closing_date`, `closing_reason`, `held_at_closing`), and each `REOPENED`'s `metadata.cleared` equals the closing it follows. Otherwise `ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` with `{ entityType: "SecurityDeposit", entityId }`, its records unused, its year as now (open, as today).
- **Only deposits attributed to P are candidates.** A deposit listed not attributed (`NO_RECONCILED_RENT` in every view, `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES` in each candidate's) is never summed, so its year moving moves no figure of any view; while it is in a year, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` holds that year open (since VC-X-51 also with a classification of an earlier closing, §58J). This follows §58G open question 3 (decided: `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` ↔ `NONE` is no part change).
- **The entry's keys:** `securityDepositId`, `mreTenantId`, `closingDate` (the record's: the new one for `DEPOSIT_CLOSED`, the cleared one for `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`), `reason`. `items: [{ sourceId, yearBefore, yearAfter }]`, with `sourceId` the deposit's id and a year `null` for "in no year" (open questions 1 and 3).
- **The item flag** of the same code goes on the deposit item now in `year` (attributed); `deriveItem`'s filter on `TRANSACTION_SPLIT` (`tax-year-items.ts:133`) is widened by the kind (a deposit kind's item is a `DEPOSIT_CLOSING`).
- **What it covers:**
  - a reopen after the year's end of a deposit closed in it (the year loses the item: `yearBefore` = `year`, `yearAfter` = `null`);
  - a closing after the year's end with a date in it, the first closing included (`null` → `year`; open question 2);
  - a reopen and a new closing in the same year with another amount: both records move the year to `null` and back, so both are flagged, although the year is the same at the end (the figure moved);
  - a reopen and a new closing with the same date and amount (a reopen by mistake): both flagged, the old classification counts again (`deposit-closing.ts:79-82`); two acknowledgements (open question 1).
- **Not a change:** a closing or reopen recorded before 31 December of the years it touches; a deposit with `RETURNED` or nothing retained on both sides (`null` to `null`); an amend (`notes`); a correction of the cash after the closing (`HELD_CHANGED_AFTER_CLOSING`, §47.4: the stored `held_at_closing` decides, `tax-source-facts.ts:302-310`); a deposit's PropertyReference moving (§58H's part kinds).
- **The classification is untouched:** a new closing still needs a new classification (§58A). Whether the new year holds a deposit with a confirmed classification of the old closing open was open question 4 (decided: it does, `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` is an open item flag); this section does not need it to flag the old year.

### Part 2: a split correction (`PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`)

| `kind` | AuditRecords read | Candidate items | The input before / after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED` | `Transaction` `CORRECTED` | the splits of the corrected Transaction and of its replacement that P's view attributes or lists on either side (the split's PropertyReference is P; a `LOAN_INTEREST` split by §58D's sets) and whose tax year is `year` (§58A, derived now, as if counting) | before: the original's splits count, the replacement does not exist; after: the replacement's splits count, the original's do not |
| `TRANSACTION_REVERSED` | `Transaction` `REVERSED` | the original's splits, as above | before: the original's splits count; after: none |

- **P's part of a split** (§58G's states): `ATTRIBUTED` with `part` = its amount when its PropertyReference is P (a `LOAN_INTEREST` split: P's part by §58D, `partOn`), `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` where P's view lists it not attributed (§58D's `candidates`), `NONE` otherwise or when it does not count on that side. An original's split goes `ATTRIBUTED` → `NONE`, a replacement's `NONE` → `ATTRIBUTED`.
- **The rule (open question 6's proposal):** flagged in P's view of `year` when the record lies after 31 December of `year` and, for some financial category and direction, the sum of P's parts of the splits with tax year `year` differs between the two sides. The items are then every candidate split whose state or part moved (`partMoved`). So a correction that only fixes a description or the Transaction's own `propertyReferenceId` (the view reads the split's, `tax-year-reads.ts:317`) raises nothing, and one that moves a split from P1 to P2 raises the flag in both views.
- **A booking date corrected across the year's edge** is covered by the same sums: the original's split leaves `year`, the replacement's counts in another year. It is a part change in the year it leaves (and in the year it reaches, if that year has ended too), not a year kind: the item is a new split, so §58E's "the same item, another year" does not hold.
- **The entry's keys:** `transactionId` (the original), `reversalTransactionId`, `replacementTransactionId` (`null` for `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`), `reason` (the correction's). `items: [{ sourceType: "TRANSACTION_SPLIT", sourceId, taxYear, stateBefore, partBefore, stateAfter, partAfter }]` (§58G's shape, unchanged).
- **A chain:** a replacement corrected again is its own record; each step is judged alone (the original of the step against its replacement).
- **The history:** a Transaction has at most one `CORRECTED` or `REVERSED` record (`CORRECTED` is final, `ALREADY_CORRECTED`, `correct-transaction.ts:106-114`). It is consistent when the status now is `CORRECTED` with exactly one such record and the record's `reversalTransactionId`/`replacementTransactionId` equal the Transaction's links; otherwise `ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` with `{ entityType: "Transaction", entityId }`, the record unused.
- **The deposit of the moved rent's Tenant** needs no kind here. The reconciliation is released before the correction and the replacement matched after it (above), and §58H's `DEPOSIT_RECONCILIATION_RELEASED`/`_CONFIRMED` judge exactly those records (the PropertyReference of the released reconciliation's split read from the original, whose splits stay stored). A test pins that a correction moving a Tenant's only reconciled rent from P1 to P2 flags the deposit in P1 (release) and P2 (match) by §58H and raises no deposit item under the correction's kind.
- **The rent's year** is §58E's: release and match are `RECONCILIATION_RELEASED`/`_CONFIRMED`, flagged only when they move the year (a split in a window at the year's edge).
- **The classification is untouched:** the replacement's split keeps P7-D2's `CLASSIFICATION_ON_CORRECTED_SPLIT` (open) where its original was classified. The fingerprint and the sums read the ledger (financial category, direction, amount), not the classification.
- **Not a change:** a correction recorded before 31 December of the years it touches; `SPLITS_REPLACED` (never on a counting Transaction); a reconciliation's records (§58E, §58H).

### In the view (additive)

- **`ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED`** gains the kinds `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED` (year shape; a year may be `null`) and the item flag on a deposit item now in `year`.
- **`PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`** gains the kinds `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED` (part shape) and the item flag on a split item now in P's view of `year` (attributed, or in `notAttributed`).
- **Levels by state, fingerprints, acknowledgements and withdrawals** exactly as §58E and §58G.
- **The snapshot** (§58C "One snapshot") gains the Realm's deposits with a `CLOSED` record and their `SecurityDeposit` records, and the Realm's `CORRECTED` Transactions with a split (of the original or of the replacement) that can count in `year` for P, with their records.
- **`ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT`** gains the entity types `SecurityDeposit` and `Transaction`.

### The fingerprint

As §58E Part 2 for the year kinds (`{ propertyReferenceId, year, auditRecordId, kind, items }`, items sorted by `sourceId`; a `null` year is `null` in the canonical JSON) and as §58G for the part kinds (the parts as exact cents). **No change to an existing kind's fingerprint:** the year item gains no key (open question 3), so no acknowledgement stored today re-opens.

### Acknowledging a change (§58E Part 2, §58G, reused)

`POST …/tax-years/{year}/acknowledgements` with §58G's body; `kind` one of the new kinds too.

```json
{
  "auditRecordId": "6f1c2a9e-0000-4000-8000-000000000501",
  "kind": "DEPOSIT_REOPENED",
  "expectedFingerprint": "5d2b8f0e4a6c1e3b7d9f0a2c4e6b8d1f3a5c7e9b0d2f4a6c8e1b3d5f7a9c0e2b",
  "reason": "Erklärung 2027 noch nicht abgegeben; Kaution nach Teilverzicht neu abgerechnet (synthetisch)"
}
```

- **Order of checks:** §58G's, unchanged; step 3 derives the new kinds too. `CHANGE_AMBIGUOUS` does not arise from the new kinds' own records (a `SecurityDeposit` record is only a year change, a `Transaction` record only a part change); it stays possible for §58H's reconciliation record.
- **Idempotency, `If-Match`, one change per request, withdraw:** unchanged. The `ACKNOWLEDGED` AuditRecord carries the items in their shape (a `null` year as `null`).

### In the database (migration: the next free number at implementation)

On the tables of 0060, 0063 and VC-X-49's migration:

- **`tax_year_acknowledgement`:** `change_kind`'s CHECK gains `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED`, `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`; `change_entity_type`'s gains `SecurityDeposit`, `Transaction`; `tax_year_acknowledgement_kind_entity` binds `SecurityDeposit` to the two deposit kinds and `Transaction` to the two correction kinds (dropped and re-added under their names, as 0063).
- **`tax_year_acknowledgement_item`:** `year_before` and `year_after` become nullable (the range CHECKs stay for a value); `_moved` becomes `year_before IS DISTINCT FROM year_after`; a new CHECK `tax_year_acknowledgement_item_some_year`: `num_nonnulls(year_before, year_after) >= 1`.
- **The shape guard** (`tax_year_acknowledgement_item_shape`, 0063): the deposit kinds take year items only, the correction kinds part items only; **a `null` year only under a deposit kind** (read from the acknowledgement's `change_kind`); refused otherwise.
- **`tax_year_acknowledgement_part_item`:** unchanged (`TRANSACTION_SPLIT` is there; `DEPOSIT_CLOSING` comes with VC-X-49).
- **`down`** restores the CHECKs and `NOT NULL`; with an acknowledgement of a new kind or a year item with a `null` year present it **refuses** (a person's statement is never dropped silently, as 0060).
- **No column** on `security_deposit`, `ledger_transaction`, `transaction_split`, `rent_payment_reconciliation` or `tax_classification`.

### Error answers

None new. `CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED`, `CHANGE_AMBIGUOUS`, `ATTRIBUTION_CHANGE_DIFFERS` as §58E and §58G.

### Examples (synthetic)

**(a) A deposit reopened and closed anew in another year.** P1 owned by A `"1/1"`. Tenant T's rent is booked on P1 and reconciled during 2027, so T's deposit D is attributed to P1. D held 900.00; 600.00 is repaid on 2027-12-15, and D is closed on **2027-12-20** `RETAINED`, `heldAtClosing` 300.00, retained **300.00**, classified `RETAINED_DEPOSIT_DAMAGES` / `INCOME` (`USER_CONFIRMED`). P1's 2027 view has the line `RETAINED_DEPOSIT_DAMAGES` 300.00.

- **On 2028-02-12** D is reopened (part of the claim is waived). D is `ACTIVE`, in no year: P1's 2027 income falls by 300.00, and D is in no list of 2027.
- **On 2028-02-14** a repayment of 50.00 booked on 2028-01-10 is linked to D, and D is closed again with `closingDate` **2028-01-10**, `RETAINED`, `heldAtClosing` 250.00: retained **250.00**, tax year **2028**.
- **P1's 2027:** `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED`, open, one entry `DEPOSIT_REOPENED` with `items: [{ sourceId: D, yearBefore: 2027, yearAfter: null }]`. The `CLOSED` record (`null` → 2028) touches neither side's 2027 and is not an entry of 2027.
- **P1's 2028:** the `CLOSED` record was made during 2028: not flagged. D is in P1's 2028 view, `counts: false`, in `unclassified` with `NOT_COUNTED` (`CLOSING_CHANGED`; the classification is of 2027-12-20 and 300.00), its review state `USER_CONFIRMED`: before VC-X-50 nothing held 2028 open through D; decided (open question 4): `NOT_COUNTED` is open, so 2028 is not final until D is classified anew. A new classification superseding the old one puts 250.00 in 2028's line.
- **Acknowledged** in 2027 (`kind` `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, the entry's fingerprint): informative, 2027 final again if nothing else is open. Acknowledging the `CLOSED` record in 2027 answers `409 CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED`.
- **Variant, a reopen by mistake:** closed again on 2028-02-14 with 2027-12-20 and 300.00 (no further cash). A second entry in 2027, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED` with `items: [{ sourceId: D, yearBefore: null, yearAfter: 2027 }]`; the old classification counts again (same closing), 300.00 is back in P1's 2027 line. Two acknowledgements; under open question 1's alternative, none.
- **Variant, the same year and another amount:** the 50.00 repayment booked on 2027-12-18, D closed again on 2028-02-14 with 2027-12-20 and 250.00. Both records are entries of 2027 (2027 → `null`, `null` → 2027); D's old classification no longer counts, D is in 2027's `unclassified`, 2027's income is 300.00 lower until D is classified anew.

**(b) A rent split corrected to another PropertyReference.** P1 owned by A `"1/1"`, P2 owned by B `"1/1"`. Tenant U rents a flat in P2. An inflow X of 950.00, booked on **2027-11-03**, has one split S1 `RENT_BASE` 950.00 on **P1** (a booking error), reconciled (`CONFIRMED` on 2027-11-05) to U's term 2027-11. S1 is classified `RENT` / `INCOME` (`USER_CONFIRMED`). P1's 2027 `RENT` line includes the 950.00.

- **On 2028-03-02** the reconciliation is released, X is corrected (replacement Y, booked 2027-11-03, one split S2 `RENT_BASE` 950.00 on **P2**), and Y is matched to U's term 2027-11. Release and match move no year (a booking in November; §58E raises nothing).
- **P1's 2027:** the `RENT` line falls by 950.00; `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`, open, one entry `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED` (`transactionId` X, `replacementTransactionId` Y) with `items: [{ sourceType: "TRANSACTION_SPLIT", sourceId: S1, taxYear: 2027, stateBefore: "ATTRIBUTED", partBefore: "950.00", stateAfter: "NONE", partAfter: null }]`.
- **P2's 2027:** the `RENT` line grows by 950.00; one entry `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED` with `items: [{ sourceType: "TRANSACTION_SPLIT", sourceId: S2, taxYear: 2027, stateBefore: "NONE", partBefore: null, stateAfter: "ATTRIBUTED", partAfter: "950.00" }]`, the item flag on S2; S2 also carries `CLASSIFICATION_ON_CORRECTED_SPLIT` (open) until classified.
- **With a deposit:** had U a deposit E closed on 2027-12-20 (after the November rent) with 200.00 retained, and S1 been U's only reconciled rent, the release makes E `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` (P1: `ATTRIBUTED` 200.00 → `NOT_ATTRIBUTED`, §58H's `DEPOSIT_RECONCILIATION_RELEASED`, flagged), and the match attributes it to P2 (P2: `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` → `ATTRIBUTED` 200.00, `DEPOSIT_RECONCILIATION_CONFIRMED`, flagged; P1 `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` → `NONE`, not). The correction's entry has no deposit item.
- **Variant, an amount only:** X corrected to 905.00 on P1. Under open question 6's proposal P1's 2027 is flagged (the `RENT_BASE` inflow sum 950.00 → 905.00; items S1 and S2); under its alternative, not. A description-only correction raises nothing under both.

### The effect on `final`, ACC7 and ACC8

- **The rule stays §58C's.** A year with a reopen, a late closing or a correction after its end that changed it is not final until each change is acknowledged; this can turn a `final: true` of today into `false` after deployment (the intended correction; a release note as VC-X-28's and VC-X-48's).
- **What an acknowledgement does not replace** (§58E, decided 2026-11-02): it classifies no deposit and no replacement split, changes no figure and no stage of §60A.
- **ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged** (open question 7's proposal): neither reopens a deposit or corrects a Transaction after the end of a year it would change (as the tests' clock runs). Both run unchanged; **a flag appearing there is a finding to report and explain, not to suppress.**

### Performance

- **Deposits:** the Realm's deposits with a `CLOSED` record that are attributed to P (a handful; the attribution as `depositFactsOf` reads it, `tax-source-facts.ts:263-322`) and their `SecurityDeposit` records by `audit_record_entity_idx`, after the deposits were selected in the Realm.
- **Corrections:** the Realm's `CORRECTED` Transactions whose own split **or whose replacement's split** is on P (or of a candidate Loan) and can count in `year` (booked in it, in its windows, or overridden to it), with the splits of both; one AuditRecord each by `audit_record_entity_idx`. A plan test reads them inside the view's snapshot.

### The code that changes (pointers)

- **`domains/taxation/attribution-rule.ts`:** the kinds `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED`, entity type `SecurityDeposit`; `ChangeItem`'s years `number | null` for the deposit kinds; `movedItems` compares with `null` as a value.
- **`domains/taxation/attribution-history.ts`:** `depositClosingChanges` (a replay with the closing as the state, not `replay`'s on/off).
- **`domains/taxation/attribution-parts.ts`:** `correctionPartChanges` (the per-category, per-direction sums and the items), the part kinds gain `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`, entity type `Transaction`.
- **`domains/taxation/tax-year-items.ts`:** the item flag of `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED` on a deposit item (`:131-136`).
- **`infrastructure/postgres/attribution-reads.ts`, `part-reads.ts`:** the deposits and their records, the corrections and their records, in the view's snapshot, every entity selected in the Realm first; the command (`tax-statement-repository.ts`) the same in its own.
- **Migration** `<n>_tax_year_deposit_and_correction_movers` (above).
- **No change:** `security-deposit-closing.ts`, `correction-repository.ts`, `deposit-closing.ts`, `rent-reconciliation-repository.ts`, `api-inventory.md`.

### Tests the implementation needs

- **Domain (pure):** example (a) with its numbers (2027 flagged by the reopen only, 2028 not; the record on 31 December and on 1 January); both variants (two entries; the same year with another amount); a first closing recorded after the year's end (open question 2); `RETURNED` on both sides (nothing); a deposit not attributed (no candidate); an inconsistent history (`ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` with `SecurityDeposit`: a `CLOSED` deposit without a record, a `REOPENED` whose `cleared` differs); example (b) (P1 and P2 flagged, items and parts); a reversal; a chain of two corrections; a description-only and a Transaction-`propertyReferenceId`-only correction (nothing); a booking date corrected across the year's edge (the year left flagged, the year reached flagged only if ended); a `LOAN_INTEREST` split corrected (P's part by §58D); a `taxYear` override; the fingerprints (a `null` year; existing kinds' fingerprints byte for byte unchanged); levels and `final`.
- **Repository (PostgreSQL):** the order of checks with the new kinds; idempotency; withdraw; one snapshot; **schema past the repository**, each with a counter-check: a deposit kind with another entity type or with a part item, a correction kind with a year item, a `null` year under a non-deposit kind, both years `null`, equal years; Realm isolation (another Realm's deposits, Transactions and records never read; their ids `CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED`); "no cash mutated" around every view; the plans; `up`, `down`, `down` refusing with a row of a new kind or a `null` year.
- **Only the replacement on P, or only it in `year`** (repository and plan test): example (b) read from P2's view (only Y's split S2 is on P2; X must be selected through its replacement, else P2 is not flagged), and an original booked on 2026-06-15 on P corrected after the end of 2027 to 2027-06-15 (only the replacement counts in 2027; P's 2027 is flagged, the original found through its replacement); each with a counter-check that a correction with neither split on P is not read.
- **The deposit under a correction:** example (b)'s variant with E: §58H's two kinds flag P1 and P2, the correction's entry has no deposit item.
- **API:** the DTO of both shapes for the new kinds, a `null` year in the year shape.
- **End to end** (`tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`, its own; synthetic values only, a settable clock): examples (a) and (b) through the HTTP API (D reopened and closed again, 2027 acknowledged, the `CLOSED` record refused in 2027 with `CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED`; X corrected from P1 to P2, both views acknowledged), **Realm isolation** and **no cash mutated** around them. ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged.

### Counter-checks and mutations

**Counter-checks:** no deposit leaving or reaching a closed year without the flag; no split leaving or reaching a closed year's view by a correction without the flag; no flag where the sums did not change; no figure changed by an acknowledgement; nothing written by a view.

**Mutations** that must turn the tests red (each applied alone, restored byte for byte):

- the reopen's side taken as the closing before it (no `null`), or the `REOPENED` records ignored;
- the 31-December rule dropped for the deposit kinds or the correction kinds;
- `null` compared as equal to every year (or `movedItems` left on `!==` of numbers only, the reopen missed);
- the deposit's closing taken as now for both sides;
- the deposit candidates widened to deposits not attributed (every view of the Realm flagged for a `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` deposit);
- the correction's "after" side keeping the original's splits (nothing flagged), or the sums taken per Transaction instead of per financial category and direction (a category or direction change missed);
- the correction's items without the replacement's splits (P2 not flagged);
- the shape guard's `null` check dropped (a `null` year accepted under `RECONCILIATION_CONFIRMED`);
- the Realm filter dropped from the deposit or the correction reads.

### Invariant suite (with the implementation)

§44's row **no silent move of a year** gains the deposit's reopen and closing; §58G's row **no silent move of a part** gains the correction.

### Open questions (decided)

1. **A reopen and the next closing: each alone, or as a pair.** **Decided (as proposed):** each record alone (§58E's rule, "each change is judged alone"), with "in no year" as a year `null` between them: a reopen after the year's end flags the year it leaves at once, even if the deposit is never closed again; a reopen by mistake and the same closing again are two entries (over-flagging only keeps a year open until acknowledged; §58E open question 5's reasoning, decided). **Alternative (not taken):** a pair: once closed again, the reopen and the next closing are one change keyed by the `CLOSED` record (the year before the reopen against the year after the closing, so the same closing again raises nothing and the year item never names `null` then); a reopen not followed by a closing stays a change with `yearAfter: null` until it is. Less noise, but an acknowledged reopen disappears when the deposit is closed again, and a same-year closing with another amount raises nothing.
2. **A first closing recorded after the year's end.** **Decided (as proposed):** flag it (`null` → `year`): DE does not know whether the return was filed without the retained amount, as for a reconciliation confirmed late in the normal course (§58E open question 5, decided). **Alternative (not taken):** a `CLOSED` record that is the deposit's first is not a change (only a closing after a reopen moves a year); less noise for the common case of a tenancy ending in December and settled in January.
3. **The year item names no source type.** **Decided (as proposed):** none: the kind tells (a deposit kind's items are deposits, every other year kind's are splits), so the year shape, its table and every stored acknowledgement's fingerprint stay as they are. **Alternative (not taken):** `sourceType` in every year item (`TRANSACTION_SPLIT`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSING`) and a `source_type` column in `tax_year_acknowledgement_item`, as the part shape has; clearer for a client, but the fingerprint of every year kind changes, so every stored acknowledgement re-opens once.
4. **The new year with a confirmed classification of the old closing.** Before VC-X-50 `NOT_COUNTED` (`CLOSING_CHANGED`) was informative (`tax-year-review.ts:14-46`, `:68-84`), so a deposit closed anew with another date or amount and an old `USER_CONFIRMED` classification is listed in `unclassified`, never summed, and holds nothing open. **Decided (as proposed):** make `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` (and §58C's `USE_CHANGED`, the same case for a use) an open item flag in §58C's review table, so the new year cannot be final until the deposit is classified anew; a schema-free change of `tax-year-review.ts` in this item. **Alternative (not taken):** leave it informative and only correct §58C's "As implemented" wording ("needing review"); the year's figures do not include the deposit either way, and the person sees it in `unclassified`.
5. **The flag for a correction.** **Decided (as proposed):** §58G's `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` with the kinds `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`: a correction moves figures between views (and out of a view), which is what the part shape records. **Alternative (not taken):** a code of its own, `LEDGER_CORRECTED_AFTER_YEAR_END`, with the part shape: a correction is a ledger act with its own reason and AuditRecord, not an attribution input, and a client could tell it apart by code.
6. **Which corrections are flagged.** **Decided (as proposed):** every correction or reversal recorded after the year's end that changes, for some financial category and direction, P's sum of the splits with tax year `year` (a split moved to another PropertyReference, the backlog's case, and equally an amount, category, direction or booking date across the year's edge; a description-only correction raises nothing). **Alternative (not taken):** only a correction that moves a split to another PropertyReference (the sets of PropertyReferences of the original's and the replacement's splits differ); the other corrections keep changing a closed year silently, to be taken by a later row.
7. **Order, migration and tests.** **Decided (as proposed):** after VC-X-49 (it widens the same CHECKs, and the deposit side of (b) relies on §58H's kinds), as a whole, with one migration; its own e2e test `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`; ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged (as decided for VC-X-48 and VC-X-49). **Alternative (not taken):** Part 1 (the deposit's year) first, on its own (it needs only 0060's tables and 0063's shape guard), Part 2 after VC-X-49.

**Decided by the owner on 2026-11-03 (chat)** (verbatim; cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-03“; for open questions 1–7 above at once):
„Alle 7 wie vorgeschlagen umsetzen“ (each proposal: (1) each record alone, "in no year" as a year `null`; (2) a first closing recorded after the year's end flagged; (3) no `sourceType` in the year item, the kind tells; (4) `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` and `USE_CHANGED` an open item flag, so the new year is not final until reclassified; (5) the corrections under `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`; (6) every correction or reversal after the year's end that changes the property's sums in the year flagged; (7) after VC-X-49 as a whole, one migration, its own e2e test `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`, ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged)

**Still open (owner):** none. Open questions 1–7 are decided (2026-11-03, above), each as proposed, so the body's proposals are the decisions and the alternatives are not taken.

### As implemented (VC-X-50)

Implemented as specified, with the owner's decisions of 2026-11-03 (questions 1–7, each as proposed; „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-03“): Part 1 and Part 2 together, after VC-X-49, with one migration. Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it. No route changed; `docs/development/api-inventory.md` is unchanged.

1. **Migration 0065** (`0065_tax_year_deposit_and_correction_movers`, the next free number on main after 0064): `tax_year_acknowledgement`'s `change_kind` gains `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSED`, `TRANSACTION_CORRECTED`, `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`, `change_entity_type` gains `SecurityDeposit`, `Transaction`, and `_kind_entity` binds `SecurityDeposit` to the two deposit kinds and `Transaction` to the two correction kinds (dropped and re-added under their names, as 0063 and 0064). `tax_year_acknowledgement_item.year_before`/`year_after` become nullable (0060's range CHECKs hold for a value), `_moved` becomes `year_before IS DISTINCT FROM year_after`, and `_some_year` (`num_nonnulls(year_before, year_after) >= 1`) is new. The shape guard (`tax_year_acknowledgement_item_shape`, replaced as in 0064): the deposit kinds take year items only, the correction kinds `TRANSACTION_SPLIT` part items only, and **a year item with a `null` year only under a deposit kind** (read from the acknowledgement's `change_kind`; the field of `NEW` read in a nested branch per table, as 0064). `tax_year_acknowledgement_part_item` is unchanged. `down` refuses while an acknowledgement of one of the four kinds or a year item with a `null` year exists, else restores `NOT NULL`, 0060's `_moved`, and 0064's CHECKs and guard (by running 0064's `up`, which drops and re-adds them by name). No column on `security_deposit`, `ledger_transaction`, `transaction_split`, `rent_payment_reconciliation` or `tax_classification`. The `down` tests of 0060, 0063 and 0064 roll 0065 back first, as the Migrator would.
2. **Part 1** (`domains/taxation/attribution-reopen.ts`, `depositClosingChanges`, `replayClosing`, `closingYear`): the deposit's closing replayed from its `SecurityDeposit` records in `(occurred_at, id)` order (`CLOSED` from its metadata, `REOPENED` clears it and must clear the closing it follows, `CREATED` only first, `VOIDED` with no closing, `AMENDED` leaves it); the end must be the row's status and closing now (`closing_date`, `closing_reason`, `held_at_closing`). A side's year is the closing date's year when the closing retains an amount (`RETAINED`, held > 0, as `retainedAmountOf`), else `null`. Each `CLOSED`/`REOPENED` record judged alone by §58E's rule with `movedItems`, which now compares `null` as a value of its own. The entry's keys `securityDepositId`, `mreTenantId`, `closingDate`, `reason` (the record's closing: the new one for `DEPOSIT_CLOSED`, the cleared one for `DEPOSIT_REOPENED`); items `{ sourceId, yearBefore, yearAfter }` with a year `null`. `ChangeItem`'s years are `number | null`; the fingerprint is §58E's, unchanged for every existing kind (tested byte for byte).
3. **Part 2** (`domains/taxation/attribution-corrections.ts`, `correctionSteps`, `splitPartOn`, `correctionRecordOf`): per corrected Transaction, its one record judged by the 31-December rule; P's part of each split whose tax year is `year` on the side it counts (the original's before, the replacement's after; `ATTRIBUTED` with its amount on P, a `LOAN_INTEREST` split by its Loan's `VALID` sets now with `partOn`, else `NONE`); flagged when, for some financial category and direction, the sum of P's attributed parts differs between the sides; the items every split whose part moved (`partMoved`). `partChanges` (`attribution-parts.ts`) adds the fingerprint (§58G's, unchanged). The entry's keys `transactionId`, `reversalTransactionId`, `replacementTransactionId` (`null` for `TRANSACTION_REVERSED`), `reason`. `partOn`, `partMoved` and the part states moved into `attribution-part-rule.ts` (re-exported unchanged from `attribution-parts.ts`), so the new module imports no value from `attribution-parts.ts` (the architecture test forbids a value-import cycle).
4. **The reads** (`infrastructure/postgres/mover-reads.ts`, in the view's and the command's snapshot): `depositClosingHistoriesOf` selects the Realm's deposits whose Tenant's `CONFIRMED` rent is booked on P, keeps those attributed to P now (`depositFactsOf`'s derivation: one PropertyReference, P's), and of those every one with a `CLOSED` record or `CLOSED` now, then their records by `audit_record_entity_idx` (`attributionInputOf` adds them as `deposits`). `correctionHistoriesOf` selects the Transactions with a split on P or of a Loan with a `VALID` set naming P, booked in `year`'s window or overridden to it, that are `CORRECTED` (the original) or a `REPLACEMENT` (its original found through it), then the originals, their reversal and replacement links, both Transactions' splits with their tax year by `meaningsOf` (§58A as the list derives it now), the Loans' sets, and the originals' `CORRECTED`/`REVERSED` records by `audit_record_entity_idx` (`partChangeInputOf` adds them as `corrections`; it takes the PropertyReference, the registry and `today` for it). `recordsOf` and `history` moved into `audit-history-reads.ts` (re-exported from `attribution-reads.ts`) for the same reason as item 3.
5. **In the view:** the item flag `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED` goes on a deposit item now in `year` for a deposit kind and on a split for every other kind (`isDepositYearKind`; the kind tells, question 3); `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`'s item flag now also goes on a listed split a correction moved. `ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` names `SecurityDeposit` and `Transaction`.
6. **`NOT_COUNTED`** (question 4): open in the review when `details.reason` is `CLOSING_CHANGED` (a deposit closed anew since its classification) or `details.notCountedReason` is `USE_CHANGED` (a WEG use changed since its classification), `notCountedIsOpen` in `tax-year-review.ts`; every other reason (a source that does not count: `NOT_CLOSED`, `NOTHING_RETAINED`, `USE_REMOVED`, `ASSESSMENT_VOID`, a split's Transaction status) stays informative. Schema-free. The full suite (ACC7 and ACC8 included) ran unchanged and green with it.
7. **The deposit under a correction** is §58H's, as the body says: a test on PostgreSQL pins that the release flags E in P1 (`DEPOSIT_RECONCILIATION_RELEASED`), the match of the replacement flags it in P2 (`DEPOSIT_RECONCILIATION_CONFIRMED`), and the correction's entry has split items only.
8. **The examples' numbers** are tested: (a) D 900.00, 600.00 repaid, closed 2027-12-20 with 300.00, reopened on 2028-02-12 (2027 → `null`, flagged in 2027), the 50.00 of 2028-01-10, closed again on 2028-02-14 with 2028-01-10 and 250.00 (not flagged in 2028; `null` → 2028 touches no side of 2027, acknowledging it in 2027 answers `409 CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED`); 2028 open through `NOT_COUNTED` until D is classified anew, then 250.00 in its line; both variants; (b) S1 950.00 on P1 corrected to S2 on P2 on 2028-03-02 (P1 `ATTRIBUTED` 950.00 → `NONE`, P2 `NONE` → `ATTRIBUTED` 950.00, P2 found through the replacement), the amount-only variant (S1 and S2), a description-only correction (nothing), a booking date 2026-06-15 → 2027-06-15 (2027 found through the replacement), a reversal, a chain, a Loan's interest split (3/5 of 100.00 → 3/5 of 120.00), a `taxYear` override.
9. **ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged** (decided): both run unchanged and green; neither shows a flag of the new kinds, and `NOT_COUNTED`'s new level changes neither. The examples run end to end in `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`.
10. **Tests:** `attribution-reopen.test.ts`, `attribution-corrections.test.ts` (pure: the examples, the 31-December rule, the histories, the fingerprints), `attribution-movers-view.test.ts` (the view: item and year flags, levels, `final`, figures, `NOT_COUNTED`'s levels), `tax-statement-movers-repository.test.ts` (both parts on PostgreSQL, the order of checks, idempotency, withdrawal, the items stored and audited with `null`, a deposit not attributed, the inconsistent histories, the deposit under a correction, Realm isolation past the Tenant id, "no cash mutated", the plans), `tax-statement-movers-schema.test.ts` (0065's CHECKs and guard with counter-checks, `up`/`down`), `api/tax-statements.test.ts` (the new kinds, a `null` year in the DTO), `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`. The mutations of "Counter-checks and mutations" each turn them red (the PR's table), except the Realm filter of a read that a second filter covers: the deposit select's (masked by `depositFactsOf`'s own Realm filter; both dropped turn the Realm isolation test red) and the correction select's (the splits on P are of P's Realm by the composite foreign key of 0008, so no other Realm's split can be selected).
11. **Release note:** like VC-X-28's, VC-X-48's and VC-X-49's kinds, the new kinds can reopen tax years previously shown as `final` on existing data, where a deposit was reopened or closed, or a Transaction corrected or reversed, after the year's end in a way that moved it; and `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` or `USE_CHANGED` now keeps a year from being final until the source is classified anew. Acknowledging each change in each view clears the former; a new classification clears the latter.

**Deviations from the body:**

1. **A deposit `CLOSED` now without a `CLOSED` record** is read too (the body's candidates have "at least one `CLOSED` record"), so the body's own test case "a `CLOSED` deposit without a record" is `ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` rather than unseen.
2. **Where an inconsistent history is named:** a deposit where its year now, or the year of a closing one of its records names, is `year`; a corrected Transaction where one of its splits is P's (`ATTRIBUTED` or `NOT_ATTRIBUTED`) in `year` on the side it counts. The body does not say where; naming it in every year of P would hold every year open for one broken record.
3. **The history of a correction** also requires the record's `reversalTransactionId` to equal the Transaction's reversal link, and a `REVERSED` record to have no replacement link (the body names the links in general).

# 58J. An Unattributed Deposit Closed Anew Since Its Classification (VC-X-51, implemented: no migration)

**Status:** implemented (VC-X-51, no migration; "As implemented (VC-X-51)" at the end of this section). **Open questions 1–4 decided by the owner on 2026-11-03** (chat; "Decided by the owner on 2026-11-03 (chat)" under "Open questions (decided)" at the end of this section): each as proposed (§58C's views unchanged; `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` counts it; the filter without `d.counts`, pinned by a repository test; a small PR of its own, no migration, its own e2e test, ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged). Backlog VC-X-51, created from the review of #259 (Claude Code, posted under the owner's account), 2026-11-03 (VC-X-50). **Migration: none** (a read-side change of the view; no table, CHECK or guard changes). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it. It amends §58C "Not attributed" (which deposits it lists) and the claim of §58I Part 1 that `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` holds the year of a deposit not attributed open; it builds on §58I open question 4 (decided 2026-11-03: `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` or `USE_CHANGED` is an open item flag), whose decision it does not change. Placement, signs, sums, the per-owner arithmetic, §58E's and §58G's flags and acknowledgements, the fingerprints, the 31-December rule and the rule for `final` are unchanged. **ACC7 and ACC8 stay unchanged; VC-X-51 has its own tests** (open question 4).

**The source** (the review of #259 (Claude Code, posted under the owner's account), 2026-11-03, on the PR's question 1; verbatim; a review, not an owner decision):

> **Nicht zugeordnete Kaution mit `CLOSING_CHANGED`:** Hier sehe ich eine echte Lücke.
> - `tax-year-view.ts` nimmt in `notAttributed` nur `d.counts`.
> - Eine neu abgeschlossene, nicht zugeordnete Kaution mit alter Klassifikation steht deshalb in keiner Liste. Frage 4 hält ihr Jahr nicht offen, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` ebenfalls nicht.
> - Ich würde sie wie die zugeordnete behandeln: in `notAttributed`, mit offenem `NOT_COUNTED`.
> - Das ist aber eine Erweiterung über die Spec hinaus. Ich würde dafür eine eigene Backlog-Zeile anlegen, statt sie in diesen PR zu ziehen. Nicht blockierend.

**Why a section of its own, after §58I:** VC-X-51 is a backlog item of its own (the review above: „eine eigene Backlog-Zeile … statt sie in diesen PR zu ziehen“). §58C and §58I kept their text until the implementation corrected it (below, "The text that changes"; applied by VC-X-51).

### As the code stands (main f4434b6, after VC-X-50, #259; paths relative to `services/de-backend/src/`)

- **The read** passes every deposit of the Realm closed in `year` that counts **by the deposit** (`CLOSED`, a retained amount > 0): `closedDepositsOf` (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-reads.ts:372-401`) selects the Realm's deposits (`:382`) with `status = 'CLOSED'` (`:383`) and `closing_date` in `year` (`:384-385`), keeps those with `depositNotCounted(f, null) === null` (`:395`, so `NOT_CLOSED` and `NOTHING_RETAINED` never reach the view), and derives each meaning **with its current classification** (`:396-400`). The view's read takes those without a PropertyReference as `unattributedDeposits` (`tax-year-reads.ts:149`).
- **The classification's closing:** with a classification of another closing date or amount the meaning has `counts: false` and `NOT_COUNTED` with `reason: 'CLOSING_CHANGED'` (`domains/taxation/deposit-closing.ts:79-82`, `:96-103`, `counts` at `:113`), and keeps the classification's `reviewState` and `treatment` (`:125-134`). So in `unattributedDeposits` a `counts: false` can only be `CLOSING_CHANGED`. `USE_CHANGED` is a WEG use's reason (`domains/taxation/weg-sources.ts:248-256`); a WEG source is read per PropertyReference (`tax-year-reads.ts:339`) and never reaches `notAttributed`, so for this section only `CLOSING_CHANGED` matters.
- **The view's filter:** `buildTaxYearView` lists a deposit not attributed only when `d.counts` (`domains/taxation/tax-year-view.ts:181-183`):

  ```ts
  const unattributed = read.unattributedDeposits.filter(
    (d) => d.counts && (d.propertyCandidates.length === 0 || d.propertyCandidates.includes(read.propertyReferenceId)),
  );
  ```

  The listed ones become `notAttributedDeposits` (`:198-201`, with §58H's part item flags), go into `notAttributed` (`:202-208`), into the cap (`:191`), into `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` (`:246`, `details.count` = their number) and into the review's items (`placed`, `:300-307`; `reviewOf`, `:328`).
- **The attributed case** has no such filter: a deposit with P's PropertyReference is an entry of P's list whatever `counts` says (`tax-year-reads.ts:349`), and the view places it in `unclassified` with its `NOT_COUNTED` (§58C "As implemented", decisions and deviations; §58I open question 4). `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED` is open there (`notCountedIsOpen`, `domains/taxation/tax-year-review.ts:67-70`; `flagIsOpen`, `:90`).
- **The gap:** a deposit **not attributed** (`NO_RECONCILED_RENT` or `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES`) closed anew since its confirmed classification is in **no list of any view** of its year: not in `notAttributed` (the filter), not in `unclassified` (it is no entry of any PropertyReference's list, `tax-year-reads.ts:349`). So neither §58I's decision 4 (its `NOT_COUNTED` is on no item) nor `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` (not counted in `:246`) holds the year open, and the year can be `final` with a retained amount nobody looked at. §58I Part 1's sentence "while it is in a year, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` holds that year open" (§58I, "Only deposits attributed to P are candidates") does not hold for this deposit.
- **The same deposit without any classification** counts (`depositNotCounted(facts, null)`, `deposit-closing.ts:96`, `counts` at `:113`) and **is** listed, with `NEEDS_REVIEW` and `UNCLASSIFIED` (`domains/taxation/tax-year-items.ts:237-241`) and `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS`. A stale classification hides what no classification shows.
- **The item builder is ready:** `notAttributedItem` (`tax-year-items.ts:211-245`) copies the meaning's flags (`:238`, so `NOT_COUNTED` with its `reason` comes along), adds `NEEDS_REVIEW`/`UNCLASSIFIED` from the review state and treatment (`:239-240`), sets `lineAmount: null` and `share: null` (`:224`, `:236`) and the reason, candidates and `href` (`:242`).
- **§58H's part changes already see the deposit:** `depositPartsOf` (`infrastructure/postgres/part-reads.ts:59-75`) filters by the deposit only (`:75`), so a reconciliation record after the year's end that moves such a deposit `ATTRIBUTED` → `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` (`depositPartOn`, `domains/taxation/attribution-deposits.ts:54-57`) raises `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` in the year flag today, while its item flag (`partItemFlags`, `domains/taxation/attribution-parts.ts:325-337`) finds no item to go on.
- **No test pins the gap:** no test of the view passes a `counts: false` deposit in `unattributedDeposits` (the cases at `domains/taxation/tax-year-view.test.ts:743`, `:761` all count).

### The rule

**A deposit closing of `year` without a PropertyReference that counts by the deposit is listed in `notAttributed`, whether or not its classification still fits its closing.** In code: the filter at `tax-year-view.ts:181-183` drops `d.counts &&` (open question 3), and nothing else changes:

- **Where it is listed** is §58C's rule, unchanged (open question 1): `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES` in the view of each candidate, `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` in the view of every PropertyReference of the Realm; at the owner level the same way, with `share` `null`. These are exactly the views that list it with no classification at all, and that list it again once it is classified anew; a stale classification only stops hiding it.
- **The item:** `notAttributedItem`'s, unchanged: `lineAmount` `null`, `counts`-independent; its flags `NO_PROPERTY_REFERENCE` (with `reason`, `candidates`), **`NOT_COUNTED` with `reason: 'CLOSING_CHANGED'` (open, §58I decision 4)**, and `NEEDS_REVIEW`/`UNCLASSIFIED` only from the stale classification's review state and treatment, as for the attributed case. Its `taxCategory`, `treatment`, `reviewState`, `origin` and `classificationId` are the stale classification's (shown, never summed).
- **`UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS`** counts it (open question 2): `details.count` is the number of entries of `notAttributed` that are deposits (`tax-year-view.ts:246`), unchanged as code.
- **Never summed:** a deposit in `notAttributed` is in no line, no section and no owner's figure (§58C); `lineAmount` stays `null`. **No figure of any view moves.**
- **The cap** (`tax-year-view.ts:191`) counts it, as every entry of `notAttributed` (§58C "As implemented": the count includes "the deposits not attributed").
- **`NOT_AN_OWNER_IN_YEAR`** is unchanged: it reads `derived` only (`tax-year-view.ts:189`), never `notAttributed`.
- **§58H's item flag** now lands on it: `notAttributedDeposits` adds `partItemFlags` to every listed deposit (`tax-year-view.ts:198-201`), so the case above (year flag without an item) gets its item.
- **Not a change here:** a deposit reopened and not closed again (`ACTIVE`, in no year; `closedDepositsOf` reads `CLOSED` only, `tax-year-reads.ts:383`); a deposit `RETURNED` or with nothing retained (filtered by the read, `:395`); the year a not-attributed deposit **leaves** by a reopen (no figure moved, §58I Part 1 "Only deposits attributed to P are candidates", decided; that year was not final through it, since `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` held it open while the deposit was in it); §55's per-property list and the deposit's `tax-meaning` read (unchanged; the meaning already says `counts: false` with `CLOSING_CHANGED`, `infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-deposit.test.ts:128-133`).
- **Why "listing" is not "flagging every view":** VC-X-49 names an inconsistent reconciliation only where the Tenant's deposit concerns P (§58H "As implemented" 4; `attribution-deposits.ts:80-89`) and §58G open question 3 keeps `NOT_ATTRIBUTED` ↔ `NONE` silent, so a deposit not attributed raises no **change** flag in every view of the Realm. §58J adds no change flag and no history read: it lists a deposit in the views §58C already lists it in when it has no classification. A `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` deposit holds every view of the Realm open today too, as long as it has no classification or a fitting one; §58J only removes the exception for a stale one.

### Example (synthetic)

P1 owned by A `"1/1"`, P2 owned by B `"1/1"`, P3 owned by C `"1/1"`, one Realm. Tenant T's rent is booked and reconciled on P1 and on P2 (a booking error never corrected), so T's deposit D is `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES` with `candidates` [P1, P2]. D held 900.00; 600.00 is repaid on 2027-12-15, D is closed on **2027-12-20** `RETAINED`, `heldAtClosing` 300.00, retained **300.00**, classified `RETAINED_DEPOSIT_DAMAGES` / `INCOME` (`USER_CONFIRMED`).

- **2027, before anything else:** D is in `notAttributed` of P1's and P2's 2027 views (not P3's), never summed; `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` `{ count: 1 }` holds both years open.
- **On 2028-02-12** D is reopened; **on 2028-02-14** a repayment of 50.00 booked on 2028-01-10 is linked and D is closed again with `closingDate` **2028-01-10**, `heldAtClosing` 250.00: retained **250.00**, tax year **2028**. The classification still names 2027-12-20 and 300.00.
- **2027 after the reopen:** D is in no list of 2027 (`ACTIVE`, then closed in 2028). No flag of §58I Part 1 (not attributed, decided). P1's and P2's 2027 lose `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` through D; no figure moved (D was never summed).
- **2028, today (main f4434b6):** D has `counts: false` (`CLOSING_CHANGED`), so the filter drops it: **D is in no list of P1's, P2's or P3's 2028 view**, no `NOT_COUNTED` and no `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` through D; with nothing else open, P1's and P2's 2028 are `final: true`.
- **2028 under §58J:** D is in `notAttributed` of P1's and P2's 2028 views (not P3's) with `amount` 250.00, `lineAmount` `null`, `taxCategory` `RETAINED_DEPOSIT_DAMAGES`, `reviewState` `USER_CONFIRMED`, `classificationId` the old one, flags `NO_PROPERTY_REFERENCE` (`SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES`, [P1, P2]) and `NOT_COUNTED` (`depositStatus` `CLOSED`, `retainedAmount` 250.00, `reason` `CLOSING_CHANGED`), both views with `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` `{ count: 1 }`. `review.open` names `NOT_COUNTED` 1 and `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` 1; **2028 is not final** in both. Every figure of both views (lines, sections, result, owners) is the same as today.
- **Classified anew** (superseding the old one, 2028-01-10 and 250.00, `USER_CONFIRMED`): `counts: true`; D stays in both `notAttributed` lists, `NOT_COUNTED` goes, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` stays (the deposit still has no PropertyReference, §58C); figures unchanged.
- **Variant, `NO_RECONCILED_RENT`:** had T no reconciled rent, D would be listed in P1's, P2's and P3's 2028 views (every view of the Realm, §58C open question 4), as it is today with no classification at all.
- **Variant, the same closing again** (a reopen by mistake, closed again with 2027-12-20 and 300.00): the classification fits again, `counts: true`, D is listed as today; nothing of §58J applies.

### The effect on `final`, ACC7 and ACC8

- **The rule for `final` stays §58C's.** A year with such a deposit is no longer final: `NOT_COUNTED` (`CLOSING_CHANGED`) is open until it is classified anew, and `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` stays open as for every deposit not attributed. This can turn a `final: true` of today into `false` after deployment on existing data where a deposit not attributed was closed anew after its classification (the intended correction; a release note as VC-X-50's "As implemented" 11).
- **No acknowledgement** clears it: neither flag is a change flag of §58E; the person classifies the deposit anew (`NOT_COUNTED`) and links it to one PropertyReference (`UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS`, §58A's later option).
- **ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged** (open question 4's proposal): neither has a deposit not attributed closed anew after its classification. Both run unchanged; **a new `NOT_COUNTED` or `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` there is a finding to report and explain, not to suppress.**

### Routes, database, errors

- **No route changes;** `docs/development/api-inventory.md` is unchanged. The item DTO is §58C's for an entry of `notAttributed` (`reason`, `candidates`, `href`), unchanged.
- **No migration:** nothing is stored; the view is derived on every read (§58C). No CHECK, guard or column changes.
- **No new error answer.**

### The code that changes (pointers)

- **`domains/taxation/tax-year-view.ts:181-183`:** the filter without `d.counts` (open question 3), and the comment at `:180` naming the stale case.
- **No change:** `tax-year-reads.ts` (it already passes the deposit), `deposit-closing.ts`, `tax-year-items.ts`, `tax-year-review.ts`, `attribution-*.ts`, the migrations, `api-inventory.md`.

### Tests the implementation needs

- **Domain (pure), in a new file** `domains/taxation/tax-year-unattributed-stale.test.ts` (`tax-year-view.test.ts` has 863 lines of the 900 allowed): the example's 2028 at the property level for P1, P2 and P3 (listed in P1 and P2 with `NOT_COUNTED` `CLOSING_CHANGED` open, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` `{ count: 1 }`, `final: false`; not in P3) and at the owner level (`share` `null`, the owner's figures unchanged); the `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` variant (every view); classified anew (`NOT_COUNTED` gone, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` stays); **unchanged money sums**: every line, section, `result`, `owners` and `notOwned` equal to the view without D (the deposit only in `notAttributed`); the cap counting D (a read at the limit with D answers `TAX_YEAR_TOO_LARGE`, without D a view); `NOT_AN_OWNER_IN_YEAR` unchanged with D; a §58H part change of D after the year's end with its item flag on D's `notAttributed` entry; counter-check: an attributed deposit with `CLOSING_CHANGED` stays in `unclassified`, not in `notAttributed`.
- **Repository (PostgreSQL),** in `infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-deposit.test.ts` (344 lines) or a new file: D of the example through the real read (`closedDepositsOf` passes it, the view lists it in P1's and P2's 2028, not P3's); D reopened and not closed again (in no view); a deposit closed with nothing retained (in no view, the read's filter); **Realm isolation**: another Realm's deposit not attributed and closed anew is in none of this Realm's views; **history**: the reopen, the closing and the classification leave their AuditRecords as today (`REOPENED`, `CLOSED`, the classification's `CREATED`/`SUPERSEDED`), and reading the view writes no AuditRecord; "no cash mutated" around every view.
- **End to end:** a case in a new `tax-year-unattributed-deposit.e2e.test.ts` (or in `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts`, 408 lines; open question 4): the example through the HTTP API, 2028 not final in P1 and P2 until D is classified anew, P3 unaffected. ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged.

### Counter-checks and mutations

**Counter-checks:** no deposit of `year` that counts by the deposit in no list of any view; no figure changed by listing it; no view outside §58C's set (P3 above) lists it; nothing written by a view.

**Mutations** that must turn the tests red (each applied alone, restored byte for byte):

- `d.counts &&` restored in the filter (`tax-year-view.ts:182`; D in no view);
- the candidate condition dropped (D listed in P3's view);
- `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` counting only the deposits with `counts` (under open question 2's proposal);
- `notCountedIsOpen` returning `false` for `CLOSING_CHANGED` (2028 final again; §58I's mutation, now also caught here);
- `lineAmount` of the entry taken as `amount` or D summed into `RETAINED_DEPOSIT_DAMAGES` (the money sums change);
- the Realm filter dropped from `closedDepositsOf` (`tax-year-reads.ts:382`; another Realm's D listed).

### The text that changes with the implementation

- **§58C "Not attributed":** "What" becomes "a deposit closing of `year` whose PropertyReference is `null` and that counts by the deposit (`CLOSED`, a retained amount > 0), its classification fitting or not (`NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED`, open)"; §58C "As implemented"'s deviation on "a list item that does not count" names `notAttributed` beside `unclassified`.
- **§58I Part 1, "Only deposits attributed to P are candidates":** "while it is in a year, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` holds that year open" gains "(since VC-X-51 also with a classification of an earlier closing)".
- **The invariant suite** (`docs/development/invariant-suite.md:866`, the row **"Nicht zugeordnet"**): "a retained deposit without one PropertyReference listed" gains "also with a classification of an earlier closing (`NOT_COUNTED`, `CLOSING_CHANGED`, open)".

### Open questions (decided)

1. **Which views list it.** **Decided (as proposed):** §58C's rule, unchanged: each candidate's view for `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES`, every view of the Realm for `NO_RECONCILED_RENT`, exactly as with no classification and after a new one; no new rule, and the stale classification no longer decides where it appears. **Alternative (not taken):** narrow a `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` deposit to the views that concern it (the PropertyReferences of its Tenant's released reconciliations' rent splits, as VC-X-49 names an inconsistency only where the deposit concerns P), every view only when there are none; less noise in a large Realm, but a new rule that differs from the unclassified and the newly classified deposit's, and needs a read of the released reconciliations in the view.
2. **`UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` counts it.** **Decided (as proposed):** yes; it is an entry of `notAttributed` like any other, and the flag's count stays "the deposits in `notAttributed`" (`tax-year-view.ts:246`, no code change). **Alternative (not taken):** count only the deposits with `counts: true` and let the open `NOT_COUNTED` alone hold the year open; then `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` appears only after the new classification, which reads as a new finding although the deposit did not change.
3. **How the filter is written.** **Decided (as proposed):** drop `d.counts &&` (the read passes only closings that count by the deposit, `tax-year-reads.ts:395`, so a `counts: false` there can only be `CLOSING_CHANGED`), and pin that in a repository test (a reopened and a nothing-retained deposit never reach `unattributedDeposits`). **Alternative (not taken):** keep a guard in the view, `d.counts || notCountedIsOpen(…)` on the meaning's `NOT_COUNTED` details, so that a future read passing other non-counting deposits does not list them silently; one more condition to keep in step with §58I decision 4.
4. **Order and tests.** **Decided (as proposed):** a small PR of its own after VC-X-50 (now on main), no migration; the pure tests in a new file, the PostgreSQL case beside `tax-year-deposit.test.ts`, its own e2e file `tax-year-unattributed-deposit.e2e.test.ts`; ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged. **Alternative (not taken):** the e2e case added to `tax-year-deposit-movers.e2e.test.ts` (VC-X-50's, 408 lines), which already builds a deposit closed anew; one file fewer, but it mixes VC-X-50's change flags with a listing rule.

**Decided by the owner on 2026-11-03 (chat)** (verbatim; cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-03“; for open questions 1–4 above at once):
„Alle vier: wie vorgeschlagen, hiermit bestätigt.“ (each proposal: (1) the views per §58C's rule unchanged, as with no classification: each candidate's view for `SEVERAL_PROPERTY_REFERENCES`, every view of the Realm for `NO_RECONCILED_RENT`; (2) `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` counts it, like any entry of `notAttributed`; (3) `d.counts &&` dropped, a repository test pinning that the read passes only `CLOSING_CHANGED` as `counts: false`; (4) a small PR of its own, no migration, its own e2e test `tax-year-unattributed-deposit.e2e.test.ts`, ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged)

**Still open (owner):** none. Open questions 1–4 are decided (2026-11-03, above), each as proposed, so the body's proposals are the decisions and the alternatives are not taken.

### As implemented (VC-X-51)

Implemented as specified, with the owner's decisions of 2026-11-03 (questions 1–4, each as proposed; „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-03“). **No migration**; no table, CHECK, guard or route changed; `docs/development/api-inventory.md` is unchanged. Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it.

1. **The filter** (`domains/taxation/tax-year-view.ts`, `buildTaxYearView`): `d.counts &&` dropped (question 3); a deposit of `unattributedDeposits` is listed by §58C's candidate condition alone (question 1). The comment there and the doc comment of `TaxYearRead.unattributedDeposits` name the stale case. Nothing else changed: `tax-year-reads.ts`, `deposit-closing.ts`, `tax-year-items.ts`, `tax-year-review.ts` and `attribution-*.ts` are as before.
2. **The item** is `notAttributedItem`'s, unchanged: `lineAmount` `null`, `share` `null`, the stale classification's `taxCategory`, `treatment`, `reviewState`, `origin` and `classificationId` shown, the meaning's flags with `NOT_COUNTED` (`CLOSING_CHANGED`, open by `notCountedIsOpen`) and `NO_PROPERTY_REFERENCE`. `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` counts it (question 2, no code change), the cap counts it, `NOT_AN_OWNER_IN_YEAR` does not read it, and §58H's item flag `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` now lands on its entry (the case of "As the code stands" with a year flag and no item).
3. **The read's pin** (question 3): a test on PostgreSQL shows that every `counts: false` deposit in `unattributedDeposits` carries `NOT_COUNTED` with `CLOSING_CHANGED`, and that a deposit reopened and not closed again and a deposit closed with nothing retained never reach it (and are in no view).
4. **The example's numbers** are tested at both levels: D (900.00, 600.00 repaid, closed 2027-12-20 with 300.00, classified, reopened, the 50.00 of 2028-01-10, closed anew with 2028-01-10 and 250.00) in `notAttributed` of P1's and P2's 2028 (not P3's) with `amount` 250.00, `lineAmount` `null`, the old `classificationId`, `NOT_COUNTED` and `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` `{ count: 1 }` open, 2028 not final; every figure equal to the view without D; in no list of 2027 after the reopen; classified anew, `NOT_COUNTED` goes and `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` stays (so 2028 stays not final until D is linked to one PropertyReference, as the body's example says); the `NO_RECONCILED_RENT` variant in every view of the Realm; an attributed deposit with `CLOSING_CHANGED` still in `unclassified` (counter-check).
5. **ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged** (question 4): both ran unchanged and green in the full suite; neither has a deposit not attributed closed anew after its classification, so neither shows a new `NOT_COUNTED` or `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS`.
6. **Tests:** `domains/taxation/tax-year-unattributed-stale.test.ts` (pure: the example at both levels, the variants, classified anew, the money sums, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS`, the cap, `NOT_AN_OWNER_IN_YEAR`, §58H's item flag, the attributed counter-check), `tax-year-unattributed-repository.test.ts` (PostgreSQL: the example through the real read and view, the read's pin, Realm isolation with another Realm's deposit closed anew and each deposit query of the read scoped to the Realm, the AuditRecords of the reopen, the closings and the classifications, no AuditRecord and no row written by a view), `tax-year-unattributed-deposit.e2e.test.ts` (the example through the HTTP API, P3 unaffected, Realm isolation, "no cash mutated"). Each mutation of the body's list turns them red (the PR lists them).
7. **Release note:** a tax year previously shown as `final` can show `final: false` after deployment where a deposit without a PropertyReference was closed anew after its classification (`NOT_COUNTED` open until it is classified anew, `UNATTRIBUTED_ITEMS` open while it has no PropertyReference); no figure moves.

**Deviations from the body:**

The repository test therefore also pins that each of the read's deposit queries carries the Realm (that mutation alone turns it red); dropping both filters turns the Realm isolation test and the e2e test red.
