# 58M. Maintenance Paid from the Hausgeld in the Anschaffungsnahe Check (VC-X-27, implemented: migration 0068)

**Status:** **implemented** (VC-X-27, migration 0068, PR #269, not merged; below, "As implemented (VC-X-27)"); specified and decided 2026-11-04. **Open questions 1–11 decided by the owner on 2026-11-04** (chat; "Decided by the owner on 2026-11-04 (chat)" under "Open questions (decided)" at the end of this section; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04): each as proposed except open question 3, where the **alternative** is taken (the statements read up to the search range's end, W + 365 days; a later-recorded line with performance in the window lands in `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`), and open question 7, decided symmetric but over question 3's range (`WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` for every financial year overlapping S to W + 365 days, so the check becomes final about five years after the transfer, not seven). The rule, the examples, the tests and the mutations below are rewritten to these decisions. **Order (decided):** §58K (VC-X-34) first, which takes 0066; then §58M (VC-X-27); then §58L (VC-X-40); each migration takes the next free number at implementation. Backlog VC-X-27 (§58B open question 12, review on #167; §58C decision 5: „not in VC-7-04; the view shows the check's `NOT_FINAL`. Follow-up: backlog VC-X-27“). **Answered by the tax review of 2026-11-01** (`docs/germany/pruefbericht-2026-11-01.md`, question 16; checklist A2b; mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01): „anteilige Maßnahmen am Gemeinschaftseigentum zählen mit; Rücklagenzuführung kein Aufwand (BFH IX R 19/24); Zeitpunkt die erbrachte Bauleistung; ohne Leistungsdaten manuelle Prüfung“. The date follows VC-X-38 (§59F). The report recommends VC-X-27 **before enablement** („Empfohlen vor der Freischaltung“); the owner placed it in **stage 2** (§59G "Stage 3, not a prerequisite of stage 1", the decision of 2026-11-01) and named it a prerequisite of the release of stage 2 (236-5, §60A) and of the go-live of the first productive installation (the Phase-7 freeze point, §59F). **Migration: the next free number at implementation** (by the decided order after §58K's 0066 and before §58L's; Kysely's Migrator refuses a migration whose name sorts before one already applied). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it.

**What it amends:**
- §58B "The anschaffungsnahe check" ("Not summed, and said so: maintenance paid from the Hausgeld", `final`'s reason `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED`), §58B "Never counted twice" („No route of this section reads `weg_statement_cost_line`“) and §58B open question 12 (its proposal "dated at the end of the statement's period (or pro rata by days in the window)" is replaced: the tax review dates by the work performed);
- §58C decision 5 and §58C "Maintenance paid from the Hausgeld (§58B open question 12) is not picked up here": unchanged in substance (the view never adds a cost line), the check now counts them;
- §59F "Not in VC-X-38" ("Maintenance paid from the Hausgeld (question 16): VC-X-27 … until then `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` stays"): a cost line takes §59F's performance;
- the WEG statement model, §50 (VC-6-03, migration 0042; data-model §31): a cost line becomes a source of the check through a classification of its own; the statement, its lines and §51's ledger effects are unchanged;
- §60A "VC-X-27 (maintenance paid from the Hausgeld) is covered by A1": the flag narrows (below), A1 is unchanged.

**Unchanged guarantees:**
- **Never a source of the view.** A cost line is never added to any figure, line, subtotal, `result`, owner part or item of the tax-year view, nor to the per-property list (§58B "Never counted twice": the Hausgeld paid, `WEG_HAUSGELD`, already holds it). Every money sum of every view is unchanged.
- The check stores nothing and changes no classification (§58B); its window, threshold, exact comparison, basis (§59A, §59D), the order of checks of `GET /acquisitions/{id}/anschaffungsnahe-herstellungskosten` (`400` → `404` → `409 ACQUISITION_CANCELLED` → `200`) and Realm isolation are unchanged.
- §59F's rules are unchanged and apply to a cost line as to any source: never the booking, payment, statement or period date as the date of the work; bounds, never estimated; no spread by calendar days; estimated points ignored (239-1); the search range never establishes completeness.
- VC-X-38 Part 2's partial treatment stays across the window's end only and refused across the start (`STRADDLES_START`, §59F "As implemented (VC-X-38 Part 2)" 3, 4); a cost line is never capitalised on the check (below), so neither applies to it.
- The reserve stays as §58B decides: a contribution is never Aufwand (question 16, BFH IX R 19/24), a withdrawal or use counts when spent (`WEG_RESERVE_WITHDRAWAL`, `WEG_ASSESSMENT_USE`), once.
- `DE_CATEGORY_DEFAULTS@1`, `DE_WEG_SPENDING@1`, `DE_82B_DISTRIBUTION@1`, `DE_CASH_TIMING@1` and the AfA rules are not changed.

**Why a section of its own, after §58L:** VC-X-27 is a backlog item of its own and a Phase-7 change (the check of §58B); §58B, §58C and §59F keep their text until the implementation corrects it (below, "The text that changes").

### As the code stands (main 59bfa6d, after #263; paths relative to `services/de-backend/src/`)

- **Where the flag is raised:** `checkAnschaffungsnahe` takes `statements` as `{ id, periodFrom, periodUntil }[]` (`domains/taxation/anschaffungsnahe.ts:251`), keeps those whose period overlaps the window (`:361-367`), pushes the `NOT_FINAL` reason `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` (`:372`) and the check flag `{ code, details: { statementIds } }` (`:441`); the types at `:93` and `:145`. Without a window (no rule) no statement is named (`:362`). No line, amount or date of a statement reaches the check.
- **Which statements:** `wegContextOf` reads every statement of the PropertyReference's memberships with its period and reserve (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-property-context.ts:75-91`) and hands the check those with `status = 'CONFIRMED'` (`:160-162`, `confirmedStatements`, typed at `:43-44`). `CONFIRMED` is the current one (a corrected statement is `SUPERSEDED`, at most one `CONFIRMED` per membership and year, 0042's partial unique index). The file's header says it reads "never a statement's cost lines" (`:36`). `effectsOf` passes them to `checksOf` (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-treatment-effects.ts:75`, `:109-113`; `tax-property-context.ts:320-328`).
- **How cost lines are stored:** `weg_statement_cost_line` (`infrastructure/postgres/migrations/0042_weg_annual_statement.ts:116-134`): `position` (unique per statement, `:131`), `account`, `cost_group` (`RECOVERABLE` | `NON_RECOVERABLE`, `:122`), `allocation_key`, `allocation_total`/`allocation_share` (`numeric(15,3)`, `:124-125`), `total_amount` and **`unit_share`** (signed Money, `:126-127`), `classification` (`RECOVERABLE` | `NON_RECOVERABLE` | `RESERVE`, `:129`) with `classification_source` (`:130`). **There is no maintenance category and no date of the work on a line:** nothing tells a repair of the common property from the administrator's fee, and the statement's period is the WEG's accounting period, not the performance. Lines change only while the statement is `DRAFT` (`weg_statement_cost_line_frozen`, `:50-51` of the header). The repository reads them only for the statement's own reads (`infrastructure/postgres/weg-statement-rows.ts:143`).
- **The unit's share:** the printed `unit_share` per line; `LINE_SHARE_DIFFERS` flags a printed share that differs from `totalAmount × allocationShare / allocationTotal` by more than a cent, informative (§50; the printed statement wins, BR-WEG-006). The membership's MEA (`m.mea_numerator`/`m.mea_denominator`, `tax-property-context.ts:63-64`) is used for the reserve's unit share, not for cost lines.
- **How the check sums its sources:** the sources (splits, withdrawals, uses) are sorted into `summed` (with performance overlapping the window, by `partInWindow`), `undetermined` (undated, own date in the search range: `lower` 0, `upper` the amount), `outsideSearchRange`, `excluded` and `unclassified` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:277-306`); `sum` and `sumUpper` are the bounds' sums (`:307-309`); the outcome by the bounds (`:345-359`); `final` is "no `NOT_FINAL` reason" (`:368-378`). A source's amount is `netAmount`, else the gross amount, signed (`:272-275`).
- **How VC-X-38's performance works:** a classification carries `performance` (`from`, `until`, up to five evidenced cumulative points, `progressEstimated`); `partInWindow` (`domains/taxation/performance.ts:85-104`) derives the part in the window as bounds, ignoring estimated points; the plausibility (`:61-70`) bounds the period to `plausibleYearsFromSourceDate` around the source's own date; `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` with `edge` `START`/`END` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:394-399`). The parameters are `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1`'s `performance` (`domains/taxation/rules/de-anschaffungsnahe.ts:105-126`), pinned in `infrastructure/hashing/frozen-rules.test.ts:70` (`d4e797c4…9f45`).
- **What can be classified:** `SOURCE_TYPES` = `TRANSACTION_SPLIT`, `WEG_RESERVE_WITHDRAWAL`, `WEG_ASSESSMENT_USE`, `DEPOSIT_CLOSING` (`domains/taxation/vocabulary.ts:73`); a withdrawal is `weg_annual_statement_id` + `weg_reserve_position`, the two set together (`migrations/0047_tax_weg_spending.ts:31`, `:56`). A cost line has no classification.
- **The release stage:** `purchaseChecksIn` reads the flag as `wegHausgeldMaintenanceNotCounted` and the summed sources' treatments (`infrastructure/postgres/depreciation-purchase-checks.ts:26`, `:28`); `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_OPEN` follows (`domains/depreciation/recording-stage.ts:75`; 236-4 for an `ABOVE_THRESHOLD` with a `DEDUCTIBLE` summed source).
- **In the view:** `buildTaxYearView` lists the check and its `notFinalReasons` and raises `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` (`domains/taxation/tax-year-view.ts:255-270`); the view never reads a statement's lines.
- **Tests that pin today's behaviour:** `domains/taxation/weg-spending.test.ts:566-576` (the flag with a statement overlapping the window, not with one of 2025 before it); ACC7 (`phase-7-acceptance.e2e.test.ts:422-455`: the statement of 2027 with `Hausmeister` `RECOVERABLE` 1,800.00 and `Verwaltervergütung` `NON_RECOVERABLE` 1,200.00; `:586-588`: `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` among the reasons). ACC8 files no annual statement (`phase-8-acceptance.e2e.test.ts`: a special assessment only).
- **Size:** `anschaffungsnahe.ts` has 540 lines (limit 600): the cost-line part goes into a file of its own (`anschaffungsnahe-hausgeld.ts`), as §58K notes for its own change.

### The rule

**A maintenance cost line of a `CONFIRMED` statement is a source of the check, and only of the check, once a person has classified it as maintenance; it is dated by its performance (§59F), never by the statement; a line not yet judged keeps `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` open.** In detail:

- **The judgement of a line (open question 1):** a new source type **`WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE`** of `POST /api/v1/tax-classifications` (`sourceId` the statement, `sourcePosition` the line's `position`). It is a check-only fact, as `netAmount` and `performance` are: the line's `taxCategory` is
  - **`MAINTENANCE`** with `treatment` **`DEDUCTIBLE`**: Erhaltungsaufwand on the common property paid from the Hausgeld (question 16). It may carry `netAmount`, `annuallyRecurring` and `performance` (§59F, with its evidence rules: points need a source reference, e.g. the administrator's statement of the work);
  - **`NOT_RELEVANT`** with `NOT_RELEVANT`: **not maintenance for the 15 % check** (the administrator's fee, bank charges, insurance). It says nothing about the deductibility of the Hausgeld, which `WEG_HAUSGELD` decides as before.
  - Refused (`400 NOT_ALLOWED_WITH_TREATMENT`): every other category or treatment, `CAPITALIZED` and `anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId` (open question 6), `partialTreatment`, `distributionYears`/`DISTRIBUTED_82B` (the Hausgeld is deducted when paid), `taxYear`, `refundOfYear`.
  - **Which lines (open question 2):** only lines whose stored `classification` is `NON_RECOVERABLE` and whose `unitShare` ≠ 0.00. A `RECOVERABLE` line is a Betriebskosten line, and Betriebskosten exclude Instandhaltung and Instandsetzung by law (§ 1 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 BetrKV); a `RESERVE` line is a contribution, never Aufwand (question 16). Another line → `422 SOURCE_NOT_COUNTED` with `notCountedReason` `COST_LINE_NOT_NON_RECOVERABLE`.
  - **Which statements:** a `CONFIRMED` statement of a membership of the source's PropertyReference (`DRAFT`, `VOID` → `422 SOURCE_NOT_COUNTED`, `STATEMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED`). A `SUPERSEDED` statement's classifications stay readable but are never read by the check; the successor's lines start unjudged (open question 11).
  - The classification stores the line's `unitShare` as classified (as a withdrawal stores its unit share), and the guard requires it equal to the line's (below, "Database").
  - The default of a line without a current classification is **none**: it is not a source and not `UNCLASSIFIED`; it is an **unjudged line** (below). DE never guesses from the account's name.
- **The statements the check reads (open question 3, decided: the alternative):** the `CONFIRMED` statements of the PropertyReference's memberships whose period overlaps **[S, W + 365 days]** (S the window's start, W its end; the end of §59F's search range), the **read range**. WEG statements are periodic and complete per financial year, and the line's performance decides the window anyway; §59F's outer bound of three years is meant for cash sources whose payment can be delayed, and an administrator pays tradespeople within weeks. The statement's period is never the work's date. A statement whose period ends before S is not read: the Hausgeld of the time before the transfer was not the buyer's.
- **A later statement** (`CONFIRMED`, its period wholly after W + 365 days, overlapping the outer bound, `plausibleYearsFromSourceDate` after W): its lines are not read for the sum, for unjudged lines or for missing years; but a line of it classified `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE` whose performance overlaps the window is **listed in `outsideSearchRange`**, not summed, with the `NOT_FINAL` reason **`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`** (§59F: the check is then never `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` by the upper bound, but `NOT_COMPUTABLE` with that reason). So a later-recorded line with performance in the window lands in `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`, not in nothing (the owner's decision on question 3; example (a″)). Its other lines (undated, `NOT_RELEVANT`, unjudged, performed outside the window) are not listed; a statement beyond the outer bound is not read.
- **A line as a source** (the five lists of §59F, unchanged):
  - **amount:** the printed `unitShare` (open question 4), signed (a credit line is negative and swaps the bounds as a refund does); `amountUsed` its `netAmount` when given, else the gross with `VAT_NOT_SEPARATED` and `GROSS_AMOUNTS` as for every source; × `acquiredShare` as every source (§58B);
  - **with `performance`:** its part in the window by `partInWindow`, exactly as a split; performed wholly outside → `excluded`, `PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW`; across the window's end without a point at W → bounds, `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` `END`; across the transfer date → only the evidenced part from S counts, `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` `START` (the check's sum, §59F; there is no capitalisation, so VC-X-38 Part 2's refusal is not reached);
  - **without `performance` ("ohne Leistungsdaten manuelle Prüfung", open question 5):** `undetermined` (`lower` 0, `upper` the amount, `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`); every statement read overlaps the search range (above), so an undated line of it is never in `outsideSearchRange`, and an undated line of a later statement is not read. So an undated line can never decide the check: above by the lower bound needs no undated line, not above by the upper bound counts it whole, and in between the check is `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`), the manual review the answer asks for;
  - **`annuallyRecurring`** (e.g. a maintenance contract booked as a cost line) → `excluded`, `ANNUALLY_RECURRING`;
  - **plausibility:** the performance's period lies within `plausibleYearsFromSourceDate` of the statement's `periodUntil` (the line's own date, `dateSource` **`STATEMENT_PERIOD_END`**, shown, never the work's date); a point's amount is below the amount used (`PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT`), as §59F.
  - **The entry** (§58B's shape): `sourceType` `WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE`, `sourceId` the statement, `sourcePosition` the line, `date` the period's end, `taxYear` the year of `periodFrom` (where the Hausgeld holding it began to be paid; shown and used only for 236-4's "from" year, never for `affectedYears`), plus **`statementPeriod: { from, until }`** and **`account`** (as printed), present on such entries only.
- **`WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` narrows** to what it now means: **an unjudged line** (`NON_RECOVERABLE`, `unitShare` ≠ 0.00, no current classification) of a statement read by the check. Details gain `lines: [{ statementId, position, account, unitShare }]` (`statementIds` stays: the statements holding them, sorted). It stays a `NOT_FINAL` reason; it holds the check open whatever its outcome, never makes it `NOT_COMPUTABLE`, and adds nothing to `sum` or `sumUpper` (as 239-8's unclassified source beyond the search range). Once every such line is judged, it is cleared.
- **Above 15 % with a cost line among the summed** (open question 6): the outcome stands (`ABOVE_THRESHOLD`); the cost-line entry carries `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` with `details: { acquisitionId, final, rule, paidFromHausgeld: true }` and **no suggestion** (`suggestedTreatment` `null`): the share is in the Hausgeld the view deducts as `WEG_HAUSGELD`, and DE has no classification that would take it out. The check gains the `NOT_FINAL` reason **`HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`** (details on the flag `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAH`: `{ lines: [{ statementId, position, inWindow }] }`, open): a manual review (the advisor) of the Hausgeld deducted. `affectedYears` lists only the suggested sources, as today. The other summed sources are suggested `CAPITALIZED` as today.
- **A statement not yet confirmed** (open question 7, decided: symmetric, over question 3's range): the check gains the `NOT_FINAL` reason **`WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING`** (flag details `{ missing: [{ membershipId, financialYear }] }`) for each financial year of a membership of the PropertyReference that overlaps **the read range, S to W + 365 days** (question 3), and the membership's period, but has no `CONFIRMED` statement: the year's Hausgeld may hold repairs no one has judged yet, among them work performed in the window and paid by the WEG after it. The two ranges are one parameter (`statementsUntil`), so a statement that would be read never goes missing silently. A year that has not ended yet counts as missing too (its statement cannot exist), so the check can be final only once every year of the range has its `CONFIRMED` statement and every line is judged: about five years after the transfer (the window's three years, the year W + 365 days falls in, and its statement), not seven. The asymmetric variant (only the years of [S, W] required) is not taken: a „final“ that the next statement reopens is no final for the AfA basis. A later statement (above) is not required; only a line of it judged as performed in the window reopens the check, visibly, through `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` (question 3).
- **No change outside the check:** the view's figures, items and lists; `WEG_HAUSGELD` and its § 11 EStG year; §51's comparison and settlement; the reserve's sources.

### Examples (synthetic)

PropertyReference P (a unit), owned by A `"1/1"`, member of a WEG from 2026-03-15 (MEA 50/1000). Acquisition Q: `economicTransferDate` **2026-03-15**, basis 198,000.00 (§58B's example): window 2026-03-15 – 2029-03-15, threshold **29,700.00**, search range 2025-12-15 – 2030-03-15, so the statements' read range is 2026-03-15 – 2030-03-15 (the financial years 2026–2030), the outer bound 2032-03-15. Read on **2030-08-01** (the window closed). A split repair R1, `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE`, net 26,000.00, performed 2027-04-01 – 2027-04-30. `CONFIRMED` statements for 2026 to 2029 (their periods from 2026-03-15 resp. 1 January to 31 December); in 2026 and 2028 every `NON_RECOVERABLE` line is classified `NOT_RELEVANT` (administrator's fee, bank charges). `RECOVERABLE` lines (`Hausmeister`, `Gebäudeversicherung`) are never read.

| Line | Statement | `unitShare` (gross) | Classification | Performance | Part in the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 „Instandsetzung Fassade“ | 2027, pos. 3 | 2,000.00 | `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE`, net 1,680.67 | 2027-06-01 – 2027-07-15 | 1,680.67 (wholly inside) |
| L2 „Verwaltervergütung“ | 2027, pos. 4 | 600.00 | `NOT_RELEVANT` | — | not a source |
| L3 „Dachrinnen“ | 2029, pos. 2 | 3,000.00 | `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE`, net 2,521.01 | 2029-02-15 – 2029-04-14, point 2029-03-15: 1,500.00 (the administrator's statement of the work) | 1,500.00 (across the end, exact) |
| L4 „Instandsetzung Tiefgarage“ | 2029, pos. 3 | 2,400.00 | `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE`, net 2,016.81 | none | 0.00 – 2,016.81 (`undetermined`) |

- **Today (main 59bfa6d):** `sum` 26,000.00 (R1 only) → `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` ("13.13"), `final` false only by `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` (`statementIds` of 2026–2029, every statement overlapping the window). Nothing says how much maintenance the Hausgeld held.
- **Under §58M:** `sum` 26,000.00 + 1,680.67 + 1,500.00 = **29,180.67**, `sumUpper` 29,180.67 + 2,016.81 = **31,197.48**. The lower bound is not above 29,700.00, the upper bound is: **`NOT_COMPUTABLE`, `PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`** (`final` false). L3 carries `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` (`edge: "END"`, `lower` = `upper` = 1,500.00); L4 is `undetermined` with `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` (`dateSource` `STATEMENT_PERIOD_END`, `date` 2029-12-31). **This is the manual review of question 16:** the undated line decides, and DE does not guess its date. P's views of 2026–2029 carry `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` as today; **no figure of any view moves**.
- **(a) L4 performed 2029-05-02 – 2029-05-20** (after the window): L4 in `excluded`, `PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW`; 29,180.67 → **`NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`** ("14.74"). **On 2030-08-01 `final` is false:** `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` names only the missing financial year **2030** (the read range ends on the search range's end, 2030-03-15; questions 3 and 7, decided). The statement of 2030 may hold a repair performed in the window and paid by the WEG after it; it is confirmed in 2031 at the earliest. **(a′) Read on 2031-08-01** with the statement of 2030 confirmed and each of its `NON_RECOVERABLE` lines judged (here `NOT_RELEVANT`, or `MAINTENANCE` performed outside the window): `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` ("14.74"), **`final` true** (every line judged, every statement of 2026–2030 confirmed, net amounts given), about five years after the transfer. No statement of 2031 or later is required, and an unjudged line of one does not hold the check open. Under today's code the same data stays not final for good. **(a″) As (a′), plus the statement of 2031** (confirmed in 2032) with a line L5 „Instandsetzung Balkone“, `unitShare` 1,000.00, `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE`, net 840.34, performed 2029-01-05 – 2029-01-25 (in the window, paid late by the WEG): the statement lies beyond the read range and within the outer bound, so L5 is listed in `outsideSearchRange`, not summed; the check is **`NOT_COMPUTABLE`, `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`** (the upper bound 29,180.67 no longer decides, §59F), `final` false. The later-recorded line lands in `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`, not in nothing.
- **(b) L4 performed 2029-01-10 – 2029-01-20** (inside): `sum` = `sumUpper` = **31,197.48** > 29,700.00 → **`ABOVE_THRESHOLD`** ("15.76"). R1 suggested `CAPITALIZED`, `affectedYears` [2027]; L1, L3, L4 carry `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` with `paidFromHausgeld: true` and no suggestion; `final` false, `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAH` open (`NOT_FINAL` `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`). The Hausgeld of 2027–2029 stays `WEG_HAUSGELD`, deducted as paid; the release stage is 2 (236-4: a summed source still `DEDUCTIBLE`).
- **(c) L2 not classified:** as above, plus `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` with `lines: [{ statementId: <2027>, position: 4, account: "Verwaltervergütung", unitShare: 600.00 }]`; in (a) the check is then not final.
- **(d) No statement of 2029 yet** (read on 2029-08-01): L3 and L4 unknown; `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` (`{ membershipId, financialYear: 2029 }`, and 2030, not yet ended) keeps (a)'s outcome not final (open question 7).

### Flags, reasons and the effect on `final`

| Code | Where | Level | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` (`details: { statementIds, lines }`) | the check's `flags`, and a `NOT_FINAL` reason | open; now only for unjudged lines | §58B, narrowed by §58M |
| `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`, `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW`, `VAT_NOT_SEPARATED`, `PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_ESTIMATED` | a cost-line entry | as §59F | §59F |
| `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` with `paidFromHausgeld: true` | a summed cost-line entry, above 15 % | open (no suggestion to follow) | §58M |
| `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAH`, `NOT_FINAL` reason `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` | the check | open | §58M (open question 6) |
| `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` (`NOT_FINAL` reason and flag) | the check, for each financial year overlapping S to W + 365 days without a `CONFIRMED` statement | open | §58M (open question 7) |
| `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` (`NOT_FINAL` reason; `notComputableReason` where the upper bound would decide) | the check, for a judged line of a later statement performed in the window (`outsideSearchRange`) | open | §59F, reached by §58M (open question 3) |
| `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` | the year (unchanged code) | open | §58C |

- **The rule for `final` stays §58C's and §59F's:** a check is final only without any `NOT_FINAL` reason; a final check never makes a tax year final (§59F). A year that is `final: true` today never becomes final by §58M alone where a line is unjudged; a year can become final where every line is judged and dated and every statement of the read range is confirmed (example (a′); on 2030-08-01, example (a), it is not); a later statement's line performed in the window reopens it visibly (example (a″)).
- **The meanings of other sources:** unchanged, except that a source's `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` and suggestion can now appear (or disappear) because a cost line moved the outcome; `checkFlagsOf` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:500-540`) never hands a flag to a cost line's meaning (it has none in any list or view).

### Interaction with VC-X-34 (§58K) and the change flags (§58E, §58G–§58J)

- **Without `economicTransferDate` (§58K):** the check has no window, reads no source and no statement, so no cost line is listed and `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` is not raised (as for `NO_APPLICABLE_RULE` today, `anschaffungsnahe.ts:362`); `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING` holds the check and its years open. A cost line can still be classified (the classification names no Acquisition). On main before §58K the window starts at `contractDate` (`tax-property-context.ts:216`), and §58M reads from that start; nothing here depends on the order of the two (decided: §58K first).
- **A statement confirmed, or a line judged, after a year's end** moves the check (its outcome, its `final`, the suggestions and `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` on other sources), never a figure: the check never changes a figure (§58B). The move is visible, not silent: the year's `acquisitions[].status`, `notFinalReasons` and `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` show it on the next read, and a year that was final shows the reopened check. **Decided (as proposed):** no new kind of `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED` (§58E) or `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED` (§58G), as §58K decides for its own change and as §58J leaves the check alone (open question 9). The existing kinds are unchanged.
- **A recorded version (§60)** is unaffected: the check is not in `inputFingerprint`; a capitalisation that follows a changed suggestion is a new classification and moves the item as §59B/§59F say.

### Database (migration: the next free number at implementation)

- **`tax_classification`** gains `weg_cost_line_position` (`integer`, 1–1000) and `weg_cost_line_unit_share` (Money, scale ≤ 2, as `weg_withdrawal_unit_share`); `tax_classification_source_type_check` gains `WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE`; `tax_classification_one_source` and 0047's `weg_source_fields` change so that `weg_annual_statement_id` is set with exactly one of `weg_reserve_position` and `weg_cost_line_position`; a foreign key `(weg_annual_statement_id, weg_cost_line_position)` → `weg_statement_cost_line (statement_id, position)` (0042's unique key, `:131`; the Realm through the statement's composite key); chain keys and supersede foreign keys as 0047's for withdrawals; `tax_classification_current_cost_line` (unique, `WHERE superseded_at IS NULL`).
- **A CHECK for the fit:** with `WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE`, `(tax_category, treatment)` is `('MAINTENANCE', 'DEDUCTIBLE')` or `('NOT_RELEVANT', 'NOT_RELEVANT')`; `anschaffungsnahe_acquisition_id`, `partial_treatment`, the § 82b fields, `tax_year` and `refund_of_year` are null/false; `net_amount`, `annually_recurring` and the performance columns (0058) only with `MAINTENANCE`.
- **A guard `tax_classification_cost_line_counts`** (before insert; writes the statement row first, a no-op, P7-D9, as 0047's `withdrawal_counts`): the statement `CONFIRMED`, the line's stored `classification` `NON_RECOVERABLE`, its `unit_share` ≠ 0 and equal to `weg_cost_line_unit_share`, else `SOURCE_NOT_COUNTED`. The frozen trigger (0047's `tax_classification_weg_source_fixed`) covers the new columns.
- **No change** to `weg_annual_statement`, `weg_statement_cost_line` or their guards; no backfill. **`down`** refuses while any `WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE` classification exists (a person's statement is never dropped silently, as 0051/0052), else restores 0047's/0062's constraints. `up` does not refuse with recorded versions (no column of them changes).
- **API inventory:** no new route (`POST /tax-classifications` and `GET /tax-classifications?sourceType=&sourceId=&sourcePosition=` take the new source type); `docs/development/api-inventory.md` is unchanged, regenerated to prove it.

### The rule version (open question 8, decided as proposed)

`DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` gains, **in place** (the Phase-7 freeze is the go-live of the first productive installation, decided 2026-11-01), the parameter `hausgeldMaintenance: { sourceType: "WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE", judgedLines: ["NON_RECOVERABLE"], lines: [{ taxCategory: "MAINTENANCE", treatment: "DEDUCTIBLE" }, { taxCategory: "NOT_RELEVANT", treatment: "NOT_RELEVANT" }], amount: "UNIT_SHARE_AS_PRINTED", statementsFrom: "WINDOW_START", statementsUntil: "SEARCH_RANGE_END", laterStatementLinesInWindow: "OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE", dateMeasured: "PERFORMANCE", aboveThreshold: "NO_SUGGESTION_MANUAL_REVIEW", source: "Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Frage 16 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01); api-design §58M" }` and a change note in `source`. The classification of a cost line names it as `rule` (selected on the statement's `periodUntil`; before 2004-01-01 `422 NO_APPLICABLE_RULE`). The pin `frozen-rules.test.ts:70` is updated explicitly, with counter-checks that recompute the current hash `d4e797c4…9f45` and that a changed `hausgeldMaintenance` changes it. A rule version without the parameter keeps today's behaviour (every overlapping statement flagged, no line read), so the parameter decides, as `performance.partialTreatment` does.

### Tests the implementation needs

- **Domain (pure):** the examples literally (the base `NOT_COMPUTABLE` with 29,180.67/31,197.48; (a) `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` "14.74" and **not** final on 2030-08-01 with `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` for 2030 alone, (a′) final on 2031-08-01 with that statement confirmed and judged; `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` for a year after W within the read range (2030), not for a year beyond it (2031), and the read range and the missing years one parameter (a test registry with another `statementsUntil` moves both); (a″) the later statement's L5 in `outsideSearchRange`, not summed, the check `NOT_COMPUTABLE` with `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`, and an unjudged or undated line of that statement neither flagged nor listed; (b) `ABOVE_THRESHOLD` "15.76" with no suggestion on L1/L3/L4 and R1 suggested; (c) the narrowed flag with its line; (d) `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING`); a credit line swapping the bounds; `annuallyRecurring` excluded; an estimated point ignored; a line performed across S (only the evidenced part from S) and across W without a point (bounds); a statement wholly before S not read, one ending on S read; a statement beyond the read range within the outer bound: only its `MAINTENANCE` lines performed in the window are listed (`outsideSearchRange`, `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`), its undated line is not; a statement beyond the outer bound not read; a `RECOVERABLE` and a `RESERVE` line never read; `unitShare` 0.00 never unjudged; a partial acquisition (× `acquiredShare`); a test registry without `hausgeldMaintenance` gives today's flag; `weg-spending.test.ts:566-576` updated explicitly (statements with lines), its counter-check (the statement of 2025 not flagged) kept.
- **The view:** every money sum of every view unchanged with cost-line classifications present (each line, section, `result`, `owners`, items, the per-property list); a cost line never an item; `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` as the check says.
- **Repository and schema (PostgreSQL):** the classification's order of checks and every refusal (`DRAFT` statement, `RECOVERABLE`/`RESERVE` line, a unit share not the line's, `CAPITALIZED`, the link, the § 82b fields, `taxYear`); supersede and the history read; **past the repository**, each guard with a counter-check (a raw insert on a `DRAFT` statement, on a `RECOVERABLE` line, with another unit share, with `CAPITALIZED`, with `anschaffungsnahe_acquisition_id`, two current classifications of one line; each accepted for a valid row); `down` refusing with a row; **history:** `TAX_CLASSIFIED` and `TAX_CLASSIFICATION_SUPERSEDED` AuditRecords for a cost line, reading the check or the view writes no row and no AuditRecord; **Realm isolation:** another Realm's statement, line and classification are in no check of this Realm, a classification naming another Realm's statement is `404`; one snapshot (a classification committed between two reads of one check is not seen).
- **End to end:** a new `tax-anschaffungsnahe-hausgeld.e2e.test.ts`: the base example, (a)–(c) and (a″) through the HTTP API, the views of 2026–2029 with unchanged figures, the release stage of the purchase in (b) (stage 2). **ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged** (open question 10): ACC7's `Verwaltervergütung` (`NON_RECOVERABLE`, 1,200.00) stays unjudged, so `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` stays among the reasons (`:586-588` holds; no figure, sum or percentage of ACC7 changes: 12,600.00, 14,600.00, "17.38"); ACC8 files no annual statement.

**Mutations** that must turn the tests red (each applied alone, restored byte for byte): a cost line summed in the view (`WEG_HAUSGELD` or `MAINTENANCE` total moves); the statement's period end used as the date of the work (L4 summed in the lower bound); an undated line dropped from the upper bound; `RECOVERABLE` lines read as judged-required (ACC7 unchanged would not catch it, the domain test does); the flag raised for a judged statement, or not raised for an unjudged line; the statements' range ending at the outer bound instead of W + 365 days (example (a) names 2031 and 2032 missing); `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` limited to the years of [S, W] (example (a) final on 2030-08-01); the missing years taken from a range other than the read range; a year not yet ended not counted as missing; a later statement's line performed in the window dropped (example (a″) final) or summed (example (a″) `ABOVE_THRESHOLD`); a statement before S read; a cost line suggested `CAPITALIZED`; `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` dropped (the check final in (b)); the printed `unitShare` replaced by `totalAmount × MEA`; the guard without the `NON_RECOVERABLE` test; the guard without the `CONFIRMED` test; the rule's parameter read from a constant.

### The text that changes with the implementation

- **§58B "Not summed, and said so: maintenance paid from the Hausgeld"** becomes "Counted when judged (§58M)": the judged maintenance lines are a source of the check only; `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` names the unjudged lines. **§58B "Never counted twice":** "No route of this section reads `weg_statement_cost_line`" gains "except the check's read of §58M, which never adds a line to a meaning, list or view". **§58B open question 12:** "Answered by the tax review (question 16) and specified in §58M; dated by the performance, not the period".
- **§58C decision 5** gains "Counted by the check since VC-X-27 (§58M); the view still never adds a cost line".
- **§59F "Not in VC-X-38"**, the Hausgeld bullet: "VC-X-27, §58M: each line takes a performance".
- **§60A** "VC-X-27 … is covered by A1": "after VC-X-27 the flag names only unjudged lines; a cost line summed above 15 % keeps the purchase at stage 2 through 236-4".
- **The invariant suite** (`docs/development/invariant-suite.md:845`, "The anschaffungsnahe check"): "the sum of Erhaltungsaufwand of every source (splits, withdrawals, uses)" gains "and the judged maintenance lines of the confirmed WEG statements (§58M), never in the view"; a new row for "a cost line is never a figure of the view".
- **`docs/germany/verification-checklist.md` A2b** and **`beratungsfragen.md` §1**: the „Folge für DE“ points to §58M.

### Open questions (decided)

1. **How a line becomes a source.** **Decided (as proposed):** a classification of the cost line (new source type `WEG_STATEMENT_COST_LINE`, `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE` or `NOT_RELEVANT`), check-only, carrying §59F's performance and evidence (one fact, one mechanism, corrections by supersede, as decided for §59F question 1). **Alternative (not taken):** a check-only table of its own (`weg_cost_line_maintenance` with the period), outside `tax_classification`, so no classification ever exists that the view must ignore; the performance machinery (points, evidence, `created_txid`) would be duplicated.
2. **Which lines must be judged.** **Decided (as proposed):** the lines stored `NON_RECOVERABLE` with `unitShare` ≠ 0.00; `RECOVERABLE` lines are Betriebskosten, which exclude maintenance by § 1 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 BetrKV, and `RESERVE` lines are contributions. The shortcut rests on the line's stored `classification` being right: it can be `USER`-set (or taken from the previous statement) and wrong, and a repair stored as `RECOVERABLE` then escapes the check silently; that gap is carried by the review of the classification in §50 (`CLASSIFIED_AGAINST_GROUP` shows a deviation from the printed group, nothing shows a wrong printed group). **Alternative (not taken):** every line except `RESERVE` (a repair misfiled among the recoverable lines is caught too), at the price of judging every Hausmeister, cleaning and insurance line each year.
3. **Which statements are read.** **Decided: the alternative** (not the proposal): only the `CONFIRMED` statements whose period overlaps the search range, S to W + 365 days (never one ending before S). WEG statements are periodic and complete per financial year, the line's performance decides the window anyway, the outer bound of three years is meant for cash sources whose payment can be delayed, and an administrator pays tradespeople within weeks. A later-recorded line with performance in the window lands in `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` (listed in `outsideSearchRange`, example (a″)), not in nothing. **Proposal (not taken):** the `CONFIRMED` statements whose period overlaps S to the outer bound's end (3 years after W), reasoning that the WEG pays late and that the owner decided no relevant source is dropped by its payment date alone (2026-11-02).
4. **The amount.** **Decided (as proposed):** the printed `unitShare` (the printed statement wins, BR-WEG-006; `LINE_SHARE_DIFFERS` already shows a deviation), net by the classification's `netAmount`. **Alternative (not taken):** `totalAmount × allocationShare / allocationTotal` (the backlog's "× the unit's share"), or × the membership's MEA, which is wrong for lines on another key (`Einheit`, consumption).
5. **A line without performance data.** **Decided (as proposed):** like any undated source (§59F, decided 2026-11-02 question 3): `undetermined` in the upper bound when its statement period overlaps the search range, listed in `outsideSearchRange` beyond it (under question 3 as decided every statement read overlaps the search range, so an undated line of it is always `undetermined`); it decides nothing, so a check that depends on it is `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (the "manuelle Prüfung"). **Alternative (not taken):** a stricter reading of "manuelle Prüfung": any undated maintenance line keeps the check `NOT_FINAL` (a new reason) even when the outcome holds by both bounds.
6. **Above 15 % with Hausgeld maintenance in the sum.** **Decided (as proposed):** the outcome stands, no suggestion on the cost line, the check `NOT_FINAL` with `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` (manual review by the advisor), the view's `WEG_HAUSGELD` unchanged; capitalising that share (out of the Hausgeld deducted, into a §59B item) is a new backlog row and an advisor question in `beratungsfragen.md` §4. **Alternative (not taken):** in VC-X-27, a partial treatment of the Hausgeld split (the share `CAPITALIZED`, as VC-X-38 Part 2's parts), which changes the view's figures and needs to pick the Hausgeld payment that held the share.
7. **A statement not yet confirmed.** **Decided (as proposed: symmetric, but over question 3's range as decided):** `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` as a `NOT_FINAL` reason for each financial year of a membership that overlaps S to W + 365 days without a `CONFIRMED` statement (examples (a), (d)); the same parameter as the statements read, so no statement that would be read is missing silently, and a check is final at the earliest after the statement of the read range's last year is confirmed: about five years after the transfer instead of seven. **Alternative (asymmetric, not taken):** only the years overlapping [S, W]: the window's own statements are required, later ones are read when they exist but their absence does not hold the check open; then example (a) would be final on 2030-08-01 and a repair in the 2030 statement could reopen a check that read final (the owner: a „final“ that the next statement reopens is no final for the AfA basis). **Alternative (none, not taken):** as today, no reason.
8. **The rule.** **Decided (as proposed):** `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` in place with the parameter `hausgeldMaintenance` and its pin updated explicitly (the Phase-7 freeze point is not reached, as for VC-X-38). **Alternative (not taken):** a rule of its own, `DE_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE@1` (as §58B gave each legal basis its own rule), pinned on its own; `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` unchanged.
9. **Change flags.** **Decided (as proposed):** none: a later statement or judgement moves the check visibly (status, `notFinalReasons`, `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL`), never a figure. **Alternative (not taken):** a §58H kind (`WEG_COST_LINE_JUDGED` from the classification's AuditRecord after the year's end), acknowledgeable by §58E, for a year whose check changed after it was final.
10. **Order, tests, ACC7 and ACC8.** **Decided (as proposed):** a PR of its own with the migration (the next free number), its own e2e test `tax-anschaffungsnahe-hausgeld.e2e.test.ts`; ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged (ACC7's `Verwaltervergütung` stays unjudged, ACC8 has no statement; no figure changes). **Alternative (not taken):** ACC7 classifies its `Verwaltervergütung` `NOT_RELEVANT`, so `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` leaves ACC7's reasons (`phase-7-acceptance.e2e.test.ts:586-588` changes to `['GROSS_AMOUNTS']` among others; every figure, sum and "17.38" unchanged). **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-05 (chat), on the conflict of M7 with „ACC8 unchanged“ found in the implementation (#269, question 1)** (verbatim; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-05):

> **(a).** ACC8 bleibt so angepasst, M7 gilt ohne Ausnahme.
>
> Begründung: Eine Mitgliedschaft ohne jede Abrechnung ist der Fall, in dem über die Ausgaben der WEG am wenigsten bekannt ist. Eine Ausnahme dafür würde „keine Daten“ besser aussehen lassen als „einige Daten“, und genau das verbietet das Prinzip, nichts still als vollständig zu behandeln. ACC8 hat eine WEG-Mitgliedschaft; dass seine Prüfung dann nicht final ist, bildet die Regel korrekt ab, statt sie zu umgehen.
>
> Eine Bedingung: Die Anpassung an ACC8 darf nur `final`, die `notFinalReasons` und das Flag betreffen. Kein Betrag, keine Summe und kein Schwellenwert in ACC8 ändert sich.

So ACC8 is adapted (below, "As implemented (VC-X-27)", deviation 1), and the condition is asserted in ACC8 itself.
11. **A superseding statement.** **Decided (as proposed):** its lines start unjudged, as a successor's withdrawals are never carried over (§58B open question 3); the flag reopens until they are judged. **Alternative (not taken):** a judgement copied by `position` and `account` when the line's `unitShare` is unchanged, which saves work but carries a judgement to a line no one looked at.

**Decided by the owner on 2026-11-04 (chat)** (verbatim; cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04“; the owner's preamble for §58K, §58L and §58M, then the part on §58M with the owner's closing paragraph on M3 and M7; M1–M11 are open questions 1–11 above; the part on §58K is recorded with VC-X-34, the part on §58L in §58L):

> Ich lese die drei Abschnitte §58K, §58L und §58M auf `main` mit ihren offenen Fragen.
>
> Hier die 29 Entscheidungen. Abweichungen vom Vorschlag: K4 (beides), L4 (Vorschlag plus Backlog-Zeile), M3 (Alternative). Reihenfolge: §58K zuerst, damit bekommt VC-X-34 die 0066; dann §58M, dann §58L.
>
> **§58M, VC-X-27: wie vorgeschlagen, außer M3**
>
> - **M1, M2, M4 bis M6, M8 bis M11: wie vorgeschlagen.** Klassifikation der Kostenzeile als Quelle, nur `NON_RECOVERABLE`-Zeilen, gedruckter `unitShare` netto, undatierte Zeile wie jede undatierte Quelle, über 15 % nur `NOT_FINAL` mit Beraterfrage, Regel in `@1` mit Parameter, keine Änderungsflags, eigener PR, Nachfolgeabrechnung startet ungeprüft.
> - **M3: Alternative, der Suchbereich bis W + 365 Tage.** WEG-Abrechnungen sind periodisch und vollständig je Geschäftsjahr, und das Leistungsdatum der Zeile entscheidet ohnehin über das Fenster. Die Außengrenze von drei Jahren ist für Kassenquellen gedacht, deren Zahlung sich verzögern kann; eine Verwaltung zahlt Handwerker innerhalb von Wochen. Eine später erfasste Zeile mit Leistung im Fenster landet in `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`, nicht im Nichts.
> - **M7: wie vorgeschlagen, symmetrisch, aber auf den Bereich aus M3.** `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` für jedes Geschäftsjahr, das S bis W + 365 Tage überlappt. Damit wird die Prüfung etwa fünf Jahre nach dem Übergang final statt sieben. Die asymmetrische Variante nehme ich nicht: ein „final“, das die nächste Abrechnung wieder öffnet, ist für die AfA-Basis kein final.
>
> Zur Einordnung von M3 und M7: Für einen WEG-Eigentümer im Dreijahresfenster ist die Prüfung nach A1 ohnehin Stufe 2. Fünf Jahre bis final sind der Preis dafür, dass die Abrechnungen der WEG wirklich gelesen werden; kürzer ginge nur, indem man etwas nicht liest.

The create writes the statement row first (a no-op, P7-D9), reads the line, takes the line's current classification `FOR UPDATE`; checks in §58B's order: source `404` → the line (`COST_LINE_NOT_NON_RECOVERABLE` for a `RECOVERABLE`/`RESERVE` line or one of 0.00) → the statement (`STATEMENT_SUPERSEDED`, `STATEMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED`) → `NO_APPLICABLE_RULE` (`DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE` with `hausgeldMaintenance` on `periodUntil`) → `TREATMENT_NOT_ALLOWED` (the rule's `lines`) → `NET_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS` (against |unit share|) → §59F's performance checks (plausible around `periodUntil`, evidence for points) → `supersedes`. Unjudged lines raise `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` (`statementIds`, `lines`); each financial year of an `ACTIVE` membership within the read range without a `CONFIRMED` statement, or not ended on `today` (clipped to the membership's end), raises `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` (`missing`) (M7); above 15 % with a summed cost line `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` with the flag `HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAH` (`lines` with `inWindow`), the cost-line entries carry `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` with `paidFromHausgeld: true` and no suggestion (M6).
