Verbatim (cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-05“; its points 1 and 2 answer #269's questions 2 and 3):

> **1. Ja.** `WEG_STATEMENT_MISSING` erfüllt das bestehende Kriterium `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_OPEN`, also Stufe 2, ab dem ersten Jahr des Fensters, solange die Prüfung aus diesem Grund nicht final ist. Das ist dieselbe Logik wie in A1 für den Hausgeld-Hinweis: Die Summe ist bekannt unvollständig. Und es passt zum Bericht, der WEG ausdrücklich in Stufe 2 führt; eine WEG-Einheit im Dreijahresfenster war nie ein Stufe-1-Fall. `DE_RECORDING_STAGES@1` bleibt unverändert, weil nur ein weiterer Weg zu einem vorhandenen Kriterium hinzukommt, wie bei 236-4.
>
> **2. Ja, a″ bestätigt.** Eine später erfasste Abrechnung außerhalb des Lesebereichs, deren Zeile eine Leistung im Fenster trägt, darf eine finale Prüfung wieder öffnen. „Final“ heißt: final nach allen Abrechnungen, die gelesen werden mussten. Neue Belege öffnen auch sonst Festgeschriebenes wieder, etwa eine erfasste AfA-Version über `DEPRECIATION_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDED`. Mein Einwand gegen die asymmetrische M7-Variante war ein anderer: Dort wäre die Pflichtmenge kleiner gewesen als die Lesemenge, und das Wiederöffnen der Normalfall. Hier bleibt es die Ausnahme für Belege, die niemand hätte erwarten müssen.
>
> Zwei Bedingungen: Das Wiederöffnen ist sichtbar, `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` erscheint wieder am Jahr, und es bleibt bei M9, also kein eigener Änderungs-Kind in §58E. Die Prüfung verschiebt sichtbar ihren Status, nie still eine Zahl.

---

# 58N. Recording the Transfer of Economic Ownership (VC-X-52, implemented: migration 0067)

**Status:** implemented (VC-X-52, migration 0067; below, "As implemented (VC-X-52)"). Open questions 1–8 decided by the owner on 2026-11-04 (below, "Open questions (decided)"; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04): 1–4 and 6–8 as proposed, 5 differing from the proposal (`OPEN` when a seller of the same Acquisition in the same Realm has an AfA component, closed by an acknowledgement of §58E Part 2 with the new kind `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER`, else `INFORMATIVE`; the correction itself is the new backlog row VC-X-55). Backlog VC-X-52 (created by the owner's decision on §58K open question 4, K4). **Migration 0067** (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04: „Reihenfolge: VC-X-52 direkt nach #266, vor §58M und §58L. Es bekommt die 0067.“). A prerequisite of release stage 1 (`docs/development/freigabe-afa-erfassung.md`, beside VC-X-34). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it, and no unconfirmed tax assumption reads as released by it.

**What it amends:** §27 (a new command), §27.1 (the response, `transferDate`, "In the database"), §28.1 requirement 0 (now also in the database) and "In the database (migration 0022)", §58K open question 4 and "As implemented (VC-X-34)" 7 and 12 (the date can now be entered), and, depending on open question 1, the readers of §27.1's `transferDate` listed under "The rule for the Ownerships".

**Unchanged guarantees:** an Acquisition's other data (price, share, contract date, land registry date, parties, `sourceReferences`, `notes`) stays fixed after creation (§27.1); `CONFIRMED` and `CANCELLED` stay final as **statuses** (P2-D6): this command changes no status and confirms nothing. `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1`, the AfA rules and their pinned hashes are unchanged. Realm isolation and §30.1's answers are unchanged. DE still writes no cash, no split and no classification.

**Why a section of its own, after §58M:** VC-X-52 is a backlog item of its own, implemented before §58M and §58L (the owner's order above), so its number is the next free letter, not its place in the order.

### The decided facts (verbatim)

All cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04“.

- **The item and its scope** (§58K K4): „Dazu die neue Backlog-Zeile für das Nachtragen an einer bestätigten Anschaffung mit Beleg, inklusive der Regel für Ownerships, die am Vertragsdatum begannen. Ohne die Zeile bliebe jeder Altbestand dauerhaft nicht final.“
- **`DRAFT` too, with the same command and rules:** „Ja, VC-X-52 sollte auch DRAFT abdecken, und zwar mit demselben Befehl und denselben Regeln wie für CONFIRMED.“
- **Requirement 0 in the database, in this migration:** „DB-Wächter für Anforderung 0: ja, aber erst mit VC-X-52 und in dessen Migration, nicht als eigene spätere.“ With the reasons and the rules given with it: „Invarianten gehören in diesem Projekt in die Datenbank, nicht nur in den Domänen-Check (AGENTS.md §28, die Trigger aus 0022). Ein Wächter heute würde aber die Altbestand-Fixtures blockieren, die §59A und die Tests für TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING brauchen, weil confirmAsBeforeVcX34 genau den Übergang DRAFT → CONFIRMED ohne Datum nimmt. Sobald VC-X-52 das Nachtragen erlaubt, ist Altbestand ein reparierbarer Zustand und kein nötiger Testpfad mehr über den Übergang.“ and
  - „Der Trigger acquisition_frozen bekommt die Regel: der Übergang nach CONFIRMED verlangt economic_transfer_date IS NOT NULL. Bestehende CONFIRMED-Zeilen bleiben unberührt, es gibt keinen Backfill.“
  - „Testdaten für Altbestand werden direkt als CONFIRMED eingefügt, nicht über den Übergang. Das ist ehrlicher als ein Repository-Bypass, weil es den Zustand erzeugt, den die Migration vorfindet, nicht den Weg, den sie verbietet.“
  - „down stellt den Trigger aus 0022 wörtlich wieder her.“
- **The order and the size:** „Es ist das kleinste der drei Items: ein Befehl, ein AuditRecord, der Wächter aus Punkt 1, die Ownership-Meldung. Ein Tag.“ and „Es ist faktisch eine Voraussetzung von Stufe 1, nicht nur „vor Freischaltung“. Eine bestätigte Anschaffung ohne Datum hat keinen AfA-Beginn und keine anschaffungsnahe Prüfung; nichts an ihr ist erfassbar. Solange VC-X-52 fehlt, ist jeder Altbestand ein toter Datensatz, der nur durch Storno und Neuanlage lebt.“
- **The tax side** (`docs/germany/pruefbericht-2026-11-01.md`, questions 3 and 14; mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01): the three-year window starts on the day of the transfer of economic ownership; without that date the record is incomplete; the date is an „Eingabe mit Belegquelle“.

**Decided later (2026-11-04, open question 1):** option (b), the Ownerships stay (below, "Open questions (decided)"). Before that decision this paragraph read: the rule for the Ownerships of a `CONFIRMED` Acquisition that began on the contract date was not decided; the owner's „die Ownership-Meldung“ above read as a notice rather than a move, which is why this spec proposed option (b).

### As the code stands (main dd1e4c7, after VC-X-34, #266; paths relative to `services/de-backend/src/`)

- **No route sets the date later:** `api/acquisitions.ts` has `POST /acquisitions`, `…/cancel` and `…/confirm` only (`:129`, `:182`, `:203`). The date is set on create, not before `contractDate` (`400 BEFORE_CONTRACT_DATE`, §27.1; 0020's CHECK `acquisition_transfer_dates`).
- **The database freezes it:** 0020's `acquisition_frozen` refuses any change of `economic_transfer_date` (and of the other data), refuses any change at all once the status is not `DRAFT`, and lets `version`/`updated_at` move only with a status step.
- **Requirement 0 is the repository's only:** `planConfirm` (`domains/acquisition/acquisition.ts:212`) adds `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`; 0022's `acquisition_step` calls `acquisition_confirmation_violation` (replaced by 0050) for requirements 1–6 on `d = coalesce(economic_transfer_date, contract_date)`, not requirement 0 (§58K "As implemented (VC-X-34)" 7). 0022's `acquisition_initial` inserts only `DRAFT`.
- **Legacy data in the tests:** `infrastructure/postgres/legacy-acquisition.test-support.ts` (`confirmAsBeforeVcX34`) takes the raw transition `DRAFT` → `CONFIRMED` of an undated row; used by `infrastructure/postgres/tax-weg.test-support.ts:350`, `depreciation-schedule.e2e.test.ts:431` and `tax-year-transfer-date.e2e.test.ts:83`, `:218`.
- **Who reads which date.** The check (§58K) and the AfA start (§59A, VC-X-33; `domains/depreciation/purchase-work.ts:144`) read `economicTransferDate` alone. §27.1's `transferDate` (`economicTransferDate ?? contractDate`, `domains/acquisition/acquisition.ts:51`) is read as **the day the buyers' Ownerships begin**: by `confirm` (`infrastructure/postgres/acquisition-repository.ts:309`) and 0050's `acquisition_confirmation_violation` (requirements 2–6 and §28.1A's increase over `d − 1`), §27.4 (`infrastructure/postgres/owner-allocation-source.ts:27`), §59A's components (`domains/depreciation/schedule.ts:118`, `ownedFrom`), the seller's cut-off (`domains/depreciation/purchase-tenure.ts:31`, `domains/depreciation/item-part.ts:159`, `domains/depreciation/recording-stage.ts:143`), the listing of a purchase in a year (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-depreciation.ts:251`) and the default `effectiveDate` of a land/building allocation (`infrastructure/postgres/land-building-allocation-repository.ts:56`).
- **A `DRAFT` can carry Ownerships.** Confirmation creates none (§28.1 "Effect"); WF-002 writes the buyers' Ownerships with the `DRAFT`'s id **before** `confirm` (requirement 4 needs them), from §27.1's `transferDate`, so for an undated `DRAFT` from the contract date. They can still be voided while the Acquisition is a `DRAFT` (§26.1), not after confirmation. (The backlog row's "a `DRAFT` Acquisition has no Ownerships yet, they begin on its `confirm`" does not hold; corrected here and in the row.)

### The command

```text
POST /api/v1/acquisitions/{acquisitionId}/economic-transfer-date
```

- **Domain owner:** Acquisition. **Authorization:** as §27.1.
- **Which Acquisitions take it:** `DRAFT` and `CONFIRMED`, **with the same command and the same rules** (the owner's decision above), whose `economicTransferDate` is `null`. A `CANCELLED` one takes none.
- **Body** (strict; unknown keys `400`):
  - `economicTransferDate` (business date, required): the day of the transfer of economic ownership (Übergang von Besitz, Nutzen und Lasten).
  - `sourceReferences` (1–10 strings of 1–500, trimmed as §26.1, **at least one**, `400 REQUIRED` for an empty list): the evidence (the tax review's „Eingabe mit Belegquelle“), e.g. the hand-over protocol or the contract clause. Where they are stored is open question 2.
  - `notes` (≤ 2000, optional), recorded in the AuditRecord only.
- **Order of checks** (the first refusal answers; nothing is written):
  1. `400` (body, id);
  2. unknown or foreign → `404`;
  3. `CANCELLED` → `409 CONFLICT` with `reason = "ACQUISITION_CANCELLED"` (also with a stale `If-Match`: a final status answers before the version, as §28.1);
  4. `economicTransferDate` already set → `409 CONFLICT` with `reason = "TRANSFER_DATE_ALREADY_SET"` and `details: { economicTransferDate }` (the stored date; also when it equals the body's: a set date is never changed or confirmed again, and a retry without a key is never applied twice);
  5. `If-Match` (§16.1, optional) on the Acquisition's version → `412`;
  6. `422`: `economicTransferDate` before `contractDate` → `422 BEFORE_CONTRACT_DATE` with `details: { contractDate }` (a `422`, not §27.1's `400`, since the contract date is stored, not in the body); a date after today → open question 3; under option (a) of open question 1 also the blocked moves (`422 TRANSFER_DATE_BLOCKED`, below).
- **Success:** `200` with the Acquisition (§27.1; `economicTransferDate` set, `version` + 1, `ETag`), its `status` unchanged. AuditRecord **`ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED`** on the Acquisition with `economicTransferDate`, `sourceReferences`, `notes`, `contractDate`, the status at the time and, under option (b), `ownershipStart` (below). One AuditRecord; none on any Ownership under option (b).
- **Idempotency (§15):** `Idempotency-Key` with scope `acquisition.transfer-date.record`, fingerprint of the Acquisition id and the normalized body (texts trimmed, `sourceReferences` as given). Replay `200` with the recorded body and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; another payload with the same key `409`. Without a key a retry answers step 4's `409`, so it is never applied twice.
- **Concurrency and locks** (one READ COMMITTED transaction, the order of every path, §27.1): claim the key → the PropertyReference's no-op write (as every Ownership writer, §26.1) → the Acquisition `FOR UPDATE` → re-read → check → write → AuditRecord → record the key. So it serialises with `confirm` and `cancel` (same order, same Acquisition lock), with cost, payment and allocation writes (they write the Acquisition row, §27.2, §27.3) and with every Ownership write of the PropertyReference. A concurrent `confirm` of a `DRAFT` either comes first (the command then dates a `CONFIRMED` Acquisition, by the same rules) or waits and then sees the date (requirement 0 met). Two recordings of one Acquisition: the second sees the first and answers `TRANSFER_DATE_ALREADY_SET`.
- **No other field moves.** The status, `confirmedAt`, `transferDate` under option (b) (below) and every cost, payment, allocation and Ownership stay as they are.

### `DRAFT` and `CONFIRMED`

- **`CONFIRMED` (legacy data):** an Acquisition confirmed before VC-X-34 without the date (§28.1 requirement 0, legacy). Its buyers' Ownerships began on `contractDate` (requirement 2 was checked on `transferDate` = `contractDate`), and its sellers' rows end on `contractDate − 1` (§28.1A "The seller side"). Those rows can no longer be voided (§28.1), and `validFrom` never changes (0019/0020's `ownership_frozen`). What the recorded date means for them is open question 1.
- **`DRAFT`:** the same command, the same checks and the same AuditRecord. After it, `confirm` finds requirement 0 met. A `DRAFT` **may already carry Ownerships** (written by WF-002 from the contract date while the date was unset, above); a `DRAFT` without any has nothing the rule of open question 1 could find. Whether the rule for the Ownerships applies to a `DRAFT`'s existing rows exactly as to a `CONFIRMED` one is open question 4 (proposal: yes, the same rule).

### The rule for the Ownerships (open question 1; decided 2026-11-04: (b))

**Amended by §58R (VC-X-57, ADR-044; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-06):** option (b) below stays the rule for every Acquisition confirmed before migration 0073 (legacy data); a `DRAFT` dated by this command has `ownershipStart` = `economicTransferDate` and is confirmed on it, and its §58N flag no longer arises.

When the recorded date equals `contractDate` nothing differs, under either option: the Ownerships already begin on the transfer date. When it is later:

- **(a) Move them.** The command moves the `validFrom` of the buyers' Ownerships carrying the Acquisition, and the `validUntil` of the sellers' rows ending on `contractDate − 1`, to the recorded date (and the day before), under §28.1's locks, and re-checks requirements 2–6 of §28.1 (with §28.1A's 5a/5b) on the new date. Refused (`422 TRANSFER_DATE_BLOCKED` with `details.blockedBy`) while a later fact rests on the old start: a further ownership change or close of those rows (§26.2), a successor row of a seller (§28.1A's guard), a land/building allocation whose `effectiveDate` is the old start (§27.3), a recorded schedule version covering the purchase (§60). It needs 0019/0020's `ownership_frozen` relaxed for this path (`validFrom` is fixed and `validUntil` is "never extended", §26.1), AuditRecords on every moved row, and makes the history of an Ownership movable for the first time.
- **(b) Keep them (proposal).** The Ownerships stay as they are. The recorded date starts the check's window (§58K) and the AfA (§59A) and nothing else. The day the Ownerships begin, today §27.1's `transferDate`, is kept as a date of its own (**`ownershipStart`**), so no reader of it moves:
  - **`ownershipStart`** is `contractDate` for an Acquisition whose `economicTransferDate` was recorded by this command, else `economicTransferDate ?? contractDate` as today. It is derived, not stored: 0067 adds `economic_transfer_recorded_at` (`timestamptz`, `NULL` until this command sets it, with the date), so no existing row changes and no backfill is needed.
  - **Every reader of `transferDate` listed under "As the code stands"** (confirm's requirements 2–6 and 5a/5b, 0050's database function, §27.4, §59A's `ownedFrom` and the seller's cut-off, the listing of a purchase, the allocation's default `effectiveDate`) reads `ownershipStart`; the check and the AfA keep reading `economicTransferDate`. §27.1's response field `transferDate` **is** `ownershipStart` (its meaning as §58K's "Unchanged guarantees" state it: "the day the buyers' Ownerships begin"); `economicTransferDate` is the recorded date. For every Acquisition not dated by this command the two are what they are today.
  - **The notice („die Ownership-Meldung“):** when `ownershipStart` ≠ `economicTransferDate`, the flag **`OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER`** with `details: { acquisitionId, ownershipStart, economicTransferDate }`, on the Acquisition's read (a new `flags` list, additive), on §59A's purchase component and, by it, in the tax-year view's AfA. Its level is open question 5 (proposal: `INFORMATIVE`).
  - **Consequences named:** the buyers hold the share from the contract date while their AfA starts at the transfer (no AfA between the two; the months as §59A); a seller's tenure and AfA end on `contractDate − 1`, the ownership end, not at the transfer (§59A's cut-off finds the Acquisition by `ownershipStart`); the flag names both.

### Example (synthetic)

PropertyReference P. Acquisition L: `contractDate` **2025-03-01**, no `economicTransferDate`, buyer A, seller S, `acquiredShare` `"1/1"`, price 200,000.00, a confirmed allocation with building 160,000.00 (the anschaffungsnahe threshold 15 % = 24,000.00), **confirmed before VC-X-34** (legacy). A's Ownership O_A `"1/1"` from 2025-03-01 carrying L; S's row ends 2025-02-28. A repair of 30,000.00 net, `MAINTENANCE` / `DEDUCTIBLE`, performed 2025-04-07 – 2025-04-25.

- **Before:** the check `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (`TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`, `{ contractDate: "2025-03-01" }`); the AfA component `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING` in every year; every year of P from 2025 on not final (`ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL`).
- **The command:** `POST …/acquisitions/L/economic-transfer-date` with `{ "economicTransferDate": "2025-05-01", "sourceReferences": ["Übergabeprotokoll 2025-05-01 (synthetisch)"] }` → `200`, `version` + 1, AuditRecord `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED`.
- **After, under (b):** the check's window 2025-05-01 – 2028-05-01; the repair, performed before it, is outside the window and not summed; the check is computed (its status and `final` by §58B's rules as for any dated Acquisition). The AfA starts in May 2025 (months as §59A: 8/12 of the year's amount in 2025). O_A stays from 2025-03-01, `transferDate` (= `ownershipStart`) stays 2025-03-01, §27.4 still answers `CONFIRMED` with A's weight `1/1`, S's cut-off is unchanged; the flag `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` `{ ownershipStart: "2025-03-01", economicTransferDate: "2025-05-01" }`. **No figure of 2024 moves**, and in 2025 only the AfA (now computed) and the check differ; rent, interest, WEG and every other section are unchanged.
- **After, under (a):** O_A's `validFrom` 2025-05-01 and S's row's `validUntil` 2025-04-30 (with their AuditRecords); refused instead when, say, an allocation of L carries `effectiveDate` 2025-03-01.
- **Why the date matters:** read from the contract date (as before VC-X-34) the repair would lie in the window and, above 24,000.00, be flagged `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN`.
- **Counter-example:** a `DRAFT` L′ with `contractDate` 2025-03-01, no date and no Ownerships: the command with 2025-03-01 (the transfer on the contract date) → `200`; then the buyers' Ownerships from 2025-03-01 and `confirm` → `200` (requirement 0 met). A second command on L′ → `409 TRANSFER_DATE_ALREADY_SET`; one with 2025-02-28 on an undated Acquisition → `422 BEFORE_CONTRACT_DATE`.

### Migration 0067

- **(i) The date's guard** (`acquisition_frozen`, 0020, replaced): exactly one change of the Acquisition's data is allowed, `economic_transfer_date` from `NULL` to a date, together with `economic_transfer_recorded_at` from `NULL` to a time (and the evidence column of open question 2, if any), on a row whose `OLD.status` is `DRAFT` or `CONFIRMED`, with `NEW.status = OLD.status` and `version = OLD.version + 1`. Refused past the repository: a change of a set date (also to `NULL`), a date on a `CANCELLED` row, the date together with a status step, the date without `economic_transfer_recorded_at` (or the reverse), `version` not raised by exactly one, any other field. Everything else of 0020's function (frozen data, final statuses, `ACQUISITION_HAS_VALID_OWNERSHIPS`, `version` only with a step) is unchanged. 0020's CHECK `acquisition_transfer_dates` keeps the date on or after `contract_date`; a CHECK ties `economic_transfer_recorded_at IS NOT NULL` to `economic_transfer_date IS NOT NULL`.
- **(ii) Requirement 0 in the database:** the transition to `CONFIRMED` requires `economic_transfer_date IS NOT NULL` (raised as `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`, before requirements 1–6). Rows already `CONFIRMED` are untouched, **no backfill**. **Where:** the owner names `acquisition_frozen`; the transition's check lives in 0022's `acquisition_step` (which calls `acquisition_confirmation_violation`), while `acquisition_frozen` is 0020's. This spec puts requirement 0 into `acquisition_step` and the date's guard into `acquisition_frozen`, and `down` restores **both** verbatim (0022's `acquisition_step`, 0020's `acquisition_frozen`); open question 6 asks the owner to confirm the reading.
- **(iii) Under option (b):** 0050's `acquisition_confirmation_violation` is replaced only in its two `d :=` lines (`ownershipStart`: `contract_date` when `economic_transfer_recorded_at IS NOT NULL`, else `coalesce(economic_transfer_date, contract_date)`), so a `DRAFT` dated by the command is confirmed on the day its Ownerships begin, past the repository as through it (open question 4); `down` restores 0050's function verbatim. Under option (a) instead: `ownership_frozen` admits the moves of this command only (a marker the command sets in its transaction; specified with (a) if chosen).
- **`down`:** refuses while a row carries `economic_transfer_recorded_at` (the recorded dates and their evidence would lose their marker, and 0020's guard could no longer tell them from a created date); otherwise drops the new column(s) and restores the functions above verbatim.
- **Legacy test data, then:** `confirmAsBeforeVcX34` is replaced by a helper that **inserts** the legacy state directly as `CONFIRMED` (the owner's decision), not through the transition. Inserting a `CONFIRMED` row meets 0022's `acquisition_initial` (only `DRAFT`), 0020's `acquisition_party_frozen` (parties only with a `DRAFT`) and `ownership_acquisition_draft` (new Ownerships only for a `DRAFT`); how the helper passes them is open question 7. Its callers (`tax-weg.test-support.ts:350`, `depreciation-schedule.e2e.test.ts:431`, `tax-year-transfer-date.e2e.test.ts:83`, `:218`) switch to it; the VC-X-34 tests keep their legacy cases.
- No other table, column or CHECK changes. `docs/development/api-inventory.md` gains the route (`yarn api:inventory`).

### Effects

- **The anschaffungsnahe check** (§58K): computable from the recorded date; nothing else clears `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING` (§58K "Nothing clears it but the date"). A capitalisation on the check (`anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId`) is accepted again for work in the window (0066's guard reads the date).
- **The AfA** (§59A): the purchase component gets its start (`start.dateSource` `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE`) and is computed by §59A's rules; the per-owner parts and the tenure under (b) as before (`ownershipStart`), under (a) from the moved rows.
- **The tax-year view's finality** (§58C): `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` no longer names L in years outside the window; inside it, by §58B's `final`. A year can turn from `final: false` to `true` (the reverse of VC-X-34's release note, open question 8).
- **The change flags** (§58E `ATTRIBUTION_INPUT_CHANGED`, §58G `PROPERTY_PART_CHANGED`, §58H–§58J): not raised. The date is no input of an item's tax year or of a Loan split's property part (§58K "No interaction with VC-X-28/48/49/50/51's flags": "An `economicTransferDate` entered later would change the check, not a year or a part"); `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED` is no kind of their tables. The years it changes were not final while the date was missing (§58K), so no final year is reopened silently.
- **Recorded schedule versions** (§60): the date is an input of the purchase component, so `inputFingerprint` of every year of the component changes and a version recorded before shows `DEPRECIATION_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDED` (open) until a new version supersedes it. Under (a) the command is refused while such a version exists; under (b) nothing is refused. Productively no version exists (recording disabled).

### Tests the implementation needs

- **Domain (pure):** the command's plan: `DRAFT` and `CONFIRMED` the same; the order of checks (`400` → `404` → `409 ACQUISITION_CANCELLED` → `409 TRANSFER_DATE_ALREADY_SET` → `412` → `422`), each refusal alone and the first of two; the date **equal to** `contractDate` accepted, one day before refused `BEFORE_CONTRACT_DATE`; `sourceReferences` empty `400`; under (b) `ownershipStart` for a dated, an undated and a created-with-date Acquisition, and the flag only when they differ.
- **Repository (PostgreSQL):** the example: legacy L (inserted as `CONFIRMED` by the new helper) gets a computed check and AfA start after the command; a `DRAFT` without the date dated by the command and then confirmed (requirement 0 met), with and without existing Ownerships (open question 4); **`CANCELLED`** refused with nothing written; **already set** refused (the same date and another); **Realm isolation:** another Realm's Acquisition `404`, and its undated legacy row stays not computable in its own Realm; **history:** one `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED` with date, evidence and status, none on an Ownership under (b), none on a refusal; idempotent replay and a key with another payload; concurrency (RC) against `confirm` of the same `DRAFT` (both orders), against `cancel`, and two recordings.
- **Past the repository (0067)**, each with a counter-check (the guard neutralised, the test red): a raw change of a set date, a raw set to `NULL`, a raw date on a `CANCELLED` row, the date with a status step, the date without `economic_transfer_recorded_at`, a raw transition to `CONFIRMED` without the date (refused `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`; **counter-check:** with the date it passes); an existing undated `CONFIRMED` row untouched by `up`; **down:** refused with a recorded row, and after removing it `down` restores 0022's and 0020's (and under (b) 0050's) functions verbatim (compared with `pg_get_functiondef` before `up`), then `up` again.
- **Unchanged money sums:** the views of P for the years **before the transfer year** (2024 in the example) equal in every line, section, `result` and `owners` before and after the command; in the transfer year every section but the AfA equal; §27.4's parts unchanged under (b).
- **End to end:** `acquisition-transfer-date.e2e.test.ts` over HTTP: the example (the command, the check, the schedule, the views 2024–2029, the flag), the `DRAFT` path to `confirm`, the refusals, Realm B `404`, the AuditRecords; ACC7 and ACC8 unchanged.

**Mutations** that must turn the tests red (each applied alone, restored byte for byte): the `CANCELLED` check dropped; the already-set check dropped (a set date overwritten); `>` instead of `>=` against `contractDate` (the transfer on the contract date refused); the `DRAFT` status refused; the evidence minimum removed; `version` not raised; the AuditRecord dropped; the guard (i) admitting a change of a set date; the guard admitting a `CANCELLED` row; requirement 0 removed from the transition (ii); `down` without the restore of 0022's trigger; under (b): `ownershipStart` reading `economicTransferDate` (§27.4 answers `409`, the seller's cut-off lost), the flag raised when the dates are equal, the flag dropped.

### Open questions (decided)

1. **The rule for the Ownerships of a `CONFIRMED` Acquisition that began on the contract date, when the recorded date differs.** **Proposal: (b)**, the Ownerships stay; the recorded date starts only the check's window and the AfA; `ownershipStart` keeps every reader of today's `transferDate` where it is; the flag `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` names the difference („die Ownership-Meldung“). Small (one derived date, one flag), no history moved, nothing refused for later facts. **Alternative (a):** move the buyers' `validFrom` and the sellers' closing day to the recorded date under §28.1's locks, requirements 2–6 re-checked, refused while later facts rest on the old start (ownership changes, successor rows, an allocation's `effectiveDate`, a recorded version); legally closer for the seller's AfA end, but it relaxes `ownership_frozen` for the first time and leaves legacy data unrepairable whenever a later fact exists. **Open.** **Decided (as proposed; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04, Frage 1):** (b). The Ownerships stay; the recorded date starts the window and the AfA; `ownershipStart` stays the same for every reader of today; the notice names the difference. The alternative (a) is not taken: it would relax `ownership_frozen` for the first time and leave legacy data with later facts unrepairable; P2-D6 (the start on the contract date) is a model decision that does not tip over within VC-X-52.
2. **Where the evidence is stored.** **Proposal:** a column `economic_transfer_source_references` (`text[]`, set with the date, at least one entry, CHECK with it), shown as `economicTransferSourceReferences` in §27.1's response, besides the AuditRecord. **Alternatives:** the AuditRecord only (the evidence then readable only in the history); appended to `sourceReferences` (one list, but a frozen field changes and the evidence is no longer tied to the date). **Decided (as proposed; Frage 2):** the column `economic_transfer_source_references`, set with the date, at least one entry, CHECK. The evidence belongs to the fact, not only to the history.
3. **A date after today.** **Proposal:** allowed, as on create (§27.1 sets no upper bound; a `DRAFT`'s transfer is often fixed by the contract ahead of the day, and the evidence can be the contract clause). **Alternative:** `422 TRANSFER_DATE_IN_FUTURE` after today (Europe/Berlin), since the evidence of a transfer exists only after it; then create should get the same bound (a separate change). **Decided (as proposed; Frage 3):** a date after today is allowed; the contract often fixes the transfer ahead, and `create` has no upper bound either.
4. **A `DRAFT` that already carries Ownerships from the contract date.** **Proposal:** the same rule as for `CONFIRMED` (the owner's „denselben Regeln“): under (b) `ownershipStart` stays `contractDate`, so the existing rows meet requirement 2 and `confirm` passes (0067 (iii)); a `DRAFT` without Ownerships writes them from `ownershipStart` too. **Alternative:** for a `DRAFT` the recorded date is also the ownership start: the rows from the contract date are voided and written again (allowed on a `DRAFT`), but a seller's row closed on `contractDate − 1` cannot be extended (§26.1), so a gap shows as `INCOMPLETE` and the seller's year as `DISPOSAL_DATE_MISSING` (§59A). **Decided (as proposed; Frage 4):** the same rule (b) for a `DRAFT`; existing rows from the contract date meet requirement 2, `confirm` passes. **Superseded for the future by §58R** (VC-X-57, migration 0073; Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-06, §58R Frage 2): before the confirmation a recorded date is the ownership start, so a `DRAFT` dated by this command is confirmed on `economicTransferDate` and its rows from the contract date are refused (repair: §58Q's act, or void and rewrite); a `DRAFT` confirmed under this rule before 0073 keeps it (§58R rule 1, branch 4). The decision stays quoted here and below.
5. **The level of `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER`** (under (b)). **Proposal:** `INFORMATIVE`: it holds no year open, otherwise the legacy data VC-X-52 is meant to repair would stay not final. **Alternatives:** `OPEN`, cleared by an acknowledgement (§58E Part 2's routes with a new kind); or `OPEN` without acknowledgement (every such year stays not final for good). **Decided, differing from the proposal (Frage 5):** not only informative. `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` is `OPEN` as soon as a seller of the same Acquisition in the same Realm has an AfA component, else `INFORMATIVE`: between contract and transfer nobody would get AfA, a wrong figure in DE, not a mere notice; with an external seller DE computes nothing wrong. The `OPEN` is closed by an acknowledgement of §58E Part 2 with the new kind `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER`, so legacy data stays repairable. A new backlog row (**VC-X-55**) takes the actual correction: extending a seller Ownership closed on `contractDate − 1` up to the transfer, with evidence, as an amendment of §26.1.
6. **Where requirement 0 sits in the database.** **Proposal:** in 0022's `acquisition_step` (the trigger that checks the transition), the date's guard in 0020's `acquisition_frozen`; `down` restores both verbatim. This reads the owner's „Der Trigger acquisition_frozen …“ and „down stellt den Trigger aus 0022 wörtlich wieder her“ together (the transition's trigger is 0022's). **Alternative:** both rules in `acquisition_frozen` (literally as worded); `down` then restores 0020's `acquisition_frozen` and leaves 0022's trigger unchanged. **Decided (as proposed; Frage 6):** requirement 0 in 0022's `acquisition_step`, the date's guard in 0020's `acquisition_frozen`, `down` restores both verbatim (the owner: „Meine Formulierung „acquisition_frozen“ war ungenau; der Übergangs-Trigger ist der richtige Ort.“).
7. **How the legacy helper inserts a `CONFIRMED` row.** **Proposal:** one transaction in the test's own schema: `ALTER TABLE … DISABLE TRIGGER` for exactly `acquisition_initial`, `acquisition_party_frozen` and `ownership_acquisition_draft` (no other trigger: 0019's invariants and the frozen guards still run), insert the Acquisition as `CONFIRMED` with `confirmed_at`, its parties and the buyers' Ownerships from the contract date, re-enable, and assert `acquisition_confirmation_violation(id) IS NULL` (the state a confirmation before VC-X-34 produced). The pattern exists (`depreciation-schedule-source.test.ts:512`). **Alternatives:** the old transition in a schema migrated to 0066 and then `up` to 0067 (the most faithful, slower, one schema per such test); or `SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica` (needs a superuser, the test role is none, and it also turns off the foreign keys). **Decided (as proposed; Frage 7):** the legacy helper disables exactly the three triggers in one transaction and checks `acquisition_confirmation_violation(id) IS NULL` at the end.
8. **The release note and §58K.** **Proposal:** VC-X-52's release note says that legacy data can now be dated, that years of its PropertyReference can turn from `final: false` to `true`, that a new Acquisition can no longer be confirmed without the date past the repository either, and (under (b)) that `transferDate` stays the ownership start; §58K "As implemented (VC-X-34)" 12's last sentence becomes "VC-X-52 (§58N) records the date". **Alternative:** no note of its own, only §58K's sentence changed. **Decided (as proposed; Frage 8):** a release note of its own; §58K's sentence 12 becomes "VC-X-52 (§58N) records the date".

**Decided by the owner on 2026-11-04 (chat)** (verbatim; cited as „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04“):

„Alle acht beantwortet. Abweichung nur bei Frage 5, und die folgt dem Review von #267.

- **1: (b), wie vorgeschlagen.** Die Ownerships bleiben, das erfasste Datum startet nur Fenster und AfA, `ownershipStart` bleibt für alle heutigen Leser gleich, die Meldung nennt die Abweichung. (a) würde `ownership_frozen` zum ersten Mal lockern und Altbestand mit späteren Fakten unreparierbar lassen. P2-D6 (Beginn am Vertragsdatum) ist eine Modellentscheidung, die nicht nebenbei in VC-X-52 kippt.
- **2: wie vorgeschlagen.** Eigene Spalte `economic_transfer_source_references`, mit dem Datum gesetzt, mindestens ein Eintrag, CHECK. Der Beleg gehört an den Fakt, nicht nur in die Historie.
- **3: wie vorgeschlagen.** Ein Datum nach heute ist erlaubt; der Vertrag legt den Übergang oft voraus fest, und `create` kennt auch keine Obergrenze.
- **4: wie vorgeschlagen.** Für `DRAFT` dieselbe Regel (b); bestehende Zeilen ab Vertragsdatum erfüllen Anforderung 2, `confirm` läuft durch.
- **5: nicht nur informativ.** `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` ist `OPEN`, sobald ein Verkäufer derselben Anschaffung im selben Realm eine AfA-Komponente hat, sonst `INFORMATIVE`. Das Review hat recht: zwischen Vertrag und Übergang bekäme sonst niemand AfA, und das ist eine falsche Zahl in DE, kein bloßer Hinweis. Bei einem externen Verkäufer rechnet DE nichts Falsches, also informativ. Das `OPEN` wird durch eine Quittierung über §58E Teil 2 geschlossen, neuer Kind `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER`; damit bleibt Altbestand reparierbar. Dazu eine neue Backlog-Zeile für die eigentliche Korrektur: das Verlängern einer am `contractDate − 1` geschlossenen Verkäufer-Ownership bis zum Übergang mit Beleg, als Änderung von §26.1, denn heute kann das niemand.
- **6: wie vorgeschlagen.** Anforderung 0 in 0022s `acquisition_step`, der Datumswächter in 0020s `acquisition_frozen`, `down` stellt beide wörtlich her. Meine Formulierung „acquisition_frozen“ war ungenau; der Übergangs-Trigger ist der richtige Ort.
- **7: wie vorgeschlagen.** Der Altbestand-Helfer schaltet in einer Transaktion genau die drei Trigger ab und prüft am Ende `acquisition_confirmation_violation(id) IS NULL`. Die Migrations-Variante ist treuer, aber ein Schema je Test; die Replica-Rolle braucht Superuser und schaltet Fremdschlüssel ab.
- **8: wie vorgeschlagen.** Eigene Release-Note, §58K Satz 12 wird zu „VC-X-52 (§58N) erfasst das Datum“.

Reihenfolge bleibt: VC-X-52 jetzt mit 0067, VC-X-27 danach. Kein Vorziehen.“

**Still open (owner):** none. Open questions 1–8 are decided (2026-11-04, above): 1–4 and 6–8 as proposed (the alternatives not taken), 5 differing from the proposal. **Follow-up backlog row the decisions create:** VC-X-55 (extending a seller Ownership closed on `contractDate − 1` up to the transfer, with evidence; an amendment of §26.1; question 5).

### As implemented (VC-X-52)

Implemented as specified, with the owner's decisions of 2026-11-04 (questions 1–8; „Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-04“); where this section and the decisions differ, the decisions win (deviations below). **Migration 0067** (`0067_acquisition_transfer_date_record`, the next free number on main). One route added (`POST /acquisitions/{acquisitionId}/economic-transfer-date`); `docs/development/api-inventory.md` regenerated with `yarn api:inventory`. Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here touches it. Paths relative to `services/de-backend/src/`.

1. **The command** (`api/acquisitions.ts`, `application/acquisitions.ts` `recordEconomicTransferDate`, `domains/acquisition/transfer-date.ts`, `infrastructure/postgres/acquisition-transfer-date.ts`): the body strict; `sourceReferences` 1–10 strings, trimmed, 1–500 each, an empty or missing list `400 REQUIRED`; `notes` trimmed (empty is `null`), recorded in the AuditRecord only. `planRecordTransferDate` keeps §58N's order after `400`/`404`: `409 ACQUISITION_CANCELLED` (also with a stale `If-Match`) → `409 TRANSFER_DATE_ALREADY_SET` with `details.economicTransferDate` (also for the same date and for a date set on create) → `412` → `422 BEFORE_CONTRACT_DATE` with `details.contractDate`; a date after today is accepted (question 3). `200` with the Acquisition, `ETag`, `version` + 1, the status, `confirmedAt` and every cost, payment, allocation and Ownership unchanged. One AuditRecord `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED` with `economicTransferDate`, `sourceReferences`, `notes`, `contractDate`, `status` and `ownershipStart`; none on an Ownership, none on a refusal. Idempotency scope `acquisition.transfer-date.record`, fingerprint the id and the normalized body; replay `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, another payload `409`. Locks: key → PropertyReference (no-op write) → Acquisition `FOR UPDATE` → plan → write → AuditRecord → key, one READ COMMITTED transaction.
2. **`ownershipStart`** (question 1, option (b); `domains/acquisition/acquisition.ts`) replaces the function `transferDate`: the contract date once `economicTransferRecordedAt` is set, else `economicTransferDate ?? contractDate`. Every reader switched: `planConfirm`, `structureViolations` and `buyerIncreases` (§28.1, §28.1A), the repository's `confirm` (`infrastructure/postgres/acquisition-repository.ts`), §27.4 (`infrastructure/postgres/owner-allocation-source.ts`), §59A's `ownedFrom` (`domains/depreciation/schedule.ts`), the seller's cut-off (`domains/depreciation/purchase-tenure.ts`, `item-part.ts`, `recording-stage.ts`; the inline `economicTransferDate ?? contractDate` gone), the listing of a purchase in a year (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-depreciation.ts`), the allocation's default `effectiveDate` (`infrastructure/postgres/land-building-allocation-repository.ts`, the SQL `coalesce` now a `CASE` on `economic_transfer_recorded_at`), §27.1's response field `transferDate`, and in the database 0050's `acquisition_confirmation_violation` and `acquisition_increase_violation` (their `d :=` lines, migration 0067 (iii)). The check (§58K) and the AfA start (§59A) read `economicTransferDate` alone, unchanged. `ScheduleAcquisition` carries `economicTransferRecordedAt` (optional; read by `infrastructure/postgres/depreciation-schedule-source.ts`).
3. **The response** (§27.1, additive): `economicTransferRecordedAt`, `economicTransferSourceReferences` (question 2) and `flags`.
4. **The flag** (question 5, decided differing from the proposal): `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` when `ownershipStart` ≠ `economicTransferDate`, `details: { acquisitionId, ownershipStart, economicTransferDate }`. **"A seller has an AfA component"** is read as: a seller of the Acquisition holds a `VALID` Ownership of the same PropertyReference in the same Realm carrying another, not cancelled Acquisition, i.e. a part of a purchase component of §59A (`infrastructure/postgres/ownership-start-reads.ts`, `sellersWithAfaComponent`; `domains/depreciation/purchase-work.ts` reads the same from the schedule's Ownerships). It shows:
   - on the Acquisition's read (`flags[]`, with `level` `OPEN` or `INFORMATIVE`; `infrastructure/postgres/acquisition-rows.ts`);
   - on §59A's purchase component (`flags[]`, `details.level` the decided level; `domains/depreciation/purchase-work.ts`);
   - as a **year flag of the tax-year view** (`domains/taxation/ownership-start-changes.ts`) in every year the gap `[ownershipStart, economicTransferDate − 1]` touches, `details` a list of entries `{ acquisitionId, ownershipStart, economicTransferDate, level, auditRecordId, recordedAt, changeFingerprint, acknowledgement }`; open while an `OPEN` entry has no matching `ACTIVE` acknowledgement (`domains/taxation/tax-year-review.ts`), informative otherwise. The transfer on the contract date raises nothing, and neither does a `CANCELLED` Acquisition (a `DRAFT` dated, then cancelled): `ownershipStartFlag` returns no flag for it, `ownershipStartFactsOf` reads no cancelled one, so the view shows no entry and an acknowledgement of the kind answers `409 CHANGE_NOT_FLAGGED` (review of #268).
5. **The acknowledgement** (§58E Part 2, the new kind): the change is the `ECONOMIC_TRANSFER_DATE_RECORDED` record on the entity `Acquisition`, `items: []`, the fingerprint §58E's canonical JSON over the empty list; the command's snapshot reads the same facts (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-statement-repository.ts`, `application/tax-statements.ts`), `kind` accepts `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` (`api/tax-statements.ts`); no item row is written. A withdrawal opens the year again.
6. **Migration 0067** (question 6): `economic_transfer_recorded_at` and `economic_transfer_source_references` with the CHECKs `acquisition_transfer_record` (time and evidence together, only with the date) and `acquisition_transfer_source_references` (1–10 entries, none `NULL`, none empty); 0020's `acquisition_frozen` admits exactly the one change (the date from `NULL` with its time and evidence on a `DRAFT` or `CONFIRMED` row, no status step, `version` + 1, nothing else) and refuses every other change of the three columns; 0022's `acquisition_step` refuses the transition to `CONFIRMED` without the date (`TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`) before requirements 1–6; 0050's two functions read `ownershipStart`; `tax_year_acknowledgement` (0065's CHECKs) gains the kind on the entity `Acquisition`, the shape guard (0065's function) refuses any item of it. No existing row changes, no backfill. `down` refuses (`23514`) while a recorded date or an acknowledgement of the new kind exists, else restores every function and CHECK verbatim and drops the columns.
7. **Legacy test data** (question 7): `infrastructure/postgres/legacy-acquisition.test-support.ts` `insertConfirmedAsBeforeVcX34` replaces `confirmAsBeforeVcX34`: one transaction, exactly `acquisition_initial`, `acquisition_party_frozen` and `ownership_acquisition_draft` disabled, the Acquisition inserted `CONFIRMED` with its parties and the buyers' Ownerships from the contract date (sellers' rows named in `close` ended the day before, first), the triggers enabled again, `acquisition_confirmation_violation(id) IS NULL` asserted (else rolled back). Its callers switched: `infrastructure/postgres/tax-weg.test-support.ts`, `depreciation-schedule.e2e.test.ts` (C's undated purchase: B's row closed and C's row inserted by the helper instead of the ownership change), `tax-year-transfer-date.e2e.test.ts` (the K4 refusal kept on a `DRAFT` of its own PropertyReference, the legacy Q inserted), and the new `api.legacy` of `phase-8-acceptance.test-support.ts`. Three existing tests confirmed an undated row raw and now carry the date: `infrastructure/postgres/acquisition-cost-repository.test.ts` (records it first), `loan-allocation-repository.test.ts` (inserted with it); `acquisition-increase-repository.test.ts`'s 0049-schema case inserts its drafts raw (the repository reads 0067's columns). `api/acquisitions.test.ts` (the additive fields) and `phase-2-acceptance.e2e.test.ts` (the route table) name the change.

| M16 | the acknowledgement does not close the flag | `domains/taxation/ownership-start-changes.ts` | 2 | acquisition-transfer-date.e2e.test.ts, domains/taxation/ownership-start-changes.test.ts |

11. **Release note (question 8):** an Acquisition confirmed before VC-X-34 without `economicTransferDate` (legacy data) can now be dated with `POST /acquisitions/{id}/economic-transfer-date` and its evidence; its anschaffungsnahe check and its AfA become computable, and tax years of its PropertyReference can turn from `final: false` to `true`. A new Acquisition can no longer be confirmed without the date, also not past the repository (migration 0067). `transferDate` stays the day the Ownerships begin (`ownershipStart`); where it lies before the recorded transfer, `OWNERSHIP_START_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_TRANSFER` names the gap: open, until acknowledged, when a seller of the purchase has an AfA component in DE, else informative. No figure of a year before the transfer moves.

**Deviations:**

1. **Question 5 differs from §58N's proposal** (the owner's decision wins): `OPEN` with an in-Realm seller having an AfA component, closed by an acknowledgement of the new kind; `INFORMATIVE` otherwise. The kind CHECK, the entity CHECK, `_kind_entity` and the shape guard of 0065 are widened by 0067.
2. **Where the `OPEN` lives:** an acknowledgement is per PropertyReference and tax year (§58E Part 2), the schedule (§59A) has none. So on §59A's component the code is informative by code (`INFORMATIVE_CODES`: the buyers' figures are right and stay `CALCULATED`), its `details.level` names the decided level, and the open state and its closing are the tax-year view's year flag in the years of the gap; the view's AfA carries the component flag as informative. On the Acquisition's read `level` is the decided level without an acknowledgement state.
3. **"A seller has an AfA component"** is read through the Ownerships (a `VALID` Ownership of the same PropertyReference carrying another, not cancelled Acquisition), not through the existence of a depreciation asset: the part of a §59A purchase component exists as soon as an asset of the PropertyReference is created, so the level does not change when the asset is entered later.
4. **The functions are patched in place:** 0067 reads each function's definition with `pg_get_functiondef`, replaces the one changed passage (checked to occur exactly once) and executes it; `down` replaces it back. The result is the same as restating the functions, and `down` returns them verbatim by construction (the test compares the definitions).
5. **The evidence CHECK** covers 1–10 entries, no `NULL`, no empty string; trimming and the 500 characters are the API's (a CHECK cannot look into each array element without a function).
6. **A date recorded past the repository without its AuditRecord** has no entry in the tax-year view's flag (there is no record a person could acknowledge); the Acquisition's read and the schedule still show it. The command always writes the record.
7. **The legacy helper writes no AuditRecords** for the row it inserts (as a migration finds the state, not the way to it); the tests of history count only the command's records.
