# 59F. The Date of Performance for the Anschaffungsnahe Check and Capitalised Items (VC-X-38, implemented: migration 0058)

**Status:** specified and decided (the owner's decisions of 2026-11-02 on open questions 1–13, below; the points they left open are listed under "Still open (owner)" at the end, **all nine decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, third round** (239-1 … 239-9, there)), **implemented (VC-X-38, migration 0058, merged after #237's 0057; deviations in "As implemented (VC-X-38)" at the end of this section)**. **The third round's follow-ups** (239-6, 239-7, 239-8: VC-X-38 follow-up; 239-2: VC-X-38 Part 2, planned and separate) are listed in "Decided on 2026-11-02, third round: what follows" at the end of this section; the follow-up is implemented ("As implemented (VC-X-38)" 3, 4, 11, 13), and **VC-X-38 Part 2 is implemented (migration 0062, merged after #251's 0061; "As implemented (VC-X-38 Part 2)" at the end of this section)**. Productive AfA recording stays disabled. **Migration: the next free number at implementation** (0053–0055 are taken by §59C, §59D and §59E; 0058 if merged after VC-X-41 Part 1 (0056) and VC-X-39 (0057), a lower number if merged before either; Kysely's Migrator refuses a migration whose name sorts before one already applied, so the number is fixed only by the merge order). It amends §56/§58B (a classification gains the period of performance; the anschaffungsnahe check measures it instead of the booking date; the edge flags and the strip after the window are withdrawn), §59B (a building's capitalised item starts in the year its work was completed), §60 (the stored item component and its fingerprint) and the parameters of `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` and `DE_AFA_BUILDING_LINEAR@1`/`@2`, all in place. The window (§58B), the threshold, the exact comparison, the basis (§59A, §59D), the cash years of every source (§58A), § 82b and §59B's rate, pools, owners and refunds are unchanged.

**Why:** the tax review of 2026-11-01 (`docs/germany/pruefbericht-2026-11-01.md`), questions 5, 14, 16 and 20 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01). Question 14, "Berechnung muss geändert werden", falls Zahlungs-/Rechnungsdatum maßgeblich: „maßgeblich die Durchführung; Frist taggenau ab Übergang des wirtschaftlichen Eigentums; bei fristüberschreitenden Maßnahmen die bis Fristende erbrachten Leistungen (ggf. geschätzt). Datenfelder: Leistungsbeginn, Teilleistungen, Abnahme, anteilige Kosten bis Fristende“. Question 16: for maintenance paid from the Hausgeld „Zeitpunkt die erbrachte Bauleistung; ohne Leistungsdaten manuelle Prüfung“. Question 5, "Muss geändert werden", falls nur monatsanteilig: later Herstellungskosten count from the start of the year in which they arise (R 7.4 Abs. 9 S. 3 EStR), „auch umqualifizierte anschaffungsnahe Aufwendungen in ihren Entstehungsjahren; maßgeblich die Leistung, nicht automatisch Rechnungs-/Zahlungsdatum“. Question 20: after a re-qualification, the AfA of the years in which the costs arose („Entstehungsjahr → VC-X-38“ in the report's column). The report lists `DATE_IS_BOOKING_DATE` and `DATES_NEAR_WINDOW_EDGE` under „Nicht auflösbar, weil die Antwort DE widerspricht“, and the P0 items „15-%-Prüfung taggenau anhand tatsächlich erbrachter Bauleistungen“ (not met) and „Nachträgliche HK in den zutreffenden Entstehungsjahren“ (partly met). The confirmation covers the legal statements, not DE's calculation (the report's own reservation).

### As the code stands (main, before VC-X-38)

- **The check's date is the source's date.** `CheckSource.date` is "the booking date, the withdrawal's (or assumed) date, the use's date" (`domains/taxation/anschaffungsnahe.ts:34–35`); the window filter is `s.date >= window.from && s.date <= window.until` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:198`). A split enters with `date: meaning.bookingDate` (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-treatment-effects.ts:89` and `:142`).
- **The edges are a constant, not a rule parameter.** `BOOKING_DATE_EDGE_DAYS = 90` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:27`) drives `DATE_IS_BOOKING_DATE` (`edgeFlag`, `anschaffungsnahe.ts:210–218`), the strip after the window (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:221–226`) and `DATES_NEAR_WINDOW_EDGE` (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:269`). `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` (`domains/taxation/rules/de-anschaffungsnahe.ts:25–40`) has `thresholdPercent`, `windowYears`, `taxCategories`, `countedTreatments` and `excludedCostCategories` only.
- **The read is bounded by booking dates.** `checkRange` (`infrastructure/postgres/tax-property-context.ts:263–276`) spans each window and 90 days after it, and `effectsOf` reads the counting splits with `t.booking_date` in that range (`tax-treatment-effects.ts:80–84`), the WEG sources by their date (`:92`). A repair carried out in the third year and paid more than 90 days after the window, or paid before the transfer for work after it, is never read (the report: „Weiter vom Rand entfernte Fälle … bleiben unerkannt“).
- **The window's start** is `coalesce(economic_transfer_date, contract_date)` (`tax-property-context.ts:215`, and 0047's guard, `migrations/0047_tax_weg_spending.ts:255`): VC-X-34's, not changed here.
- **A capitalisation on the check** is refused unless the source's date lies in the window: `classification-checks.ts:141` (`OUTSIDE_WINDOW`) and 0047's `tax_classification_anschaffungsnahe` (booking date of the split, the withdrawal's date or the period's end, the use's date; `0047_tax_weg_spending.ts:260–280`, the 3 years literally).
- **A classification has no date of its own** besides `taxYear` and `refundOfYear` (`domains/taxation/tax-classification.ts:13–55`); the check-only facts `netAmount`, `annuallyRecurring` and `anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId` already live there.
- **A capitalised item's date** is the share date of the view: `date = split ? meaning.bookingDate : meaning.date` (`domains/taxation/capitalized-items.ts:56`), `dateSource` `BOOKING`, `WITHDRAWAL` or `USE`; it decides both the owners (`participantsOn`, `:58`) and the start (`domains/depreciation/capitalized-item.ts:30`). On a building `startMonth = year * 12` for `START_OF_YEAR` (`domains/depreciation/schedule-items.ts:76–78`; the parameter `subsequentCostStart` at `domains/depreciation/rules/de-afa-building-linear.ts:144–149`, `verified: false`), `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` when the item's tax year differs from that year (`schedule-items.ts:103`). The report cites `de-afa-building-linear.ts:119–124`; the parameter moved with the VERIFY PR of 2026-11-01.
- **`DATE_IS_BOOKING_DATE` never reaches an item.** §59B says the item carries it (informative), and `CARRIED_FLAGS` names it (`schedule-items.ts:192`), but `checkFlagsOf` passes only `VAT_NOT_SEPARATED`, `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` and `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NO_LONGER_ABOVE` to a meaning (`anschaffungsnahe.ts:359–361`), so no meaning, and no item, carries it. Dead today; withdrawn below.
- **Not pinned:** `infrastructure/hashing/frozen-rules.test.ts:16–25` pins `DE_CATEGORY_DEFAULTS@1` and the three AfA versions; `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` has no pinned hash.

### The fact: the period of performance on a classification (open questions 1 and 2, decided 2026-11-02)

A classification (§56, §58B) gains **`performance`** (optional, `null` by default): when the work it pays for was carried out. It is a fact of the classification as `netAmount` is: recorded as entered, never changed, corrected by a new classification that supersedes it (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02).

| Field | Values | The report (question 14) |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | business date, required | Leistungsbeginn |
| `until` | business date, required, ≥ `from` | Abnahme / completion; a one-day job has `from` = `until` |
| `progress` | 0–5 entries `{ through, amount }`: `through` a date with `from` ≤ `through` < `until`, strictly ascending; `amount` Money > 0, strictly ascending, each below the source's **amount used** (`netAmount`, else the gross amount, §58B) | Teilleistungen; anteilige Kosten bis Fristende: `amount` is the cumulative part of the amount used that was performed up to and including `through` |
| `progressEstimated` | boolean, required with `progress` not empty | „ggf. geschätzt“ |

- **Allowed on** a classification of a split, a withdrawal or a use with `taxCategory` `MAINTENANCE` or `WEG_SPENDING` (any treatment but `NOT_RELEVANT`), and with `treatment` `CAPITALIZED` of any other category (a later Herstellungskosten item of §59B). **Not on interest** (§59E: interest is never part of the 15 % check, §58B reads `MAINTENANCE` and `WEG_SPENDING` only, and its date is its booking date or later its interest period, §59E open question 6): a split that is interest by §59E's list ("Which splits are interest"), or a `taxCategory` `LOAN_INTEREST` or `FINANCING_COSTS`, refuses it. Not on a deposit closing.
- **Plausibility:** `from` and `until` lie within `plausibleYearsFromSourceDate` (3) years before or after the source's date (§58B's proposal of open question 9), else `422 PERFORMANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE`. Both directions: an invoice paid long after the work and an advance payment before it are both real.
- **Review:** the classification's `reviewState` covers it. The check reads it from the current classification whatever its review state, as it reads `netAmount` (§58B); a capitalised item needs a confirmed classification anyway (§59B, `capitalizedItemReviewStates`).
- **Evidence** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: „Zeitraum und belegte kumulierte Leistungsanteile“): the classification's `sourceReferences` (the invoice, the Abnahmeprotokoll, the WEG administrator's statement, a contractor's statement of progress).
  - A classification with `progress` needs at least one source reference, else `422 PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`.
  - A classification with `progressEstimated: true` is recorded as entered, but its points are **not evidenced shares**: the check and the items read it as if it had no points (bounds from `from` and `until` only), and its entry carries `PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_ESTIMATED` (informative). Whether an estimate may count („ggf. geschätzt“, question 14), for instance one the advisor accepts, is still open (below).
- **Never the booking date** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02): a missing performance is never replaced by the booking, payment, invoice or statement date, neither in the check nor for an item's start.
- **One source, one period:** a split or a WEG source paying several measures is one period from the first start to the last completion, with `progress` for the parts; a more precise split is a cash correction (VC-1-11), not a classification.

### The check measures the performance (§58B, amended)

For an Acquisition with window [S, W] (§58B, both inclusive) and a summed source (the filter of §58B unchanged: `MAINTENANCE` / `WEG_SPENDING` with `DEDUCTIBLE`, `DISTRIBUTED_82B`, or `CAPITALIZED` on this check; not `annuallyRecurring`), DE derives the source's **part in the window** as two bounds in cents, `lower` ≤ `upper`, never estimated:

- **A source with `performance`:** let `cum(t)` be the amount performed up to and including day `t`: 0 before `from`, the amount used from `until` on, `amount` at each progress point. Where `cum` is not known exactly, `cumLow(t)` is the value at the latest known point on or before `t` and `cumHigh(t)` the value at the earliest known point on or after `t`. Then `lower = cumLow(W) − cumHigh(S − 1)` and `upper = cumHigh(W) − cumLow(S − 1)`, each at least 0.
  - performed wholly in the window (`S` ≤ `from`, `until` ≤ `W`): `lower` = `upper` = the amount used, exact;
  - performed wholly outside (`until` < `S` or `from` > `W`): 0 and 0; listed in `excluded` with the reason **`PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW`**, whatever its booking date (a repair the seller ordered and the buyer paid after the transfer; work after the window paid inside it);
  - **across the window's end:** a progress point with `through` = `W` makes the part exact (the report's „anteilige Kosten bis Fristende“); without one the part lies between the evidenced points around `W` (0 and the whole amount without points). No part is ever spread by calendar days (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02). The entry carries **`PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW`** (`details: { edge: "END", lower, upper }`);
  - **across the transfer date** (begun before it): by the same formula only the evidenced part performed from `S` on counts, never a share by calendar days (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 6), flagged `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` with `edge: "START"`.
- **A source without `performance`** whose own date lies in the **search range** (below): its part is unknown, `lower` = 0 and `upper` = the amount used. It is listed in the new list **`undetermined`** with the flag **`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`** (`details: { date, dateSource }`). Its booking date is shown, never used as the date of the work (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 3).
- **A refund** (`INFLOW`, negative): the bounds swap (its negative amount in `lower`, 0 in `upper`, without performance), so a refund never pushes a check over the threshold on a guess.
- **The search range and the sources outside it** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 4: „Suchgrenzen von 90/365 Tagen dürfen keine Vollständigkeit oder abschließende Prüfung begründen. Keine relevante Quelle allein wegen ihres Zahlungsdatums still ausschließen.“):
  - the sources with `performance` overlapping the window are read **whatever their booking date**;
  - the sources without `performance` whose own date lies from `undatedReadBeforeWindowDays` (90) before `S` to `undatedReadAfterWindowDays` (365) after `W`, the **search range**, are `undetermined` and in the upper bound;
  - a source without `performance` whose own date lies **outside the search range**, but within `plausibleYearsFromSourceDate` (3) years of the window, is **never dropped**. It is listed in the new list **`outsideSearchRange`**, with `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` on its meaning; it is not summed, and it keeps the check from being decided by the upper bound (below). A source further away could not take a performance in the window (the plausibility check above); the response names the search range and this outer bound, so it is visible what was searched (whether the outer bound stands is still open, below);
  - the search range therefore never makes the sources complete, and never alone makes a check final: it decides only which undated sources are summed in the upper bound.

**The outcome by the bounds** (as §59D decides by the basis's bounds): with `sumLower` and `sumUpper` the sums of the parts (× `acquiredShare` as today, compared exactly on fractions), and the threshold's bounds of §59D (equal while every cost is classified):

- `sumLower` above 15 % of the upper basis → **`ABOVE_THRESHOLD`** (above whatever the dates);
- `sumUpper` not above 15 % of the lower basis → **`NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`** (not above whatever the dates), **only with complete sources**: `outsideSearchRange` is empty. Otherwise **`NOT_COMPUTABLE`**, `notComputableReason` **`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: a final decision by the upper bound requires complete sources);
- otherwise **`NOT_COMPUTABLE`**, `notComputableReason` **`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`** (after §58B's five reasons and §59D's two; where both §59D's basis and the dates leave it open, §59D's reason is given and the `NOT_FINAL` reasons below name both).
- **`final`** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 7):
  - the new `NOT_FINAL` reason **`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`** when the outcome is `ABOVE_THRESHOLD` and `sumLower` ≠ `sumUpper`: the outcome holds, but whether each undetermined source is anschaffungsnah depends on its dates;
  - the new `NOT_FINAL` reason **`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`** whenever `outsideSearchRange` is not empty, whatever the outcome;
  - a `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` decided by `sumUpper` is final **only with complete sources**: none outside the search range and none of §58B's reasons, which all stay (`GROSS_AMOUNTS`, `UNCLASSIFIED_SOURCES`, `WINDOW_OPEN`, `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED`). Undated sources inside the search range are in its upper bound and do not hold it open;
  - `DATES_NEAR_WINDOW_EDGE` is withdrawn.
- **A final check confirms the check, not the tax year** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02): it states the threshold outcome of one Acquisition's window. It never makes a tax year `final`, closes no other flag of any year, and confirms neither the cash years of its sources nor an AfA figure; each tax year stays judged by §58C's own conditions.
- **Above 15 %:** `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` and the suggestion `CAPITALIZED` go to every source in `sources` **performed wholly in the window**, as today.
  - **A source straddling an edge is never suggested as a whole** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 8: „Bei Fristüberschreitung nicht die ganze Rechnung zur Aktivierung vorschlagen. Betroffenen Anteil ausweisen und belegte Aufteilung verlangen.“). Its entry shows the affected share (`inWindow`: exact with an evidenced point at the edge, else its bounds) with `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW`. Its meaning carries `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` with `details: { acquisitionId, inWindow, splitRequired: true }` and no suggested treatment.
  - An evidenced split is required before the share in the window can be capitalised; a capitalisation of the whole source on the check is refused (below). How the split is recorded is still open (below).
  - An `undetermined` or `outsideSearchRange` source gets no suggestion; its meaning carries `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` (informative there, with `details.acquisitionId`), so the user sees on the source which date the check wants.
- **`affectedYears`:** the tax years (§58A, the cash years) of the suggested sources, as today. The performance moves no cash year: a deductible repair stays in the year it was paid (§ 11 EStG), and § 82b distributes from that year as today.

**Withdrawn:** `DATE_IS_BOOKING_DATE` (the check's entry flag and §59B's carried flag), `DATES_NEAR_WINDOW_EDGE`, the strip after the window and the excluded reason `AFTER_WINDOW_NEAR_EDGE` (the undetermined list and `PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW` replace them), `BOOKING_DATE_EDGE_DAYS`. The owner's decision of #169 ("before the window's start nothing extra is read") is revised for sources with `performance`: an advance payment for work after the transfer counts by its performance (question 14: „maßgeblich die Durchführung“; decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 5: „Vorauszahlungen … anhand der tatsächlich erbrachten Leistungen beurteilen; keine automatische Verteilung nach Kalendertagen“).

**Response** (§58B's, additively): each entry gains `performance` (as stored, or `null`) and `inWindow: { lower, upper }` (Money); the check gains `undetermined` and `outsideSearchRange` (entries as `unclassified`), `searchRange` and `outerBound` (`{ from, until }` each), `sumUpper`, `attributableAmountUpper` and `percentOfBasisUpper` (equal to `sum`, `attributableAmount`, `percentOfBasis` when nothing is open); `sum`, `attributableAmount` and `percentOfBasis` are the lower bound. `excluded[].reason` takes `ANNUALLY_RECURRING` or `PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW`. The tax-year view's `acquisitions[].notFinalReasons` (§58C) shows the new reason; `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_CHECK_NOT_FINAL` (`tax-year-view.ts:200–201`) is raised as today, for a `NOT_COMPUTABLE` check too.

**A capitalisation on the check** (`anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId`, §58B) needs sufficient performance data (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 12): a create is `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE` with `details.reason` **`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`** and `details.cause` `MISSING` (no `performance`) or `STRADDLES_WINDOW` (`from` < `S` or `until` > `W`: only an evidenced split part performed in the window may be capitalised on the check). `OUTSIDE_WINDOW` is judged by the performance (`until` < `S` or `from` > `W`), no longer by the source's date. Existing classifications with the link and without `performance` are not changed (classifications are never edited, §57): they stay in the sum's upper bound, `undetermined`, until superseded.

### Capitalised items start in the year of completion (§59B, amended; open questions 9–11, decided 2026-11-02)

- **The start date of a building's item** is `performance.until` (completion, Abnahme), with `subsequentCostStart`'s method unchanged: `START_OF_YEAR` of that year, never before the owner's start (`notBeforeOwnerStart`, judged on the owner's tenure that holds the item's share date). R 7.4 Abs. 9 S. 3 EStR read with question 5: the costs arise when the work is done, not when the invoice is paid. An anschaffungsnahe item re-qualified later starts in the year its work was completed (question 20's „Entstehungsjahr“), so earlier years' AfA is derived anew on read, as every figure is (§59B; a recorded version shows `DEPRECIATION_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDED`, §60).
- **Without `performance`:** the item part is **not computable**, new reason **`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`** (`details: { date, dateSource, classificationId }`), in every year, amounts `null`, never 0.00; order after `LINKED_ITEM_NOT_CAPITALIZED`, before `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_CONFIRMED`. The booking year is not used in its place (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 10: „Aktivierte Posten ohne Leistungsangabe: `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`“).
- **A period across a year end** (`from` and `until` in different years; decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 9: „Mehrjährige Leistungen nicht pauschal ins Abschlussjahr legen. Ohne belastbare Jahreszuordnung bleibt der Posten nicht berechenbar.“): the item part is **not computable**, reason **`PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END`** (`details: { from, until, classificationId }`), in every year, amounts `null`, never 0.00; order directly after `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`. It is never put into the year of `until`. VC-X-38 models no yearly allocation: whether evidenced points at each 31 December the period spans give a reliable one, and how the item's yearly parts would then look, is still open (below).
- **What stays:** the item's **share date** (`date`, booking/withdrawal/use) still decides its owners and parts (§58C's per-item parts, „one function computes both“, P8-D8: who bore the cost when it was paid). The view's `capitalized` still follows the tax year (§58A). `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` keeps its code, compares the tax year with the start's year, and is **informative** when the start comes from `performance` (the difference is then the law's, not an assumption); `details` gain `startDate` and `dateSource`.
- **Not affected:** a separate asset's items (they start with `acquiredOn`, §59B; `performance` is ignored there, and `LATER_ITEM_TO_VERIFY` stays as it is); interest (`LOAN_INTEREST`, `FINANCING_COSTS`, §59E's sources) keeps its booking date and is exempt from `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`.
- **The component** gains `source.performance` (as stored) and `start.dateSource` `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL` (beside `ITEM_DATE` for an exempt item and `ACQUIRED_ON`).
- **The confirmed rule and the open reading, documented apart** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 11: „Die bestätigte Regel ‚Jahresbeginn des Entstehungsjahres‘ getrennt von noch offenen Auslegungen dokumentieren.“):
  - **confirmed:** `START_OF_YEAR` of the year in which the costs arise, the year following the performance (question 5, mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01; the report: „Methode ja; das Jahr folgt der Leistung → erst mit VC-X-38 vollständig“). `subsequentCostStart.verified` becomes `true` for this rule, and `SUBSEQUENT_COST_START_TO_VERIFY` is withdrawn;
  - **open reading of this spec, not confirmed:** `notBeforeOwnerStart` (an item whose year begins before the owner's start starts with the owner). It is a parameter of its own with `verified: false` (below). Where it changes an item's start, the component carries the open VERIFY flag **`SUBSEQUENT_COST_OWNER_START_TO_VERIFY`** (`details: { startYear, ownerStart }`). It does not block a record by itself (§60 open question 1), and it never reads as confirmed.

### The rules, in place (the owner's decision of 2026-11-01; §60 open question 11)

| Rule | Parameter | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` | `performance` (new) | `{ dateMeasured: "PERFORMANCE", undatedReadBeforeWindowDays: 90, undatedReadAfterWindowDays: 365, outsideSearchRange: "LISTED_NOT_DECIDED", plausibleYearsFromSourceDate: 3, progressEvidenceRequired: true, estimatedProgress: "NOT_EVIDENCED", straddlingSource: "SHARE_SHOWN_SPLIT_REQUIRED", legalBasis: "§ 6 Abs. 1 Nr. 1a EStG; BMF 20.10.2017, Rn. 1 ff. (Durchführung der Maßnahme)", source: "Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Fragen 14 und 16 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01)" }` |
| `DE_AFA_BUILDING_LINEAR@1`, `@2` | `subsequentCostStart` | `{ method: "START_OF_YEAR", date: "PERFORMANCE_UNTIL", performanceRequired: true, spansYearEnd: "NOT_COMPUTABLE", exemptTaxCategories: ["LOAN_INTEREST", "FINANCING_COSTS"], verified: true, legalBasis: "R 7.4 Abs. 9 S. 3 EStR; Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Frage 5 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01)", notBeforeOwnerStart: { value: true, verified: false, source: "api-design §59F (reading of this spec, not confirmed)" } }` |

- **`DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1`** keeps `effectiveFrom` 2004-01-01, `windowYears`, the threshold, the lines and treatments; its `source` gains the change note "VC-X-38 in place: Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Fragen 14, 16 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01); owner decision 2026-11-01, api-design §59F". **A pinned hash is added** to `frozen-rules.test.ts` with the change (it has none today); from the documented go-live of the first productive installation a change is `@2` (the Phase-7 freeze point; the AfA rules below freeze earlier, at the first enablement of recording). If §59D lands first, its parameter brings the pin and this change updates it explicitly, and the other way round.
- **`DE_AFA_BUILDING_LINEAR@1`/`@2`:** identical in both (a registry test asserts it, as for `basis`); the pinned hashes updated explicitly in the same commit, the comment naming question 5. `DE_AFA_MOVABLE_LINEAR@1` is not changed (no `subsequentCostStart`).
- **`DE_CASH_TIMING@1`, `DE_CATEGORY_DEFAULTS@1`, `DE_WEG_SPENDING@1`, `DE_82B_DISTRIBUTION@1`:** not changed.

### API (§56, §58B, amended)

- **`POST /api/v1/tax-classifications`:** the body gains `performance` (strict, optional). Field errors (`400`, all at once): `from` or `until` missing `REQUIRED`; `until` before `from`, a `through` outside [`from`, `until`), more than 5 points, points or amounts not strictly ascending `OUT_OF_RANGE`; a duplicate `through` `DUPLICATE`; an amount ≤ 0 `NOT_POSITIVE`; `progressEstimated` without points `NOT_ALLOWED`; `performance` with `NOT_RELEVANT`, with a category other than `MAINTENANCE`/`WEG_SPENDING` and a treatment other than `CAPITALIZED`, or on `DEPOSIT_CLOSING` → `NOT_ALLOWED_WITH_TREATMENT` (as `anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId`, §58B).
- **Order of checks** (§58B's, extended): after `422 NET_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS`: a split that is interest (§59E) → `400` `NOT_ALLOWED` at `performance` (as §59E's check 5, source-dependent); a progress amount not below the amount used → `422 PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT` (`details: { amountUsed, amount }`); `progress` without any source reference → `422 PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED` (decided 2026-11-02); a date outside the plausible years → `422 PERFORMANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE` (`details: { sourceDate, from, until, allowedFrom, allowedUntil }`); then the Acquisition `404` and `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE` (gaining `PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED` with `cause` `MISSING` or `STRADDLES_WINDOW`, `OUTSIDE_WINDOW` by the performance), as before.
- **Idempotency:** the fingerprint includes `performance` only when given (as VC-7-03's fields, `classificationFingerprint`), so a key stored before replays unchanged.
- **Responses:** the classification, both tax-meaning reads and the per-property list gain `performance`; the check as above; the schedule's item component as above.
- **AuditRecords:** `TAX_CLASSIFIED`'s metadata gains `performance`.
- **Error answers** (`api/error-answers/taxation.ts`): `PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT`, `PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED` and `PERFORMANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE` (`422`); the new reason of `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE`. No new route. VC-X-38 Part 2 adds, on the same `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE`: `reason` `PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED` with `cause` `SPLIT_NOT_EVIDENCED` (and `details.inWindow`) or `STRADDLES_START` (a partial treatment of a source begun before the transfer date), and `reason` `PARTIAL_TREATMENT_NOT_APPLICABLE` with `cause` `NOT_STRADDLING` ("As implemented (VC-X-38 Part 2)", point 3).

### In the database (migration: the next free number at implementation)

- **`tax_classification`** gains `performed_from`, `performed_until` (`date`, both null or both set, `performed_from <= performed_until`) and `performance_progress_estimated` (`boolean`, set exactly when progress rows exist, checked at commit); a CHECK that they are null with `NOT_RELEVANT` and on a deposit closing. The classification's frozen trigger (0047's `tax_classification_weg_source_fixed` list) covers the new columns.
- **`tax_classification_performance_progress`:** `classification_id`, `position` (1–5), `through` (`date`), `amount` (`numeric(14, 2)`, > 0); key `(classification_id, position)`; inserted only in its classification's transaction (as §59D's parts); a deferred trigger checks at commit that the points lie in [`performed_from`, `performed_until`) and ascend strictly in date and amount. The amount against the amount used is the repository's check (it needs the source), as `NET_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS` is.
- **0047's `tax_classification_anschaffungsnahe` is replaced:** with `anschaffungsnahe_acquisition_id` set, `performed_from`/`performed_until` are required and must lie within `transfer_date` to `transfer_date + interval '3 years'` (a straddling source is capitalised only by an evidenced split, decided 2026-11-02); the source's date is no longer compared. The transfer date stays `coalesce(…)` until VC-X-34.
- **The recorded versions (0052):** `depreciation_schedule_version_component` gains `item_performed_from`, `item_performed_until` (set together, only for `kind` `CAPITALIZED_ITEM`); `start_date_source` takes `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL`. Nothing productive is recorded, so **`up` refuses while any `depreciation_schedule_version` row exists**, naming the reset of a non-production database (as 0054).
- **No backfill** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 13): the migration sets no performance. **`down`** drops the columns and the table; with any row of performance it refuses.

### Recorded versions and the fingerprint (§60)

- **Stored inputs:** an item component's inputs gain `performance` (from, until; not the progress, which the check alone reads), so `computeSchedule(storedInputs)` re-derives the same start.
- **`inputFingerprint(Y)`** covers it from the component's first year: a superseding classification with another completion year changes the fingerprint of every year from the earlier of the two starts, and the comparison names the component (`INPUTS_CHANGED`). `SCHEDULE_CALCULATION_VERSION` stays 1; the rule hash changes with `subsequentCostStart`.
- **The record command** (§60 step 4) refuses a run with `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` or `PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END` (`409 SCHEDULE_NOT_COMPLETE`; its list gains the codes), at every release stage (§60A). Recording stays disabled; nothing here enables it.

### Effect on existing data, ACC7, ACC8 and the tests

- **Existing data:** every check with summed sources becomes `undetermined` for them until their performance is entered: a check whose sources are small stays `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` by the upper bound; one that was above becomes `NOT_COMPUTABLE` unless enough is dated. An undated source outside the search range now keeps a check from `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`. Every building item (except interest) is not computable until its classification is superseded with `performance`; an item whose work spans a year end stays not computable. No backfill (decided 2026-11-02). That is the intended correction (questions 14 and 5); the figures were computed on the booking date.
- **ACC7** (`phase-7-acceptance.e2e.test.ts:516–541`): the step "exactly 15 %" stays `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` (`sumUpper` 12,600.00 is not above 12,600.00); the step "above" (14,600.00) becomes `NOT_COMPUTABLE` with `PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN` (`sum` 0.00, `sumUpper` 14,600.00). **Proposal:** the four sources get `performance` in the month of their dates, and the test asserts both the step without (`NOT_COMPUTABLE`) and with (14,600.00, `ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, `percentOfBasis` "17.38", unchanged).
- **ACC8** (`phase-8-acceptance.e2e.test.ts:186–296`): the repair (2027-03-10) and the use (2028-02-15) get `performance` in the same months; the check (39,000.00 > 38,160.00) and the AfA (714.00 from 2027, 180.00 from 2028) do not change. **Proposal:** one step before the performance is entered shows the building's 2027 `PARTIAL` with `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` on the repair's component.
- **Existing tests** of the edge flags and the strip (the check's blocks of `domains/taxation/weg-spending.test.ts` and `tax-weg.e2e.test.ts`) are replaced by the tests below, and the fixtures that hand `DATE_IS_BOOKING_DATE` to an item (`schedule-items-owners.test.ts:255`, `domains/taxation/tax-year-depreciation.test.ts`, `infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-depreciation.test.ts`) drop it; the tests that build a capitalised building item (`schedule-items*.test.ts`, `depreciation-items.e2e.test.ts`, `tax-year-afa.e2e.test.ts`, the version tests and their support) gain `performance` in their fixtures; none is weakened. `frozen-rules.test.ts` takes the new hashes explicitly and the new pin.

### Tests the implementation must have

- **The check (pure):** the bounds for each case (inside, before, after, across the end with and without a point at `W`, across the start, a refund, a partial acquisition); the three outcomes by the bounds, each with the exact fraction (one cent below and above 15 %); combined with §59D's basis bounds; `final` with and without undetermined sources for each outcome; the parameters read from the rule (a test registry with other read days changes the search range and the result); `outsideSearchRange` (an undated source listed, not summed; the check `NOT_COMPUTABLE` with `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` where it would otherwise be `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` by the upper bound, and not final when above); a straddling source above 15 % shown with its share and without a suggestion; an estimated progress point ignored for the bounds; a final check leaving a tax year's other flags open and its `final` unchanged.
- **The read (PostgreSQL):** a dated source booked 117 days after the window (and two years after) is read and summed; an advance payment 13 days before the transfer with performance in the window is read; an undated source 91 days before and 366 days after is listed in `outsideSearchRange` and not summed, 90 and 365 are summed; one beyond the outer bound is not read, and the response names the bound; one snapshot; Realm isolation.
- **The classification:** every `400`, `422` and the order; interest refused (a `LOAN_INTEREST` split and a split classified `MAINTENANCE` whose financial category is `LOAN_INTEREST`); the link without performance refused (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `MISSING`), straddling the window refused (`STRADDLES_WINDOW`), by performance outside refused, wholly inside accepted although the booking date lies outside; progress without a source reference refused (`PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`); past the repository each guard with a counter-check (one date only, `from` after `until`, a point outside, a point added later, a changed column, the link without performance); the migration's `up` refusing with a recorded version, `down` refusing with a performance.
- **The items (pure):** the start by `until` (`START_OF_YEAR`); `notBeforeOwnerStart` against the share date's tenure; `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` (amounts `null` in the component, owner and property sums); `PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END` as a reason (amounts `null`, never in `until`'s year); `SUBSEQUENT_COST_OWNER_START_TO_VERIFY` exactly where `notBeforeOwnerStart` moves a start; `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` informative by performance, open otherwise; a separate asset's item and an interest item unaffected; the owners' parts unchanged by the performance.
- **End to end:** the example below literally.

### Counter-checks and mutations

**Counter-checks:** no check decided on a booking date; no undated source counted as certainly inside or outside; work performed in the window and paid late never lost; no item started in the payment year when its work was completed earlier; no 0.00 in place of a missing start; no cash year moved by a performance; no relevant source dropped silently by its payment date; no `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` with sources outside the search range; no straddling source suggested or capitalised as a whole; no item computed across a year end; no estimated point used as evidenced.

**Mutations** (each alone, restored byte for byte):
- the booking date used where `performance` is missing (in the lower bound, or as the item's start);
- an undated source dropped from the upper bound, or a refund's bounds not swapped;
- the read range by booking date only (the late payment lost);
- a straddling source counted whole, or the progress point at `W` ignored;
- `NOT_FINAL` (`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`) dropped for an `ABOVE_THRESHOLD` with undetermined sources;
- the item's start from `from` instead of `until`, or its owners taken on the performance date;
- the parameters read from constants, or `subsequentCostStart` differing between `@1` and `@2`;
- `performance` left out of the stored inputs or the fingerprint;
- an undated source outside the search range dropped instead of listed, or summed in the lower bound;
- a straddling source suggested `CAPITALIZED` as a whole, or its whole capitalisation on the check accepted;
- an item across a year end started in `until`'s year instead of not computable;
- an estimated progress point used as evidenced, or `progress` accepted without a source reference.

### Example (synthetic)

An Acquisition with economic transfer **2026-03-15**, basis 198,000.00 (§58B's example): window 2026-03-15–2029-03-15, threshold 29,700.00. One owner A (`"1/1"`), a building of completion year 1960 (2 %). Read on 2029-08-01 (the window closed); every source `MAINTENANCE`/`DEDUCTIBLE` with its `netAmount`:

| Source | Booked | Amount used | Performance | Part in the window | Today (booking date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 roof | 2027-05-20 | 12,000.00 | 2027-04-01–2027-04-30 | 12,000.00 | summed |
| S2 windows | 2029-07-10 | 9,500.00 (gross 11,305.00) | 2028-11-02–2028-12-20 | 9,500.00 | not read (117 days after the window) |
| S3 heating | 2029-04-30 | 8,400.00 | 2029-02-01–2029-04-15, point 2029-03-15: 5,600.00 | 5,600.00 | excluded, strip after the window (46 days) |
| S4 painting | 2026-03-02 | 3,000.00 | 2026-04-10–2026-04-20 | 3,000.00 | not read (before the window) |
| S5 small repair | 2027-09-14 | 1,200.00 | none | 0.00 – 1,200.00 | summed |

- **§59F:** `sum` 12,000.00 + 9,500.00 + 5,600.00 + 3,000.00 = **30,100.00** > 29,700.00 → **`ABOVE_THRESHOLD`**, `sumUpper` 31,300.00, `percentOfBasis` "15.20" (30,100 / 198,000 = 15.2020…), `percentOfBasisUpper` "15.81" (15.8080…); `final` false, `NOT_FINAL` `PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN` (S5 in `undetermined`). S1, S2 and S4 are suggested `CAPITALIZED`, `affectedYears` [2026, 2027, 2029] (their cash years). **S3 is not suggested** (decided 2026-11-02): it carries `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` with `lower` = `upper` = 5,600.00 (its point at `W`, evidenced by the contractor's statement of progress, makes the share exact) and `splitRequired`. Its share counts in the sum, and only an evidenced split lets the 5,600.00 be capitalised; S3's cash year 2029 is already in `affectedYears` through S2.
- **Today:** S1 + S5 = 13,200.00 → `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` ("6.67"), not final only by `DATES_NEAR_WINDOW_EDGE` (S3 in the strip). The report's point: a check above 15 % shown below it.
- **Variants:** (a) S5 dated 2027-09-01–2027-09-05: 31,300.00, `ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, **`final` true**. (b) S4 and S5 undated: `sum` 27,100.00 ("13.69"), `sumUpper` 31,300.00 → **`NOT_COMPUTABLE`** (`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`). (c) as (a), but S3 with points 2029-03-10: 5,000.00 and 2029-03-31: 6,500.00: S3 in [5,000.00, 6,500.00], `sum` 30,700.00 > 29,700.00 → `ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, not final, S3 flagged with `lower` 5,000.00, `upper` 6,500.00, never spread by calendar days. (d) as (a), plus an undated S6 (`MAINTENANCE`, 2,000.00) booked 2025-10-01, 165 days before the transfer: outside the search range, within the outer bound. S6 is listed in `outsideSearchRange`, not summed; the check stays `ABOVE_THRESHOLD` (31,300.00 by the lower bound) but is not final (`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`). Had the upper bound been below 15 %, S6 would make the check `NOT_COMPUTABLE` instead of `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`.
- **The capitalised item:** S2 reclassified `CAPITALIZED` on this check, `USER_CONFIRMED`, with its performance: basis 11,305.00 (gross, §59B), start `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL` 2028-12-20 → **2028-01**, AfA 11,305.00 × 2 % = **226.10** in 2028 and in 2029. Today it would start 2029-01, with nothing in 2028. Its tax year stays 2029 (in 2029's `capitalized`), so `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` (`startDate` 2028-12-20, `taxYear` 2029) is informative. Without the performance: `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`, the AfA `null` in every year.

### Not in VC-X-38 (pointers)

- **The window's start without `economicTransferDate`:** not computable (§58K, VC-X-34, migration 0066): no window, so nothing is measured; with the date §59F measures from it.
- **Maintenance paid from the Hausgeld** (question 16): VC-X-27, §58M (implemented): each line takes a performance as here (question 16: „Zeitpunkt die erbrachte Bauleistung; ohne Leistungsdaten manuelle Prüfung“); `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` now names only the unjudged lines.
- **Interest:** never part of the check, dated by its booking date (§59E open question 6) or its periods (VC-X-40).
- **Re-qualification of earlier years** (question 20): the derivation on read and the version comparison already show changed years; a receipt for the cash years is VC-X-28.
- **Separate assets:** `acquiredOn` stays the start; whether a later item of a movable asset should take its performance is `LATER_ITEM_TO_VERIFY`'s open point.
- **Release stages:** decided with VC-X-45 (§60A; the owner's decision A1 of 2026-11-01): a purchase with an open `WEG_HAUSGELD_MAINTENANCE_NOT_COUNTED` or a `NOT_COMPUTABLE` anschaffungsnahe check (`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN` and `SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` included) is at least stage 2; a running window alone does not raise the stage. A check that is above but only not final raises it through its capitalised items (stage 2), not by itself. Missing performance stays blocking at every stage (§60A).

### Open questions for review

1. **Where the performance lives.** **Proposal:** on the classification (split, withdrawal, use), beside `netAmount` and `anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId`: one fact serves the check and §59B's items (which are derived from classifications, not stored), and a correction supersedes. **Alternative:** on the split itself (cash; a confirmed split is frozen and ADR-006 keeps tax facts off it), or a "measure" record of its own (one period for several sources, as §59E's record), more rows for the common case of one invoice per job. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal.** On the classification: the period and the evidenced cumulative shares; a correction is a new classification.
2. **A period with progress points, or one date.** **Proposal:** `from`, `until` and up to five cumulative points (question 14 names Leistungsbeginn, Teilleistungen, Abnahme and the part up to the window's end); a single-day job is `from` = `until`. **Alternative:** one `performedOn` date (§58B's earlier proposal); simpler, but a measure across the window's end cannot be split, and every such case stays undecided. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal, with evidenced shares** („belegte kumulierte Leistungsanteile“): a classification with points needs a source reference, and an estimated point is not an evidenced share ("The fact").
3. **A source without performance in the check.** **Proposal:** never dated by its booking date: `lower` 0, `upper` its amount, decided only where both bounds agree („ohne Leistungsdaten manuelle Prüfung“). **Alternative:** the booking date stands for the work for sources more than N days from both edges, flagged open; fewer undecided checks, but the report rejects the booking date as the measure („nicht automatisch Rechnungs-/Zahlungsdatum“). **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal.** Missing performance data are never replaced by booking data; the check works with lower and upper bounds.
4. **The read range for undated sources.** **Proposal:** 90 days before the transfer and 365 days after the window's end, as rule parameters; a source outside is not read. **Alternative:** 0 days before (the owner's decision of #169 kept for undated sources) and 90 after (today's strip), or no bound at all (every undated maintenance source of the property is undetermined for every check). **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, replacing the proposal in part:** 90 and 365 days stay the search range of the upper bound, but they never establish completeness or a final check, and no relevant source is dropped silently by its payment date. An undated source outside the range is listed (`outsideSearchRange`) and keeps the check from being decided by the upper bound (`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE`, "The check").
5. **Advance payments before the transfer.** **Proposal:** counted by their performance (question 14), revising the decision of #169 for dated sources. **Alternative:** keep #169 (a payment before the transfer never counts), so the check never reads before the window. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal, made precise.** Advance payments count by the work actually performed; no automatic spread by calendar days.
6. **A measure begun before the transfer.** **Proposal:** only the part performed from the transfer day counts, by the progress points (the window is „taggenau ab Übergang“). **Alternative:** the whole measure counts when it is completed in the window, or none of it when begun before; one rule each, the report does not say. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal, made precise.** Only the evidenced part performed from the transfer day counts; no automatic spread by calendar days.
7. **`final` for a check decided `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` by the upper bound.** **Proposal:** final (no source's treatment depends on the missing dates). **Alternative:** not final while any summed source is undated (question 16's „manuelle Prüfung“ read strictly), so every window year stays open until each repair is dated. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, replacing the proposal:** a final decision by the upper bound requires complete sources (none outside the search range, none of §58B's reasons), and a final check never confirms the whole tax year ("The check").
8. **A source straddling the window's end, above 15 %.** **Proposal:** suggested `CAPITALIZED` as a whole with `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW`: the person or the advisor decides; DE cannot classify part of a source. **Alternative:** a classification with a split treatment (the part up to the window's end `CAPITALIZED`, the rest `DEDUCTIBLE`), a new concept for §56 and §58C. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, replacing the proposal:** the whole invoice is never suggested for capitalisation; the affected share is shown and an evidenced split is required, and a whole capitalisation on the check is refused (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `STRADDLES_WINDOW`). The alternative's split treatment is not adopted by the decision; how the split is recorded is still open.
9. **The start year of a period across a year end.** **Proposal:** the year of `until`, flagged `PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END` (open). **Alternative:** split the item into yearly parts by the progress points (each part starting in its own year), more exact and more components. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, replacing the proposal:** multi-year work is not put into the completion year; without a reliable yearly allocation the item is not computable (`PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END` as a reason). Whether evidenced year-end points are such an allocation is still open.
10. **A capitalised building item without performance.** **Proposal:** not computable (`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`), as §59C and §59D: „lieber nicht rechnen als falsch rechnen“. **Alternative:** computed by the booking year with an open flag (`PROVISIONAL`), which keeps today's figures visible but rests on the date the report rejects. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal** (`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`).
11. **`subsequentCostStart.verified`.** **Proposal:** `true` with VC-X-38 (question 5 confirms the method, and the year now follows the performance), resolving `SUBSEQUENT_COST_START_TO_VERIFY`; `notBeforeOwnerStart` is this spec's reading, which the report's „stimmt (Jahresbeginn)“ covers. **Alternative:** keep `verified: false` until the advisor confirms `notBeforeOwnerStart` separately. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, replacing the proposal in part:** `verified: true` for the confirmed rule (the start of the year in which the costs arise), documented apart from the open reading `notBeforeOwnerStart`, which keeps `verified: false` and is flagged where it moves a start (`SUBSEQUENT_COST_OWNER_START_TO_VERIFY`).
12. **A capitalisation on the check without performance.** **Proposal:** refused (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`): capitalising on the check asserts that the work fell in the window. **Alternative:** allowed, judged by the source's date as today, the source then `undetermined` in the check. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal** (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`), also for a source straddling the window without an evidenced split.
13. **Existing classifications: no backfill.** **Proposal:** none; the user supersedes each relevant classification with its performance. **Alternative:** the migration copies nothing but the read offers the booking date as a suggestion in the meaning (`suggestedPerformance`, never used by a figure), which saves typing and invites a confirmation without looking at the invoice. **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02: the proposal.** No backfill.

### As implemented (VC-X-38)

Implemented as specified and decided, with migration **0058** (#237's 0057, VC-X-39, was merged first; Kysely's Migrator refuses a name sorting before an applied one). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here enables it, and no unconfirmed tax assumption reads as released: `notBeforeOwnerStart` keeps `verified: false` and is flagged where it moves a start. Tax-review citations: questions 5, 14 and 16 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01). The points that differ from the text above, or that the text left to the implementation:

1. **The points' own transaction** (**confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-02, third round, 239-9:** „ja, `created_txid` ist als Wächter für die Punkte in Ordnung“). `tax_classification` gains `created_txid` (the inserting transaction, by default; `NULL` on every row before 0058, no backfill; guarded on insert, frozen), so 0058's append-only guard can refuse a point inserted by any other transaction, as 0054's parts. The spec names no such column.
2. **The read.** The repository reads every counting split and WEG source of the PropertyReference whose own date lies within the outer bound of any of its Acquisitions (one range, `checkRange`), and the pure check sorts them; a source with a performance in the window has its own date within that bound by the plausibility check on create.
3. **`excluded` and `unclassified` by the search range** (**accepted by the owner on 2026-11-02, third round, 239-8, with one addition to implement:** an unclassified source beyond the search range but within the outer bound is listed in `unclassified` with `beyondSearchRange` and keeps the check `NOT_FINAL` (`UNCLASSIFIED_SOURCES`); VC-X-38 follow-up, below). A source performed wholly outside is listed `PERFORMED_OUTSIDE_WINDOW` when its own date lies in the search range (not for every source within the outer bound, so `excluded` keeps to the sources near the window); an annually recurring source when its performance overlaps the window or, undated, its date lies in the search range; an `UNCLASSIFIED` source when its date lies in the search range (before: in the window, and the strip). An unclassified source beyond the search range is not listed in `outsideSearchRange` (it is not known to be a source of the check). **Implemented (VC-X-38 follow-up, 239-8 (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-02)):** an `UNCLASSIFIED` source whose own date lies beyond the search range but within the outer bound is listed in `unclassified` too; every `unclassified` entry carries `beyondSearchRange` (`true` for such a source, `false` within the search range), the other lists carry no such key. It is never summed, never makes the check `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (`SOURCES_OUTSIDE_SEARCH_RANGE` stays the classified undated sources' reason) and keeps it `NOT_FINAL` by the existing reason `UNCLASSIFIED_SOURCES` (`unclassified` not empty), whatever the outcome. A source beyond the outer bound is not listed. No new reason, no new parameter: `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` and its pinned hash are unchanged.
4. **`CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` stays open** (**superseded by the owner's decision 239-7 of 2026-11-02, third round: informative where `dateSource` is `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL`; to implement: VC-X-38 follow-up**, below). The level of a code is the code's (`INFORMATIVE_CODES`), not its details, so it is open also where the start comes from the performance (the conservative reading); its `details` gain `startDate` and `dateSource` as specified, and the tax year is compared with the start's year (the performance's on a building, the item's date otherwise, as before). **Implemented (VC-X-38 follow-up, 239-7 (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-02)):** `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` is informative when `details.dateSource` is `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL`, open otherwise (`ITEM_DATE`, e.g. an exempt interest item whose tax year differs from its booking year). Depreciation decides it in one place (`flagIsOpen`, `schedule-review.ts`, a level by details beside `INFORMATIVE_CODES`, as `flagIsOpen` in `tax-year-review.ts` does for `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` and `CONSTRUCTION_PERIOD_TREATMENT_MIXED`), read by the component's and the owners' `calculationStatus`, the schedule's `review` (a code counted once per carrier, open where any of its flags there is open, so one code can be both open and informative), the recorded version's flag levels and the tax-year view's carried `level`. The year flags of the schedule merge each code across components and drop the details, so a year's `calculationStatus` and a recorded year flag's level are judged on the flags as raised, before the merge. The `details` and every figure are unchanged.
5. **The not-final reasons of a `NOT_COMPUTABLE` check.** `PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN` is named whenever the dates leave the sum open and the outcome is not `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, so a check open by both §59D's basis and the dates names both. Where both are open, `notComputableReason` is §59D's when the basis's bounds alone leave the sum's lower or upper bound undecided (or the dates are exact), else `PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`.
6. **`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING` on the meaning** is carried from every check that lists the source (`undetermined`, `outsideSearchRange`) unless the check has no applicable rule, also when it is `NOT_COMPUTABLE`, so the source shows which date the check wants. A source straddling both edges carries two `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` flags (`START`, `END`); `PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS_ESTIMATED` has empty `details`.
7. **The plausibility parameter** (`plausibleYearsFromSourceDate`) is read from `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE` on the source's date, else from its first version (a performance on a source before 2004 is still checked).
8. **Interest exempt by the item's line.** A building item with `taxCategory` in `subsequentCostStart.exemptTaxCategories` keeps its booking date (`ITEM_DATE`); the create's refusal of a performance on an interest split (`400 NOT_ALLOWED`) follows §59E's list (financial category or line), and 0058's CHECK refuses the interest lines.
9. **An item without a start** (`PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`, `PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END`) has `start.date` and `start.month` `null`; its parts are still derived on the share date so the owners are listed, their months never read. The record command refuses it by the existing check of a component without a first year (`SCHEDULE_NOT_COMPLETE`, the component and its reason named); no list of codes is added. The rule version of a building item is selected by the year of its start (the completion), else of its date.
10. **The component and the stored inputs** carry the period (`from`, `until`) only, never the points (the check alone reads them); the stored item inputs gain `performedFrom`/`performedUntil` only where the performance decided the start, so every other item's canonical JSON is unchanged. 0058's CHECK requires them exactly with `start_date_source` `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL`, and then `start_date` is `item_performed_until`.
11. **ACC7** (**both deviations accepted by the owner on 2026-11-02, third round, 239-6**, provided ACC8 also shows the refusal with the switch off: VC-X-38 follow-up, below) implements the proposal: the step "exactly 15 %" without performances is `NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD` by the upper bound (`sum` 0.00, `sumUpper` 12,600.00); with the Sonderumlage use `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (`PERFORMANCE_IN_WINDOW_UNKNOWN`, `sumUpper` 14,600.00); the four sources superseded with performances in the months of their dates give 14,600.00, `ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, "17.38". **ACC8:** the repair and the use get performances in their months, figures unchanged; the undated step is shown on the item of 2027-12-30 (2027 `PARTIAL`, `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`), not on the repair, because the repair's capitalisation on the check is refused without a performance. With `SUBSEQUENT_COST_START_TO_VERIFY` withdrawn, ACC8's 2027 and 2028 are final after version 3 (test wiring; productive recording disabled). **ACC8 with the switch off (VC-X-38 follow-up, 239-6 (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-02)):** before version 3, the shipped default refuses the record through 2028 (`409 RECORDING_NOT_ENABLED`), nothing written (no version, no AuditRecord, no `Idempotency-Key`), and its views of 2027 and 2028 equal the test wiring's and are not `final` (2027 `DEPRECIATION_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDED` and `DEPRECIATION_SCHEDULE_NOT_RECORDED` for the kitchen, 2028 `DEPRECIATION_SCHEDULE_NOT_RECORDED`); after version 3 the shipped default's views of 2027 and 2028 equal the final ones of the test wiring (the outcome follows from the versions, never from the switch).
12. **Field errors.** An amount not above the previous point's is `OUT_OF_RANGE` at `progress.i.amount`; `progressEstimated` missing with points `REQUIRED`. `PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED` answers with empty `details`.
13. **The follow-up's reading of "`false` on every other entry"** (§59F, "what follows" 2): every other entry of `unclassified`; `sources`, `excluded`, `undetermined` and `outsideSearchRange` carry no `beyondSearchRange` (an `outsideSearchRange` entry is beyond the search range by its list, and a key `false` there would read wrong). 239-1, 239-4, 239-5 and 239-9 need no change: an estimated point stays ignored and flagged, the outer bound stays the parameter, `notBeforeOwnerStart` stays `verified: false` and flagged, and `created_txid` stays the points' guard, each already pinned by the tests of §52 of the invariant suite.

It leaves `review.open` and no longer keeps a year from `final` by itself; its `details` are unchanged. **Tests:** an item started by `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL` in another year than its tax year → `CAPITALIZED_YEAR_DIFFERS` informative, not in `review.open`, the year `final` where nothing else is open; the same item with a `taxYear` override (no performance start) → open, as today; both at the property and the owner level; the figures and money sums unchanged. **Mutations:** the flag informative for every `dateSource`; the flag open for `PERFORMANCE_UNTIL` again.
2. **239-8, an unclassified source beyond the search range** (adds to "As implemented" 3): an `UNCLASSIFIED` source whose own date lies beyond the search range (90 days before the transfer, 365 days after the window's end) but within the outer bound (`plausibleYearsFromSourceDate`, 3 years) is listed under the check's `unclassified` with the marker `beyondSearchRange: true` (`false` on every other entry), and keeps the check open: `NOT_FINAL` with `UNCLASSIFIED_SOURCES`. It is **not** `NOT_COMPUTABLE` (that stays reserved for the dated sources, and for §58B's and §59D's reasons) and never added to `sum` or `sumUpper` (unclassified, it is not known to be a source of the check); the outcome by the bounds is otherwise unchanged. ### As implemented (VC-X-38 Part 2)

Implemented with migration **0062: merge after #251 (VC-X-41 Part 2, 0061)**; Kysely's Migrator refuses a name sorting before an applied one. Decision 239-2 (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-02); the split itself is question 14 of the tax review („bei fristüberschreitenden Maßnahmen die bis Fristende erbrachten Leistungen“, mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01). Productive AfA recording stays disabled; nothing here enables it, and no unconfirmed tax assumption reads as released. The points the decision left to the implementation:

1. **The request.** `POST /api/v1/tax-classifications` takes **`partialTreatment: true`** (optional boolean; absent or `false`: as before). It is allowed only with `treatment` `CAPITALIZED` on an Erhaltung line (`MAINTENANCE`, `WEG_SPENDING`) and `anschaffungsnaheAcquisitionId` (else `400 NOT_ALLOWED_WITH_TREATMENT` at `partialTreatment`), and needs `performance` (else `400 REQUIRED` at `performance`). The person does not enter amounts: DE derives both parts from the evidenced points at the create („Beträge aus den belegten Punkten“), so a part can never disagree with its evidence. The classification's `treatment` stays `CAPITALIZED` (the capitalisation on the check, `treatmentRule` `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1`); its parts say how much of the source it is.
2. **The parts**, as §59D's: **`treatmentParts`** `[{ position: 1, treatment: "CAPITALIZED", amount }, { position: 2, treatment: "DEDUCTIBLE", amount }]`, amounts of the source's amount (the split's amount, the withdrawal's or the use's unit share), both > 0 and summing to it exactly. The window part is the part in the window of §59F's check (`partInWindow`) when its bounds are equal; an estimated point is ignored (239-1), and nothing is spread by calendar days.
   - **Rounding (deterministic):** the points are stated in the amount used (`netAmount`, else the gross amount, §58B). Without `netAmount` the window part is exact, no rounding. With `netAmount` the gross window part is `gross × window part / netAmount`, rounded half-up to the cent once; the deductible part is the gross amount less it. Example: gross 11,305.00, net 9,500.00, 3,333.33 net in the window → 3,966.66 `CAPITALIZED`, 7,338.34 `DEDUCTIBLE`; 1.01 gross, 1.00 net, 0.50 in the window → 0.51 and 0.50. Both parts stay > 0 because the window part lies strictly between 0 and the amount used and the net amount never exceeds the gross.
3. **When it is accepted, and the remaining refusal** (§59F "Order of checks", after `OUTSIDE_WINDOW`, judged by the performance as before): a source performed **wholly in the window** with `partialTreatment` → `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE`, `reason` **`PARTIAL_TREATMENT_NOT_APPLICABLE`**, `cause` **`NOT_STRADDLING`** (it is capitalised whole, without parts). **Only a source straddling the window's end** (begun on or after the transfer date `S`, completed after `W`) is accepted, and **only when the evidenced points determine the part exactly**: an evidenced point with `through` = the window's last day (`W`). **A source begun before the transfer date** (across the start, or across both edges) is refused with `partialTreatment` even with points on `S − 1` and `W`: `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE`, `reason` `PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `cause` **`STRADDLES_START`** (no `inWindow`), nothing written; 0062's guard refuses such a row past the repository too (owner's review of #252, see point 4). **The other refusal cause:** otherwise `422 ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_NOT_APPLICABLE`, `reason` `PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `cause` **`SPLIT_NOT_EVIDENCED`**, `details.inWindow: { lower, upper }` (the evidenced bounds of the window part, in the amount used): no point at the edge (a point on `W + 1`), points only around it, no points, or estimated points. The order within the partial treatment: `NOT_STRADDLING`, then (a rule without the parameter) `STRADDLES_WINDOW`, then `STRADDLES_START`, then `SPLIT_NOT_EVIDENCED`. Without `partialTreatment` a straddling source is still refused as a whole (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `STRADDLES_WINDOW`). The parameter decides: a rule version without `performance.partialTreatment` keeps refusing (`STRADDLES_WINDOW`).
4. **The edge: the window's end only.** Across the end the part up to and including `W` is `CAPITALIZED` and the work after it `DEDUCTIBLE`, as 239-2 and question 14 of the tax review („die bis Fristende erbrachten Leistungen“) say. **The start is pending the owner's and the advisor's decision** (owner's review of #252): treating the work before the transfer date as `DEDUCTIBLE` would assert that it is deductible for the buyer, which nobody has confirmed (it may be acquisition cost instead); 239-2 and question 14 cover the window's end only. Until decided, a source begun before `S` (across the start, or across both edges) is refused with `partialTreatment` (`STRADDLES_START`, point 3) and stays refused as a whole (`STRADDLES_WINDOW`); its share stays shown with `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` (`edge: "START"`) and `splitRequired: true`. The question is open in `docs/germany/beratungsfragen.md` §4 („Arbeiten vor dem Übergang: beim Käufer sofort abziehbar oder Anschaffungskosten?“). A decision for the start changes the rule's `straddledEdge` (point 10) and 0062's link guard in a new migration.
5. **The check (§58B, §59F)** counts the source by its part in the window exactly as before: `DEDUCTIBLE` or partially treated, `sum`, `sumUpper` and the percentages are equal (the test compares both). The `ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE_HERSTELLUNGSKOSTEN` flag of a straddling source carries `splitRequired: false` once a partial treatment on this check stands (`true` otherwise, also for a partial treatment on another Acquisition); it is still never suggested as a whole, and `PERFORMANCE_STRADDLES_WINDOW` stays. In the view's review the flag is informative on both parts (the classification's `treatment` is `CAPITALIZED`: the suggestion is followed).
6. **The tax-year view (§58C):** a counting source with a partial treatment is **two items**, one per part, each placed by its part's treatment: the window part in `capitalized`, the rest on its line (`MAINTENANCE` or `WEG_SPENDING`, in `subtotals.immediate`). Each item's `lineAmount` is its part's amount; `amount`, `date`, `taxYear` and `treatment` (the classification's, `CAPITALIZED`) are the source's; the new **`treatmentPart`** `{ position, treatment, amount }` is present on such items only. Each part is shared out to the owners on its own (the largest remainder per item, as every item), so the owners and `NOT_OWNED` sum to the property per part and per line; an owner's two parts together may differ by a cent from a share of the whole (as for any two sources). The view's item count includes both.
7. **The capitalised item (§59B):** the window part only, gross, with the view's per-part shares; its start by §59F's rule on the classification's performance: `START_OF_YEAR` of `performance.until`, `PERFORMANCE_SPANS_YEAR_END` (not computable) when the period crosses a year end. This is the conservative reading (the whole period's completion, not the edge; whether the window part's work counts as completed at `W` is PR question 2, beside 239-3's advisor question). Example: S3 (8,400.00, performed 2029-02-01–2029-04-15, point 2029-03-15: 5,600.00) → 5,600.00 `CAPITALIZED` from 2029-01, 112.00 in 2029; 2,800.00 deductible in its cash year 2029.
8. **No cash correction** (239-2: „die Kasse ist Kasse, und WEG-Entnahmen haben keine“): no cash row changes, the source's cash year, date and owners stay; a WEG withdrawal or use takes the parts of its unit share as classified.
9. **The database (0062):** `tax_classification.partial_treatment` (boolean, `false` by default, no backfill), with `tax_classification_partial_treatment` (only `CAPITALIZED` with the anschaffungsnahe link and a performance, on `MAINTENANCE`/`WEG_SPENDING`, never on a deposit, never with an election), frozen (0047's frozen trigger extended). `tax_classification_treatment_part` (`position` 1 `CAPITALIZED`, 2 `DEDUCTIBLE`, `amount` > 0), inserted only by the classification's own transaction (`created_txid`, as 0058's points), never changed or deleted; a deferred trigger checks at commit that a partial treatment has exactly both parts summing to the source's amount (the split's amount, the withdrawal's or use's unit share as classified) and any other classification none. 0058's `tax_classification_anschaffungsnahe` is replaced: a partial treatment needs a performance straddling the window's end (`performed_from` from `S` to `W`, `performed_until` after `W`); one begun before `S` is refused; every other link keeps 0058's rule. Whether the parts equal the evidenced points is the repository's check (it needs the rule), as the points against the amount used are. `down` refuses while a partial treatment exists. `up` does not refuse with recorded versions: no column of them changes (a component's basis is its line amount, now the part).
10. **The rule, in place:** `DE_ANSCHAFFUNGSNAHE@1` gains `performance.partialTreatment` `{ straddledEdge: "END", windowPart: "CAPITALIZED", rest: "DEDUCTIBLE", amountsFrom: "EVIDENCED_POINTS", grossWindowPart: "PRO_RATA_HALF_UP", cashCorrection: false, source }` and a change note in its `source`; the pinned hash in `frozen-rules.test.ts` updated explicitly (before 6f14e4ac…1c57; dadb1895…6587 without `straddledEdge`; now d4e797c4…9f45), with counter-checks that recompute both earlier hashes and that a changed parameter (also `straddledEdge`) changes it. The Phase-7 freeze point (the first productive go-live) is not reached.
11. **Responses and history:** `treatmentParts` on the classification and on both tax-meaning reads and the per-property list, present only on a partial treatment (every other classification and meaning keeps its shape); `treatmentPart` on the view's items of such a source only; `TAX_CLASSIFIED`'s metadata gains `treatmentParts`. A withdrawal of the partial treatment is a new classification superseding it (`TAX_CLASSIFICATION_SUPERSEDED`), as every correction. The idempotency fingerprint includes `partialTreatment` only when `true`, so a key stored before replays. No new route; `api-inventory.md` is unchanged.

# 59G. The Shorter Useful Life from the Evidence, and Later Costs over the Remaining Useful Life (VC-X-41, Part 1 implemented: migration 0056; Part 2: migration 0061)

**Status:** specified and decided (the owner's decisions of 2026-11-02, both rounds, below). **Part 1 (the guard) implemented** (VC-X-41 Part 1, migration 0056; deviations in "As implemented (VC-X-41 Part 1)" at the end of this section); **the second round of 2026-11-02 (238-3, 238-5) is implemented** (VC-X-41 follow-up, #244, migration 0059; "As implemented (VC-X-41 Part 1)" 1, 6, 10, 13; the decisions in "Decided on 2026-11-02, second round: what follows" at the end of this section); **Part 2 implemented** (VC-X-41 Part 2, #251, migration 0061; "As implemented (VC-X-41 Part 2)" at the end of this section); recording stays disabled. **Part 1 first, as an implementation of its own.** Part 2 was blocked until the four points the owner named („vor Teil 2 fachlich klären“) were clarified; **the owner decided them, and open question 5, on 2026-11-02 (chat; "Decided by the owner on 2026-11-02 (chat): Part 2" below, open questions 2, 4, 5, 8 and 11, and "Decided on 2026-11-02 (chat): what follows for Part 2" at the end of this section)**, and Part 2 implements them (VC-X-41 Part 2, #251). **Part 2 lands before the first enablement of stage 1** (the owner's decision on the order, below): it changes `shorterUsefulLife.fromEvidenceYear` and `subsequentCostRate.shorterLife`, which freeze with the AfA rules at the first enablement. **Migration:** Part 1 is **0056** (0053–0055 are taken by §59C, §59D and §59E; it merges before VC-X-39's 0057, since Kysely's Migrator refuses a migration whose name sorts before one already applied). It amends:
- §59: what `evidence.date` and `usefulLifeYears` of a shorter-life entry mean, the Stichtag stored apart (`evidence.valuationDate`) and a release note (`releaseNote`), and when an entry is shorter;
- §59A: the rate of a year for a purchase with a confirmed shorter life, the residual value from the evidence year, and the withdrawal of `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY`;
- §59B: the rate and the end of a later cost in the pool of such a purchase, and the withdrawal of `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY`;
- §60: the stored inputs, the fingerprint and the pinned hashes;
- §58C: the gaps and the review table (codes withdrawn and added, below);
- the parameters of `DE_AFA_BUILDING_LINEAR@1` and `@2`, in place.

The bands and thresholds of S. 2, the start and the first year, the owners' bases, the cumulative rounding, the tenure, the disposal year, the share reduction, §59C's method gate, §59D's basis, §59F's start of a capitalised item and the separate assets are unchanged.

**Why:** the tax review of 2026-11-01 (`docs/germany/pruefbericht-2026-11-01.md`), questions 8 and 9 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01).
- **Question 8**, „Kürzere tatsächliche ND“, rated „Nur unter folgenden Voraussetzungen“: the thresholds < 33 / < 50 / < 40 are correct; „bisherige AfA ins Restvolumen, Gutachten-Stichtag nicht beliebig rückwirkend; eigene, dokumentationspflichtige Methode mit Freigabevermerk“. Its comparison column reads „teilweise / **abweichend** bei späterem Nachweis“.
- **Question 9**, „Nachträgliche HK bei kürzerer ND“, rated **„Berechnung muss geändert werden“**, „wenn der frühere Satz immer unverändert bleibt: Restwert + HK über die Restnutzungsdauer; R 7.4 Abs. 9 S. 2 erlaubt die Vereinfachung, zwingend ist sie nicht“. Its comparison column reads „**abweichend**“.
- **The reading** taken here: a shorter useful life is not applied arbitrarily retroactively. When the evidence is dated after the first year, the AfA so far stays at the band rate and goes into the residual value, and from the evidence's year the residual value is spread over the remaining useful life. With later costs on such a purchase, the residual value plus the costs run over the remaining useful life; keeping the old rate is an allowed simplification, not a must.
- The report lists `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` and `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY` under „Nicht auflösbar, weil die Antwort DE widerspricht“, and its P1 item „Kürzere ND mit Nachweisen und Restwertrechnung“ as „teilweise (Nachweis ja, Restwert nein; VC-X-41)“. Its section F puts the shorter useful life in **stage 3** („Spezial“). The confirmation covers the legal statements, not DE's calculation (the report's own reservation).
