**Why a section of its own, after §59F:** VC-X-41 is a backlog item of its own and touches §59, §59A, §59B and §60 at once. Each keeps its statements and points here where they change. It reads §59F's start of a capitalised item (the year of `performance.until`) and so follows it.

### As the code stands (main, before VC-X-41)

- **The rate of a year ignores the evidence's date.** `rateOfYear` (`domains/depreciation/exact.ts:67–76`) returns `1/usefulLifeYears` for every year in which the entry is confirmed and shorter than the year's band threshold (`isShorter`, `domains/depreciation/rate.ts:76`). `nominalMonths` (`domains/depreciation/purchase-work.ts:256–288`) asks it once per year and steps `min(rate/12, 1 − done)` (`:282`), so a confirmed shorter life runs from the component's first month whatever `evidence.date` says.
- **A later evidence is only flagged.** `purchase-work.ts:194–199` adds `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` (informative, `schedule-review.ts:11–13`) and, when `evidence.date` lies after 31 December of the first year, `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` (open, since it is not in `INFORMATIVE_CODES`). The year is `PROVISIONAL`, the figure is `1/n` from the start: what question 8 calls „beliebig rückwirkend“.
- **A later cost always takes the owner's purchase rate.** `item-part.ts:257` finds the purchase whose tenure holds the item's date; `:282–290` give the part `1/usefulLifeYears` for every year when that purchase's entry applies. `schedule-items.ts:118–127` flags `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY` while the rule's `subsequentCostRate.shorterLifeVerified` is `false` (`domains/depreciation/rules/de-afa-building-linear.ts:91`, value `:172`). The pool's allowance and the nominal last month ask `rateOfYear` again (`item-pools.ts:21–24`, `:191`), so the rate is derived in four places from the same entry.
- **The remaining useful life is a parameter that computes nothing:** `subsequentCostEnd.remainingUsefulLife: { allowed: true, computed: false }` (`de-afa-building-linear.ts:99`, `:175`).
- **The evidence date reaches no recorded version.** A recorded purchase component stores `rate_kind` and `useful_life_years` (`migrations/0052_depreciation_schedule_version.ts:102–103`) and `shorter_life_review_state` (`:114`), not the evidence date. `version-compute.ts:76–79` rebuilds the entry for the recomputation as `{ acquisitionId, usefulLifeYears, reviewState: 'CONFIRMED' }` with a type cast and no `evidence`, and the fingerprint covers `usefulLifeYears` only (`version-inputs.ts:129–131`, `:176`). Today that is consistent, since the date moves no figure; after VC-X-41 it moves the switch year, so it must be stored and fingerprinted.
- **The asset's `rate` read** (§59, `rate.ts:89–123`) shows `rate: "1/n"` and `applies` per entry, judged on the year's band. It has no start year and does not know the switch.
- **Tests that assert today's behaviour:** `schedule-rules.test.ts:188–209` (`USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` with `evidenceDate: '2027-02-01', firstYear: 2026`), `schedule-items.test.ts:328–346` (`1/30` for the item, `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY`), and the lists of open codes in `domains/taxation/tax-year-depreciation.test.ts:543–549` and `infrastructure/postgres/tax-year-depreciation.test.ts:122–129`. ACC8 (`phase-8-acceptance.e2e.test.ts`) records no shorter life.

### The reading: the evidence year decides from when

For a purchase component with a confirmed entry (§59), let `Y1` be the year of the component's first month (§59A), `YC` the year of the Acquisition's `contractDate`, `YE` the year of the Stichtag (`evidence.valuationDate`, below) and `n` the entry's `usefulLifeYears`.

- **What the entry states** (§59, made precise; decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 6: „Dokumentdatum und Bewertungsstichtag getrennt speichern; Bestandsdaten nicht still umdeuten.“): `usefulLifeYears` is the building's **remaining** useful life as of the **Stichtag**, the new field `evidence.valuationDate` (the date as of which the evidence states that remaining life; „Gutachten-Stichtag“). `evidence.date` stays what it is, the date of the document, and is never read as the Stichtag.
- **An entry without a Stichtag** (every entry stored before Part 1; a create or amend from Part 1 on requires one, `400 REQUIRED`): **not computable** in every year, reason **`USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, evidenceDate }`, `evidenceDate` being only the document's date, shown so the person finds the entry). Taking its `evidence.date` as the Stichtag would reinterpret existing data silently, and without a Stichtag the case cannot be judged. The person amends the entry with its Stichtag, which resets its review state (§59 amend).
- **Three cases**, judged per component:
  1. **`FROM_START`** (`YC` ≤ `YE` ≤ `Y1`: the evidence lies in the first year, or between the contract year and the first year): `1/n` from the component's first month for `12·n` months. The figures of today; the review confirms that an evidence of the first year applies from the start.
  2. **`FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`** (`YE` > `Y1`): the years `Y1` … `YE − 1` at the band's rate of each year's version (§59A, the same months and amounts as without an entry); from the **switch month** `S` = January of `YE`, the residual value is spread evenly over `n` whole years, through the **last month** `L` = December of `YE + n − 1` (Part 2). The evidence year counts in full at the new rate, from January (**decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 2, the proposal:** „ab Januar von `YE`, ganze Jahre bis Dezember `YE + n − 1`.“): the AfA is an annual amount, and the law knows a monthly share only for the years of acquisition and of sale. The code implements both values of the parameter, as for `subsequentCostStart`, and the Stichtag's month stays testable as the alternative. Part 1 computes neither.
  3. **Evidence before the purchase** (`YE` < `YC`): not computable in any year, reason **`USEFUL_LIFE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_PURCHASE`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, valuationDate, evidenceDate, contractDate }`: `valuationDate` the Stichtag that decides the case, `evidenceDate` the document's date, shown alongside). The remaining life the evidence states is not the buyer's remaining life at the purchase, and DE does not shorten it by the years elapsed (**decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 5, the proposal:** „bleibt nicht berechenbar. … Die Alternative, `n` um die verstrichenen Jahre zu kürzen, ist eine Schätzung, und das Projekt schätzt nicht.“; Part 1 implements it, Part 2 keeps it).
- **Shorter, for a late evidence** (§59, amended; open question 4, **decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, the proposal:** „`(YE − Y1) + n` unter `shorterThanYears`. … Das ist Gesetzeswortlaut, kein Auslegungsspielraum“; its source is the law itself, **`Primärquelle` § 7 Abs. 4 S. 2 EStG**, noted in `docs/germany/verification-checklist.md` under B7). Part 1 needs no answer: a late evidence whose `n` is below the band's `shorterThanYears` is not computed from `YE` whichever reading applies (Part 1's guard), and one whose `n` is not below it is not shorter under either reading (the band's rate, `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_SHORTER` open, as today). The reading Part 2 implements (decided 2026-11-02): the entry is shorter when the useful life it implies **from the component's first year**, `(max(YE, Y1) − Y1) + n` years, is below the band's `shorterThanYears` (§ 7 Abs. 4 S. 2 EStG compares the building's actual useful life, which for a buyer runs from the purchase). For `FROM_START` that is `n`, today's check. Otherwise the entry is not shorter: the band's rate in every year, flagged `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_SHORTER` (open) as today, with `details` gaining `yearsFromFirstYear`. The threshold is read from the version selected for `max(YE, Y1)`; a registry test asserts that `@1` and `@2` give every completion year the same threshold, so the version cannot change the answer today.
- **`USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_CONFIRMED`** is unchanged: an unconfirmed entry stops the component in every year, whatever its date.

### Part 1: not computed until the residual value is (the guard)

Part 1 lands first, as an implementation of its own (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 1: „Zuerst Teil 1 umsetzen: automatische Rückrechnung verhindern; spätere Nachweise bis zur unterstützten Restwertberechnung nicht berechenbar.“). It also stores the Stichtag apart from the document date (above). Its rule values are `shorterUsefulLife.fromEvidenceYear: "NOT_COMPUTABLE"` and `subsequentCostRate.shorterLife: "NOT_COMPUTABLE"` (below).

- **`FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`:** the years `Y1` … `YE − 1` are computed at the band's rate (`rate.kind` `BAND`; the review says this AfA stays). From `YE` on, every owner's year is **not computable**, reason **`SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RESIDUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, valuationDate, evidenceDate, firstYear, fromYear }`: `fromYear` is the year of `valuationDate`; `evidenceDate`, the document's date, is shown alongside), the amounts, cumulative AfA and residual value `null`, never 0.00. It works as `DISPOSAL_DATE_MISSING` does (§59A, the owner's `missingFrom`): the earlier years stand, nothing follows.
- **`FROM_START`** (a Stichtag in or before the first year): computed as today (`1/n` from the start, `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE`); `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` cannot arise any more.
- **Later costs:** an owner's item part whose pool (§59B "The pools": the purchase parts of the owner's tenure) contains a purchase with an applying shorter life is **not computable**, part reason **`SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_NOT_SUPPORTED`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, usefulLifeYears }`):
  - for a `FROM_START` purchase, in every year of the part: today's `1/n` on the item is the simplification the review allows but does not require (question 9), and DE does not choose it for the taxpayer (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 7: no automatic choice of method);
  - for a `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` purchase, from `YE` on (a part that starts in or after `YE`: in every year). Before `YE` the pool runs at the band's rate by §59B, unchanged.
  - Heir parts (`OWNER_WITHOUT_ACQUISITION`) and the `NOT_OWNED` part keep the band's rate in pools of their own (§59B), and are not affected.
- **Withdrawn by Part 1:** `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` and `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY`, and the parameter `subsequentCostRate.shorterLifeVerified`. Their cases are not computed now, so no figure rests on them.

### Part 2: the residual value over the remaining useful life

**Part 2 was blocked** until the four points of "Still open" (end of this section) were clarified (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02); **the owner decided them on 2026-11-02 (chat; open questions 2, 4, 8 and 11)**, and what follows specifies Part 2 with those decisions (the tests and mutations they add in "Decided on 2026-11-02 (chat): what follows for Part 2" at the end of this section). Part 2 replaces Part 1's two reasons with the computation; its rule values are `shorterUsefulLife.fromEvidenceYear: "RESIDUAL_OVER_REMAINING_LIFE"` and `subsequentCostRate.shorterLife: "REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE"`. The code implements both values of each parameter, so that moving between them is one line in the rule, and the tests cover both (as `subsequentCostStart` did with `MONTH_OF_DATE`).

**The purchase** (`FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`). Every amount is computed in integer cents and exact fractions, as §59A does (`bigint`, AGENTS.md §20):
- **Before `S`:** §59A's monthly steps at the band's rate of each year, `q_m = min(rate_m / 12, 1 − done)`. Let `U` be the consumed fraction of the basis at the end of month `S − 1`, the sum of those steps (exact).
- **From `S` through `L`, per owner, the carried-forward residual value** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 3: „Teil 2 verwendet den nachvollziehbar fortgeschriebenen Restwert nach bisheriger AfA. Keine rückwirkenden Änderungen durch neue Rundungslogik.“). Owner `i`'s residual value `R_i = b_i − round(C_i(YE − 1))` is the Restbuchwert shown at the end of `YE − 1`: the owner's basis less the AfA so far, exactly as computed and shown for those years.
  - From `S`, `R_i` is spread evenly over the `12·n` months through `L`. Owner `i`'s exact cumulative spread after month `k` is **`Σ_{m = S}^{k} R_i · g_m / (12·n)`**, `g_m` the fraction of the part still held in month `m` relative to `S` (the running minimum, as §59A's `f_m`; it falls with a sale or a share reduction). Its year is the difference of that cumulative spread rounded half-up to the cent (one rounding per owner and year, P8-D8). Only while `g_m` is constant (`g`) is the sum `R_i · g · k' / (12·n)` for `k'` months; with `g` = 1 throughout, month `L` closes `R_i` exactly.
  - **No retroactive change by the new rounding:** every year before `YE` keeps the amounts and residual values computed under §59A. The spread starts from the rounded residual value shown, never from an exact fraction that would move a cent between the years before and after `S`. So each owner's series sums to `b_i` to the cent, and the component's year is the sum of its owners' (as §59A's figures are).
- **A share reduced or a tenure ended** in or after `YE`: the still-held fraction falls as §59A says; the sold fraction keeps its residual value, and nothing passes to the buyer (P8-D8). The month of the last day counts by `end.disposal.endMonthCounts` (verified, Prüfbericht Frage 4). A tenure that ends before `YE` never reaches the switch: the entry changes none of that owner's figures. A share reduction across several purchases stays `PRO_RATA_ALL_COMPONENTS` (Frage 11): each purchase keeps its own entry and switch.
- **The buyer** of a share depreciates their own Acquisition (§59A). Their component has its own entry or none: an evidence the seller obtained before the buyer's contract year is case 3 for the buyer.
- **Who releases a late evidence** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 10: „Spätere Nachweise benötigen `ADVISOR_CONFIRMED`, Beleg und Freigabevermerk.“): a `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` entry is computed from `S` only when it is `ADVISOR_CONFIRMED`, names its own evidence (`evidence.documentReference`) and carries a release note (`releaseNote`, the Freigabevermerk: which method was released, by which role and when; text 1–500). **Only the entry's own `evidence.documentReference` counts** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, second round, 238-3: „nur der eigene Beleg des Eintrags.“): a shorter useful life needs a concrete, dated evidence (Gutachten), and the asset's general `sourceReferences` have no date; they no longer count as the evidence of the release. The release note may be recorded in any review state and counts only once the entry is `ADVISOR_CONFIRMED` (238-1); `ADVISOR_CONFIRMED` suffices without a named advisor (`advisorPartyId` not required; there is no advisor role in the MVP, §57; 238-2). Otherwise its years from `YE` stay not computable, reason **`SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RELEASE_MISSING`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, missing: ["ADVISOR_CONFIRMED", "EVIDENCE", "RELEASE_NOTE", "DECLARED_AFA"] }`, the missing ones; `DECLARED_AFA` by open question 11, below). A `FROM_START` entry keeps §59's rule (a user's `CONFIRMED` suffices).
- **The declared AfA of a late evidence** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 11: „ein spätes Gutachten braucht die erfasste erklärte AfA.“): the release of a `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` entry also needs, **per owner**, the cumulative AfA declared per the tax assessments (Steuerbescheide) through `YE − 1`, with an evidence reference, as a new field of the entry (proposed: `declaredAfa`, one row per owner with `partyId`, `throughYear` = `YE − 1`, `amount` and `evidenceReference`; the names are the implementation's). Each owner's declared AfA is compared with the cumulative AfA DE computes and shows for that owner at the end of `YE − 1` (`round(C_i(YE − 1))`, the AfA so far behind `R_i`):
  - **matching** (proposed: equal to the cent): the switch runs on the carried-forward residual value `R_i`, as decided for open question 3;
  - **differing:** that owner's years from `YE` are not computable, owner's reason **`DECLARED_AFA_DIFFERS`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, throughYear, declaredAfa, computedAfa }`, both amounts), and the case goes to the advisor: which residual value applies when too much or too little AfA was declared is a question of tax law, a new point in `docs/germany/beratungsfragen.md` §4. DE corrects neither amount and picks neither;
  - **missing** (no declared AfA recorded for that owner): no release, `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RELEASE_MISSING` names `DECLARED_AFA`.
  The years before `YE` stand in every case (the band's). A `FROM_START` entry needs no declared AfA, and nothing changes for it. The declared AfA is a fact of the entry: proposed, a change resets the entry's review state as a changed evidence or release note does (§59 amend), and it enters the stored inputs and the fingerprint from `YE` ("Recorded versions and the fingerprint" below).
- **The rule version of each year** is still the one selected for the year (§58) and named in each year with its band and `legalBasis`. A year without a version stays `NO_APPLICABLE_RULE`; a year before 2006 stays `HISTORICAL_RULE_NOT_SUPPORTED` (§59A, §59C open question 3).

**Later costs** (question 9; §59B, amended). In a pool whose governing purchase has an applying shorter life, from the purchase's `S` (for `FROM_START`, its first month), every positive part `p` with consumed fraction `u_p` spreads what is left of it evenly to the purchase's last month `L`:
- a part that **starts in or after `S`** (`firstMonth_p` ≥ `S`): `q_m = 1 / (L − firstMonth_p + 1)` for each month from its first month through `L`. Its first month is §59B's (`START_OF_YEAR` of the year of `performance.until` by §59F, never before the owner's start);
- a part that **started before `S`** (`FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` only): §59B's pooled arithmetic at the band's rate up to `S − 1`, then `q_m = (1 − u_p(S − 1)) / (L − S + 1)` through `L` (**decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 8, the proposal:** „ihr Restwert läuft ab `S` mit dem Kauf bis `L`.“: capitalised later costs are part of the building's cost and so of the residual value the report's question 9 means, „Restwert + HK über die Restnutzungsdauer“);
- **a refund** (a negative part, §59B) spreads its own negative basis the same way, from its first month to `L`; it takes no overflow;
- **no overflow:** every part of the pool ends in `L`, so the pool's allowance equals the sum of its parts' steps in every month. `POOLED_BASIS` and `PER_ITEM_SERIES` give the same figures, and such a pool never carries `SUBSEQUENT_COST_END_TO_VERIFY`;
- **a part that starts after `L`** (the evidenced remaining life has ended): not computable, part reason **`REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE_ENDED`** (open, `details: { acquisitionId, lastMonth }`). A new evidence and a new clarification are needed (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 9: „Kosten nach Ablauf der belegten Nutzungsdauer bleiben ohne neue Klärung nicht berechenbar.“);
- the owners, the still-held fractions, the tenure's end and the rounding are §59B's and §59A's, as for the purchase.

This is „Restwert + HK über die Restnutzungsdauer“: the purchase's own steps do not change when an item arrives (its residual already runs to `L`), and each item runs from its start to the same `L`. The simplification the review allows (the old rate on the item) is not offered (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, open question 7: „Zunächst nur die bestätigte Restnutzungsdauer-Methode unterstützen; keine automatische Methodenwahl.“).

**Not affected by Part 2:** a purchase without an entry or with an entry that is not shorter (the band's rate; §59B's pool and `SUBSEQUENT_COST_END_TO_VERIFY` as today); heir and `NOT_OWNED` parts; separate assets (`DE_AFA_MOVABLE_LINEAR`, whose `1/n` is the asset's own life).

### Interplay with §59A, §59B, §59C, §59D, §59F

- **§59A's order of component reasons** gains `USEFUL_LIFE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_PURCHASE` directly after `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_CONFIRMED`: the basis function's reason, `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_CONFIRMED`, `USEFUL_LIFE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_PURCHASE`, `TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`, `HISTORICAL_RULE_NOT_SUPPORTED`, the method reason, `NO_APPLICABLE_RULE`, `BUYER_ALREADY_OWNER`. `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RESIDUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED` is an owner's reason from a year on, after `DISPOSAL_DATE_MISSING`.
- **§59A's start:** without `economicTransferDate` the component has no `Y1` (`TRANSFER_DATE_MISSING`), so the case is not judged and no case reason is added.
- **§59B's order of part reasons** gains `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_NOT_SUPPORTED` (Part 1) or `REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE_ENDED` (Part 2) after `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_CONFIRMED` and the method reason.
- **§59C:** the method gate is checked first, as today. A purchase with a method reason is not computed whatever its shorter life, and its items stop with it (§59C "Items of such a purchase"). §59C's "its own open points are VC-X-41's" now points here.
- **§59D:** the basis and its bounds are unchanged. A purchase not computable for its basis is not computed, and no case is judged.
- **§59F:** an item's start year (`performance.until`) decides whether it starts before or after `S`. Without `performance` it stays `PERFORMANCE_DATE_MISSING`, before any reason of this section. Until §59F is implemented, the item's start is today's (the share date's year).
- **`HISTORICAL_RULE_TO_VERIFY`:** `isRateVerified(parameters, shorter)` (`rate.ts:72–73`) is asked with `shorter` true for the years from `S`. Both versions carry `shorterUsefulLifeThresholds: true`, so the flag does not appear.

### The rule, in place (§60 open question 11)

| Parameter (`DE_AFA_BUILDING_LINEAR@1` and `@2`, identical) | Today | Part 1 | Part 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shorterUsefulLife` | `{ legalBasis: "§ 7 Abs. 4 S. 2 EStG", rate: "RECIPROCAL_OF_YEARS" }` | adds `evidenceDate: "DOCUMENT_DATE"`, `valuationDate: { required: true, missing: "NOT_COMPUTABLE" }`, `fromStart: "STICHTAG_NOT_AFTER_FIRST_YEAR"`, `evidenceBeforeContractYear: "NOT_COMPUTABLE"`, `fromEvidenceYear: "NOT_COMPUTABLE"`, `source: "Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Frage 8 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01)"` | `fromEvidenceYear: "RESIDUAL_OVER_REMAINING_LIFE"`, `residualValue: "CARRIED_FORWARD_ROUNDED"`, `lateEvidenceRelease: { reviewState: "ADVISOR_CONFIRMED", evidence: "ENTRY_DOCUMENT_REFERENCE", releaseNote: true }` (the evidence being the entry's own `documentReference` only, 238-3, as #244 implemented); `evidenceYearCounts: "FROM_JANUARY"` (the other value, e.g. `"FROM_STICHTAG_MONTH"`, implemented and tested; open question 2) and `thresholdYears: "FROM_FIRST_YEAR"` (open question 4); `lateEvidenceRelease` gains the declared AfA (e.g. `declaredAfa: "PER_OWNER_THROUGH_YEAR_BEFORE"`, a difference `NOT_COMPUTABLE`; open question 11); all decided 2026-11-02, the names the implementation's |
| `subsequentCostRate` | `{ rate: "OWNER_PURCHASE_RATE", shorterLifeVerified: false }` | `{ rate: "OWNER_PURCHASE_RATE", shorterLife: "NOT_COMPUTABLE", legalBasis: "R 7.4 Abs. 9 S. 2 EStR; Prüfbericht 2026-11-01, Frage 9 (mündlich bestätigt durch den Steuerberater, laut Projektinhaber am 2026-11-01)" }` | `shorterLife: "REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE"`, `afterRemainingLife: "NOT_COMPUTABLE"`; the parts begun before `S` spread from `S` to `L` with the purchase (e.g. `partsBeforeSwitch: "RESIDUAL_TO_LAST_MONTH"`; open question 8, decided 2026-11-02) |
| `subsequentCostEnd.remainingUsefulLife` | `{ allowed: true, computed: false }` | unchanged | unchanged: it is S. 2's option for a building **without** a shorter-life entry (question 6, „ggf. tatsächliche ND“), not this section's case |

- **The values are the rule's, never constants** (AGENTS.md §16): the code reads each value, and a test registry with the other value turns the corresponding tests.
- **Both versions identically** (a registry test asserts it, as for `basis` and `methodStatus`); the schedule reads them from the version of the component's first year, else the latest (§59A "As implemented (VC-8-02)" 5).
- **The pinned hashes** of both versions are updated explicitly in the commit of each part, the comment naming questions 8 and 9. `DE_AFA_MOVABLE_LINEAR@1` is not changed.

### Reasons, flags and the response

| Code | Where | Level | Part |
|---|---|---|---|
| `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` | component | **withdrawn** | 1 |
| `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_TO_VERIFY` | item component | **withdrawn** | 1 |
| `USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING` | component reason, every year | open | 1 and 2 |
| `USEFUL_LIFE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_PURCHASE` | component reason, every year | open | 1 and 2 |
| `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RESIDUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED` | owner's reason from `YE` on | open | 1 only |
| `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_NOT_SUPPORTED` | item part reason | open | 1 only |
| `REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE_ENDED` | item part reason, every year | open | 2 |
| `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RELEASE_MISSING` | owner's reason from `YE` on | open | 2 (`missing` gains `DECLARED_AFA`, open question 11) |
| `DECLARED_AFA_DIFFERS` | owner's reason from `YE` on | open | 2 (open question 11, decided 2026-11-02; `details: { acquisitionId, throughYear, declaredAfa, computedAfa }`) |
| `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` | component flag | informative (unchanged) | `details` gain `valuationDate` (the Stichtag, which decides `method` and `fromYear`), `evidenceDate` (the document's date, alongside), `method` (`FROM_START`, `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`), `fromYear`, `lastMonth` |
| `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_SHORTER` | component flag | open (unchanged) | `details` gain `yearsFromFirstYear` |

- **The schedule's component** (§59A's response, additively): `rate.shorterUsefulLife` `{ usefulLifeYears, valuationDate, evidenceDate, method, fromYear, lastMonth }` or `null` (`valuationDate` decides `method`, `fromYear` and `lastMonth`; `evidenceDate` is the document's date). Each year's `rate` names its `kind`: `BAND` before `S`, `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` from `S`. From `S` on, the year's `annualFraction` is the exact share of the basis per full year (`12·q`, e.g. `"63/2200"` in the example below), not a percentage.
- **The asset's `rate` read** (§59): `rate` and `ratePercent` of an entry keep showing `1/n`, the claimed remaining life. They are not the year's effective rate, which only the schedule knows, since it alone knows the start. `applies` is unchanged. `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_SHORTER` in the asset read is still judged on `n` alone, and the schedule's judgement (from the first year) governs the figures. The read states this in its documentation; it does not change shape.
- **§58C:** the tax-year view's gaps and review table gain the open codes of this table and lose the two withdrawn ones. A year with `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RESIDUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED` is `PARTIAL` or `DEPRECIATION_NOT_AVAILABLE`, as for any not-computable component.
- **No new route:** the entry is §59's, written with create and amend; its `evidence` gains `valuationDate` (business date, required on every entry a create or amend sends, `400 REQUIRED`) and the entry gains `releaseNote` (optional, trimmed, 1–500).
- **A Stichtag after the document's date is refused** (decided by the owner on 2026-11-02, second round, 238-5: „ablehnen, `422`.“): a create or amend whose entry has `evidence.valuationDate` after `evidence.date` answers **`422`** (code `VALUATION_DATE_AFTER_EVIDENCE_DATE`, `details: { index, valuationDate, evidenceDate }`, `index` the entry's position in `usefulLife`; the name is this spec's, **confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-02, third round:** „Der Codename `VALUATION_DATE_AFTER_EVIDENCE_DATE` ist in Ordnung.“; as implemented the `details` also carry `acquisitionId`, "As implemented (VC-X-41 Part 1)" 13), after the `400` field checks and before any write. A document cannot attest a Stichtag after its own date; this is a structural error at the boundary, not a tax judgement. The same day, and any earlier Stichtag, is accepted. The refusal applies to what a create or amend sends; an entry Part 1 already stored with a later Stichtag is not reinterpreted or changed, and its next amend must correct it (no productive installation exists, so no such entry is productive data).
- **A late evidence that is not released is accepted** at create and amend (decided 2026-11-02, second round, 238-4: „annehmen, wie heute.“): the facts are recorded, and the schedule refuses the computation (`SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RELEASE_MISSING`, Part 1's guard), since the transfer date and with it the case can still change.

### Texts for the user (German; proposals for the UI)

The UI texts live in `docs/development/ui-guide.md`, which this spec does not change. These are the proposals:

- `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RESIDUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED`: „Die kürzere Nutzungsdauer ist erst zum Stichtag {valuationDate} nachgewiesen (Dokument vom {evidenceDate}). Bis {fromYear − 1} gilt der gesetzliche AfA-Satz. Die Verteilung des Restwerts auf die Restnutzungsdauer ab {fromYear} berechnet DE noch nicht.“
- `SUBSEQUENT_COST_SHORTER_LIFE_NOT_SUPPORTED`: „Für diesen Erwerb gilt eine kürzere Nutzungsdauer. Nachträgliche Herstellungskosten über die Restnutzungsdauer berechnet DE noch nicht.“
- `USEFUL_LIFE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_PURCHASE`: „Der Nachweis der Nutzungsdauer (Dokument vom {evidenceDate}) hat den Stichtag {valuationDate} und liegt vor dem Kaufvertrag ({contractDate}). Bitte einen Nachweis zum Erwerb erfassen.“
- `REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE_ENDED`: „Die nachgewiesene Restnutzungsdauer endete {lastMonth}. Für diese Kosten ist ein neuer Nachweis nötig.“
- `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` with `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`: „Kürzere Nutzungsdauer ab {fromYear}: Restwert zum 31.12.{fromYear − 1} verteilt auf {usefulLifeYears} Jahre (bis {lastMonth}).“
- The entry's two dates (decided 2026-11-02): „Datum des Dokuments“ (`evidence.date`) and „Stichtag des Nachweises“ (`evidence.valuationDate`), with the hint „Der Tag, zu dem der Nachweis die Restnutzungsdauer angibt“; the release note: „Freigabevermerk“.
- `USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING`: „Für diesen Nachweis ist kein Stichtag erfasst. Das Datum des Dokuments wird nicht als Stichtag verwendet. Bitte den Stichtag ergänzen.“

### In the database (Part 1: migration 0056)

- **On the asset** (decided 2026-11-02): `depreciation_asset_useful_life` keeps `evidence_date` (0049) as the document's date and gains `valuation_date` (`date`, nullable) and `release_note` (text 1–500, nullable). `valuation_date` is never filled from `evidence_date`: the rows stored before stay `NULL`, so their entries read `USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING`. An insert trigger refuses a new row without `valuation_date` (an amend writes the whole list anew, §59).
- **The recorded versions (0052's tables):** `depreciation_schedule_version_component` gains `shorter_life_valuation_date` (`date`, the Stichtag), set exactly when `kind` is `ACQUISITION` and `rate_kind` is `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` (CHECK), as `shorter_life_review_state` is. Nothing productive is recorded (the switch has never been on), so **`up` refuses while any `depreciation_schedule_version` row exists**, naming the reset of a non-production database (as 0053 does).
- **The migration lands with Part 1** (decided: Part 1 first), since Part 1 already makes the years computed depend on the Stichtag. Part 2 needs no further migration for its arithmetic: the item parts' last month follows from their pool's purchase, which the version stores (`poolKey`). **Part 2 needs a migration for the declared AfA** (open question 11, decided 2026-11-02): the per-owner cumulative AfA declared through `YE − 1` with its evidence reference, as a field of the entry (on `depreciation_asset_useful_life` or a child table, the implementation's choice), with its guards and their schema tests; the next free number at implementation (VC-X-28 takes 0060).
- **No backfill;** `down` drops the columns and refuses while a recorded version exists or a row has a `valuation_date` or `release_note`.

### Recorded versions and the fingerprint (§60)

- **Stored inputs:** a purchase component's inputs gain the entry's Stichtag (`valuationDate`) when a shorter life is used (and, under Part 2, whether the release's three conditions hold), so `computeSchedule(storedInputs)` re-derives the case, `S` and `L`. `version-compute.ts` rebuilds the entry with its `valuationDate`, without the type cast.
- **`inputFingerprint(Y)`** covers the Stichtag from the component's first year. A changed Stichtag that moves the switch changes every year from the earlier of the two `S`, and a recorded year shows `DEPRECIATION_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDED`. A changed entry resets its review state anyway (§59 amend), so the component stops until it is confirmed again.
- **`SCHEDULE_CALCULATION_VERSION`** stays 1: the migration refuses while any version row exists, so no version computed under the old arithmetic can exist, and the rule hash changes with the parameters.
- **The record command** (§60 step 4) refuses a run with any open reason of this section (`409 SCHEDULE_NOT_COMPLETE`; its list gains them), at every release stage (§60A). Recording stays disabled; nothing here enables it.

### Effect on existing data, ACC8, the tests and the stages

- **Existing entries have no Stichtag** and are not reinterpreted (decided 2026-11-02): with Part 1 each reads `USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING` in every year until amended with its Stichtag. Once amended:
- **Entries with a Stichtag in the first year** (`FROM_START`): the figures of today. `USEFUL_LIFE_START_TO_VERIFY` never applied to them.
- **Entries with a later Stichtag:** with Part 1 the years before `YE` change from `1/n` to the band's rate (lower amounts, higher residual values), and the years from `YE` on become `null`. That is the intended correction (question 8: „nicht beliebig rückwirkend“). With Part 2 the years from `YE` on are the residual spreading.
- **Entries whose Stichtag predates the contract year:** not computable (case 3).
- **Items in a shorter-life pool:** with Part 1 not computable, with Part 2 the remaining-life figures (lower or higher than `1/n` on the item, depending on how much of the life remains).
- **ACC7 and ACC8:** no shorter life, no change.
- **Existing tests:** `schedule-rules.test.ts:188–209` is rewritten for the three cases. `schedule-items.test.ts:328–346` asserts Part 1's reason and, with the Part 2 registry, the remaining-life figures. The open-code lists of both `tax-year-depreciation.test.ts` files swap the codes. `frozen-rules.test.ts` takes the new hashes explicitly. None is weakened.
- **Stages (VC-X-45):** a shorter useful life is stage 3 (report F). VC-X-41 is not a prerequisite of stage 1 (owner's decision in chat on 2026-11-01, a departure from the report's line 116, above), **provided VC-X-45 gates stage 3** (decided in §60A on 2026-11-02, also for an unconfirmed entry; not implemented). With that gate a stage-1 release keeps every purchase with a shorter-life entry unrecordable, whether Part 1, Part 2 or neither is implemented; without it, VC-X-41 (at least Part 1) stays before enablement. Part 1 is the backlog row's „or the cases kept not computable“: with it, no preview figure rests on a retroactive `1/n` even before stage 3 is released. **Part 2 lands before the first enablement of stage 1** (Entscheidung des Projektinhabers, 2026-11-02, the order): not for the case, which stays stage 3, but because the rule values it changes freeze at that enablement.

### Tests the implementation must have

- **The Stichtag:** an entry without `valuationDate` not computable in every year (`USEFUL_LIFE_VALUATION_DATE_MISSING`); `evidence.date` never read as the Stichtag (a document dated in the first year with a later Stichtag is `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`, and the reverse is `FROM_START`); a create or amend without it `400 REQUIRED`; the insert trigger past the repository, with a counter-check.
- **The case (pure):** `FROM_START` for an evidence on the first month's day, on 31 December of `Y1`, and in the contract year before a transfer in the next year; `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` for an evidence on 1 January of `Y1 + 1`; case 3 for an evidence on 31 December of `YC − 1`. Each case read from the rule (a test registry with other values changes it).
- **The threshold from the first year:** band 2 % (50 years), `Y1` 2024, `YE` 2027: `n` 46 is shorter (49), `n` 47 is not (50; `USEFUL_LIFE_NOT_SHORTER` with `yearsFromFirstYear: 50`, the band's rate in every year). The same `n` with `FROM_START` judged on `n`.
- **Part 1:** the band years before `YE` exactly as a component without an entry; `null` from `YE` (in the component, owner and property sums, never 0.00); the reason's `details`; an item part in every year (`FROM_START`) and from `YE` (`FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR`); an heir part and `NOT_OWNED` computed at the band; the two withdrawn codes absent everywhere.
- **Part 2, the purchase:** the example below literally (both owners, every year 2024–2059, the sums 144,000.00 and 96,000.00); `U` exact across a band year of `@1` and of `@2` (a start in 2021, `YE` 2024); a share reduced in `YE`, a sale after it (the sold residual stays), a tenure ending before `YE` (band only); the last month `L` taking exactly the rest; `HISTORICAL_RULE_TO_VERIFY` absent with both `verified` flags true and present with a test registry setting `shorterUsefulLifeThresholds` false.
- **Part 2, the residual value and the release:** the years before `YE` byte-identical to Part 1's; a residual value with fractions of a cent in the exact consumption spread from the rounded `R_i`, the last year closing it; a `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` entry only `CONFIRMED`, without evidence or without a release note: `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE_RELEASE_MISSING` naming what is missing; with all three computed.
- **Part 2, later costs:** an item starting after `S` (`1/(L − first + 1)`), one starting before `S` (band, then the spread), a refund, an item after `L` (`REMAINING_USEFUL_LIFE_ENDED`); the pool's figures equal under `POOLED_BASIS` and `PER_ITEM_SERIES` and without `SUBSEQUENT_COST_END_TO_VERIFY`; the owners and `NOT_OWNED` summing to the component and the property to the cent.
- **Recorded versions:** the round trip and the reproduction with a `FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR` component (the `valuationDate` stored, the version recomputed equal); a changed `valuationDate` changing the fingerprint from the earlier `S`, a changed document date (`evidenceDate`) alone changing no year; the CHECK of `shorter_life_valuation_date` past the repository (set on an item, missing on a shorter-life purchase: refused `23514`; counter-check: set on a shorter-life purchase); the migration's `up` refusing with a version row.
- **End to end:** the example below through the API (create the asset with the entry, confirm, read the schedule), with the Part 1 registry and the Part 2 registry.

### Counter-checks and mutations

**Counter-checks:** no shorter life applied to a year before the evidence year; no `1/n` on the original basis after a late evidence; no year from `YE` computed under Part 1; no 0.00 in place of a missing figure; no item in a shorter-life pool at the purchase's rate under Part 2; no evidence before the contract year accepted as the buyer's.

**Mutations** that must turn the tests red (each applied alone, restored byte for byte):
- the Stichtag ignored (`1/n` from the start in every case), or `evidence.date` read as the Stichtag where `valuationDate` is missing;
- the switch at the Stichtag's month while the rule says January (open question 2), or in January while a test registry says the Stichtag's month;
- the residual spread over `n` years from the first year instead of from `YE` (`L` too early);
- the spread computed from the exact `b_i · (1 − U)` instead of the carried-forward residual value `R_i`, so that a year before `YE` or the closing year moves by a cent;
- a late evidence computed with `CONFIRMED` only, or without its evidence or release note;
- the threshold judged on `n` alone for a late evidence;
- case 3 computed from the start;
- Part 1's reason dropped for the years from `YE` (computed at the band's rate instead);
- an item part under Part 2 at `1/n` of its basis, or ending at its own `12·n` months instead of `L`;
- the overflow of §59B left on in a shorter-life pool;
- the Stichtag left out of the stored inputs or of `inputFingerprint`;
- a parameter read from a constant, or differing between `@1` and `@2`.

### Example (synthetic)

One Acquisition, buyers A `3/5` and B `2/5`, basis 240,000.00 (A 144,000.00, B 96,000.00), economic transfer **2024-04-01** (`Y1` 2024, 9/12), contract 2024-02-10 (`YC` 2024). A building completed 1965: band `B` of `@2`, 2 %, `shorterThanYears` 50. An entry: `usefulLifeYears` **33**, evidence „Gutachten zur Restnutzungsdauer“ with `evidence.date` 2027-06-15 (the document's date) and `evidence.valuationDate` **2027-05-20** (the Stichtag, so `YE` 2027); `ADVISOR_CONFIRMED` with a release note for Part 2 (Part 1 needs only a confirmation). The Part 2 column takes the switch in January (open question 2, decided 2026-11-02) and each owner's declared AfA through 2026 recorded and matching (A 7,920.00, B 5,280.00; open question 11). A confirmed `STANDARD` method entry (§59C). Shorter: (2027 − 2024) + 33 = 36 < 50.

From 2027-01 each month consumes `(189/200) / 396` of the basis, a year `63/2200` (`annualFraction`), i.e. 6,872.7272… for the component: A 4,123.6363… (136,080.00 / 33), B 2,749.0909… (90,720.00 / 33). The cumulative rounding gives A 4,123.64, 4,123.63, 4,123.64, … (2058: 4,123.63, 2059: 4,123.64), B 2,749.09, and 2,749.10 in 2032, 2043 and 2054 (the 1/11 cent B carries each year). A's series sums to 144,000.00 and B's to 96,000.00. `L` = 2059-12, A's residual value at the end of 2058 is 4,123.64, and it is 0.00 after 2059. `SHORTER_USEFUL_LIFE` `details: { usefulLifeYears: 33, valuationDate: "2027-05-20", evidenceDate: "2027-06-15", method: "FROM_EVIDENCE_YEAR", fromYear: 2027, lastMonth: "2059-12" }`.
